entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Breath Weapons
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons:

entries.name: Molten Breath
entries: The dragon exhales molten glass in a 20-foot-long  5-foot-wide line. Each creature in the area makes a DC 11 saving throw  taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Sleep Breath
entries: The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  a creature falls unconscious for 10 minutes or until it takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Breath Weapons
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons:

entries.name: Lightning Breath
entries: The dragon exhales lightning in a 30-foot-long  5-foot-wide line. Each creature in the area makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 16 (3d10) lightning damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Ocean Surge
entries: The dragon exhales a torrent of seawater in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from the dragon.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4+4) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends  the bear can't attack a different target with its claws.

entries.name: Strangle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature that is surprised  grappled by the bugbear  or that can't see the bugbear. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage  and the target is pulled 5 feet towards the bugbear and grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends  the bugbear automatically hits with the Strangle attack and the target can't breathe.

entries.name: Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage  or 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage if the target is a creature that is surprised or that can't see the bugbear.

entries.name: Stealthy Sneak
entries: The bugbear moves up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It can then attempt to hide.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The bugbear chief makes two attacks.

entries.name: Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage  or 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage if the target is a creature that is surprised or that can't see the bugbear.

entries.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage  or 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage if the target is a creature that is surprised or that can't see the bugbear.

entries.name: Move Out
entries: The bugbear and creatures of its choice within 30 feet move up to half their Speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Steely Hide
entries: If a creature targets the bulette with a melee attack using a nonmagical weapon and rolls a natural 1 on the attack roll, the weapon breaks.

entries.name: Leap
entries: The bulette leaps up to half its Speed horizontally and half its Speed vertically without provoking opportunity attacks  and can land in a space containing one or more creatures. Each creature in its space when it lands makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and being knocked prone on a failure. On a success  the creature takes half damage and is pushed 5 feet to a space of its choice. If that space is occupied  the creature is knocked prone.

entries.name: Burrow
entries: The bulette burrows under the ground without provoking opportunity attacks  moves up to its burrow speed  and then resurfaces in an unoccupied space. If it is within 5 feet of a creature  it then makes a bite attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Jaw Clamp
entries: When an attacker within 5 feet of the bulette misses it with a melee attack, the bulette makes a bite attack against the attacker. On a hit, the attacker is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the grappled creature is restrained, and the only attack the bulette can make is a bite against the grappled creature.

entries.name: Hard Carapace
entries: After taking damage from an attack, the bulette lies down and closes its eyes, protecting all vulnerable spots. Until the beginning of its next turn, its AC becomes 21 and it has advantage on saving throws.

entries.name: Brave
entries: The bunyip has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: The bunyip can hold its breath for 1 hour.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The bunyip has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing or smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The bunyip makes a bite attack and two slam attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12+6) piercing damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained  and the bunyip can't bite another target.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Terrifying Howl
entries: The bunyip unleashes a terrifying howl. Each creature of its choice within 120 feet that can see and hear it makes a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, becoming frightened for 1 minute on a failure. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creatures saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the bunyips Terrifying Howl for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The cambion makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

entries.name: Black Iron Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage  and the target takes a wound that deals 5 (1d10) ongoing slashing damage. A creature can end the ongoing damage by staunching the wound as an action or by giving the target magical healing.

entries.name: Fire Blast
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) fire damage.

entries.name: Fiery Escape
entries: The cambion magically creates a fiery portal to the realm of its fiendish parent. The portal appears in an empty space within 5 feet. The portal lasts until the end of the cambions next turn or until it passes through the portal. No one but the cambion can pass through the portal; anyone else that enters its space takes 14 (4d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Fell Charm
entries: The cambion targets one creature within 30 feet. The target makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is magically charmed by the cambion for 1 day. The effect ends if the cambion or a cambions ally harms the target, or if the cambion commands it to take a suicidal action. While charmed, the target regards the cambion as a trusted friend and is an ally of the cambion. If the target makes a successful saving throw or the effect ends, the target is immune to this cambions Fell Charm for 24 hours.

entries.name: Command
entries: The cambion gives an order to an ally within 60 feet that can hear it. If the ally has a reaction available, it can use it to follow the cambions order, either taking an action or moving up to its Speed.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The cambion magically changes its form to that of any humanoid creature it has seen before, or back into its true form. While shapeshifted, its statistics are unchanged except that it has no armor or equipment, can't use its black iron blade, and can fly only if it is in a form with wings. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The cat has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Safe Landing
entries: The cat takes no falling damage from the first 10 feet that it falls.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage. If this damage would reduce a Small or larger target to 0 hit points  the target takes no damage from this attack.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two melee attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4+5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends  the bear can't attack a different target with its claws.

entries.name: Elite Recovery
entries: At the end of each of its turns while bloodied, the ogre can end one condition or effect on itself. It can do this even when unconscious or incapacitated.

entries.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Sweeping Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.  all creatures within 5 feet. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 10 feet away from the ogre.

entries.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The troll has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes radiant damage or is exposed to sunlight, this trait doesnt function on its next turn. The troll is petrified if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesnt regenerate.

entries.name: Severed Limbs
entries: If the troll is dealt a critical hit with a slashing weapon, one of its extremities is severed. The extremity has AC 15, 10 hit points, a Speed of 10, and the trolls Regeneration trait. The troll controls the severed extremity and perceives through it with the appropriate senses (for instance, it sees through the eyes of its severed head). As a bonus action, the troll can reattach the extremity. While the troll is missing the extremity, its maximum hit points are reduced by 10. Roll d6 to determine the severed extremity:

entries.name: 1-4: Arm
entries: If the troll has an arm, it loses an arm. It loses one of its claw attacks, and the severed arm can make a claw attack.

entries.name: 5-6: Head
entries: If the troll has a head, it loses its head. It loses its bite attack, and the severed head can make a bite attack.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll attacks with its bite and twice with its claw. When the troll uses Multiattack  it can make a rock attack in place of one claw attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur attacks with its pike and its hooves.

entries.name: Pike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If this attack deals damage  the centaurs movement doesnt provoke opportunity attacks from the target for the rest of the centaurs turn.

entries.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Deadeye Shot
entries: The centaur makes a shortbow attack with advantage.

entries.name: Devils Sight
entries: The devils darkvision penetrates magical darkness.

entries.name: Lawful Evil
entries: The devil radiates a Lawful and Evil aura.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Rattling Chains
entries: Whenever the devil moves, the rattling of its chains can be heard up to 300 feet away, unless it moves at half its Speed.

entries.name: Relentless Tracker
entries: Once the devil has grappled a creature in its chains, it has advantage on ability checks made to track that creature for the next 30 days.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The chain devil makes two chain attacks and commands up to two animated chains under its control to make chain attacks.

entries.name: Chain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained. Until the grapple ends  this chain can only attack the grappled target.

entries.name: Animate Chain
entries: One inanimate, unattended chain within 60 feet sprouts blades and magically animates under the devils control for 1 hour. It has AC 20 and 20 hit points, a Speed of 0, and immunity to psychic, piercing, poison, and thunder damage. When the devil uses Multiattack, the devil may command the chain to make one Chain attack against a target within 15 feet of it. If the chain is reduced to 0 hit points, it can't be reanimated.

entries.name: Unnerving Mask
entries: When damaged by a creature within 30 feet that can see the devil, the devil momentarily assumes the magical illusory form of one of the attackers enemies or loved ones, alive or dead. The illusory figure may speak words that only the attacker can hear. The attacker makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn.The attacker is then immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The warrior attacks twice.

entries.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage. If the warrior has moved this turn, this attack is made with advantage.

entries.name: Reactive Heads
entries: The chimera can take three reactions per round, but not more than one per turn.

entries.name: Three Heads
entries: The chimera has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious, and it can't be flanked.

entries.name: Wakeful
entries: When one of the chimeras heads is asleep, the others are awake.

entries.name: Headbutt
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage  or 14 (4d4 + 4) slashing damage against a prone target.

entries.name: Breath Weapon
entries: The dragon head breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Tail Swipe
entries: If a creature within 5 feet hits the chimera with a melee attack, the attacker is battered by the chimeras tail. The attacker makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is pushed 10 feet from the chimera and knocked prone.

entries.name: Winged Charge
entries: If a creature the chimera can see hits it with a ranged attack, the chimera leaps off the ground and moves up to its fly speed towards the attacker. If within range, the chimera then makes a headbutt attack against the attacker.

entries.name: Bite
entries: The chimera uses its Bite attack.

entries.name: Claw
entries: The chimera uses its Claw attack.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The chimera can take 2 legendary actions: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

name: Chuul
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The chuul can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Detect Magic
entries: The chuul senses a magical aura around any visible creature or object within 120 feet that bears magic.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: If the chuul is grappling a creature  it uses its tentacle on that creature. It then makes two pincer attacks.

entries.name: Pincer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 15). When carrying a grappled creature  the chuul can move at full speed. A pincer that is being used to grapple a creature can be used only to attack that creature.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: A grappled creature makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is paralyzed for 1 minute. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the paralysis on a success.

name: Clay Guardian
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

entries.name: Constructed Nature
entries: Guardians dont require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Acid Absorption
entries: When the guardian is subjected to acid damage, it instead regains hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.

entries.name: Berserk
entries: When the guardian starts its turn while bloodied , roll a d6. On a 6, the guardian goes berserk. While berserk, the guardian attacks the nearest creature it can see. If it can’t reach a creature, it attacks an object. The guardian stays berserk until it is destroyed or restored to full hit points.

entries.name: Bloodied Haste
entries: While the guardian is bloodied, its speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws , and it can use its slam as a bonus action.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: The guardian is immune to any effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian attacks twice with its slam.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage dealt. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A greater restoration spell or similar magic removes the reduction.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: When motionless, the cloaker is indistinguishable from a black cloak or similar cloth or leather article.

entries.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: The cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Perception checks while in bright light.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). If the cloaker has advantage against the target  the cloaker attaches to the targets head  and the target is blinded and suffocating. Until this grapple ends  the cloaker automatically hits the grappled creature with this attack. When the cloaker is dealt damage while grappling  it takes half the damage (rounded down) and the other half is dealt to the grappled target. The cloaker can have only one creature grappled at once.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage  and the creature makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned until the end of the cloakers next turn.

entries.name: Moan
entries: Each non-aberration creature within 60 feet that can hear its moan makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is frightened until the end of the cloakers next turn. When a creature succeeds on this saving throw  it becomes immune to the cloakers moan for 24 hours.

entries.name: Phantasms
entries: The cloaker magically creates flickering illusions of itself in its space. Attacks on it have disadvantage. This effect ends after 1 minute  when the cloaker enters an area of bright light  or when it successfully grapples a creature.

entries.name: Reactive Tail
entries: When hit or missed with a melee attack, the cloaker makes a tail attack against the attacker.

entries.name: Angry Moan
entries: When the cloaker takes damage, it uses Moan.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the sentinel is indistinguishable from normal armor.

entries.name: Clockwork Nature
entries: A clockwork doesnt require air, nourishment, or rest, and is immune to disease.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: The clockwork is immune to any effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The sentinel attacks three times.

entries.name: Halberd
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Calculated Sweep
entries: The sentinel makes a melee attack against each creature of its choice within 10 feet. On a critical hit  the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Overclock
entries: The sentinel takes the Dash action.

entries.name: Parry
entries: The sentinel adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

entries.name: Cloud Sight
entries: Clouds and fog do not impair the giants vision.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The giants spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect magic, fog cloud, light, 3/day each: feather fall, fly, misty step, telekinesis, 1/day each: control weather, gaseous form

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant attacks twice with its glaive.

entries.name: Glaive
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 39 (9d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 20 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Fog Cloud (1st-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The giant creates a 20-foot-radius  heavily obscured sphere of fog centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. The fog spreads around corners and can be dispersed by a moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour). It lasts for 1 hour.

entries.name: Gust
entries: One creature within 10 feet makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is pushed up to 30 feet away from the giant.

entries.name: Misty Step (2nd-Level; V)
entries: The giant teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. The giant can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

entries.name: Cloud Sight
entries: Clouds and fog do not impair the giants vision.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The giants spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect magic, fog cloud, light, 3/day each: feather fall, fly, misty step, telekinesis, 1/day each: control weather, gaseous form

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant attacks twice with its glaive.

entries.name: Glaive
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 39 (9d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 20 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Fog Cloud (1st-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The giant creates a 20-foot-radius  heavily obscured sphere of fog centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. The fog spreads around corners and can be dispersed by a moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour). It lasts for 1 hour.

entries.name: Arc Lightning
entries: Up to three creatures within 60 feet that the giant can see make DC 15 Dexterity saving throws  taking 42 (12d6) lightning damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Blinking Blades
entries: The giant magically teleports multiple times within a few seconds. The giant may make one glaive attack against each creature of its choice within 30 feet  up to a maximum of 6 attacks.

entries.name: Reverse Gravity
entries: Each creature of the giants choice within 30 feet is magically hurled 60 feet in the air. If a creature hits an obstacle  it takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage. The creatures then fall  taking falling damage as normal.

entries.name: Silver Tongue
entries: One creature that can hear the giant within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically charmed by the giant for 1 hour. This effect ends if the giant or its allies harm the creature.

entries.name: Gust
entries: One creature within 10 feet makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is pushed up to 30 feet away from the giant.

entries.name: Misty Step (2nd-Level; V)
entries: The giant teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. The giant can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw against being petrified. On a failure  the target is restrained as it begins to turn to stone. A lesser restoration spell ends this effect. If still restrained  the creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success  the effect ends. On a failure  the creature is petrified for 24 hours.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries: When attacked by a creature it can see within 20 feet, the cockatrice moves up to half its Speed and makes a bite attack against that creature.

entries.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Stone
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 10/30 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Area Vulnerability
entries: The mob takes double damage from any effect that targets an area.

entries.name: Mob Dispersal
entries: When the mob is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into 5 (1d6 + 2) commoners with 2 hit points.

entries.name: Mob
entries: The mob is composed of 10 or more commoners. If it is subjected to a spell, attack, or other effect that affects only one target, it takes any damage but ignores other effects. It can share its space with Medium or smaller creatures or objects. The mob can move through any opening large enough for one Medium creature.

entries.name: Clubs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., up to two targets. Hit: 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage  or half damage if the mob is bloodied.

entries.name: Stones
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 10/30 ft., up to two targets. Hit: 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage or half damage if the mob is bloodied.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained and the snake can't constrict a different target.

entries.name: Flow Within the Mountain
entries: The dragon has advantage on Stealth checks made to hide in mountainous regions.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Breath Weapons
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons:

entries.name: Acid Breath
entries: The dragon exhales acid in a 20-foot-long  5-foot wide-line. Each creature in the area makes a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw  taking 13 (3d8) acid damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Slowing Breath
entries: The dragon exhales toxic gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw  becoming slowed for 1 minute on a failure. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Aquatic
entries: The coralfish can only breathe underwater.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw against being petrified. On a failure  the target is restrained as it begins to turn to a brightly colored statue. A lesser restoration spell ends this effect. If still restrained  the creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success  the effect ends. On a failure  the creature is petrified for 24 hours.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries: When attacked by a creature it can see within 20 feet, the cockatrice moves up to half its Speed and makes a bite attack against that creature.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The unicorn attacks once with its hooves and once with its horn.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage. If the target is a creature and the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Trample
entries: The unicorn attacks a prone creature with its hooves.

entries.name: Darkness Aura
entries: A 15-foot radius area of magical darkness emanates from the unicorn  spreading around corners and moving with it. Darkvision and natural light can't penetrate it. If the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a 2nd-level spell or lower  the spell creating the light is dispelled. The darkness aura lasts for 10 minutes or until the unicorn takes damage. The aura doesnt hinder the unicorns sight.

entries.name: Grant Boon
entries: The unicorn touches a willing creature including itself  with its horn and grants one of the following boons:

entries.name: Healing
entries: The creature magically regains 21 (6d6) hit points. It is cured of all diseases and poisons affecting it are neutralized.

entries.name: Luck: During the next 24 hours, the creature can roll a d12 and add the result to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw after seeing the result
Protection: A glowing mote of light orbits the creatures head
entries: The mote lasts 24 hours. When the creature fails a saving throw  it can use its reaction to expend the mote and succeed on the saving throw.

entries.name: Resolution
entries: The creature is immune to being charmed or frightened for 24 hours.

entries.name: Alchemy Schooling
entries: The alchemist gains their proficiency bonus and an expertise die (+1d6) on checks made with alchemists supplies.

entries.name: Crafting
entries: So long as the alchemist has the required components and equipment, they are able to craft potions of up to legendary rarity and other magic items of up to very rare rarity.

entries.name: Potion Crafter
entries: The alchemist has the following potions on hand:

entries.name: Potion of Climbing
entries: For 1 hour, the drinker gains a climb speed equal to its Speed and has advantage on Athletics checks made to climb.

entries.name: Potion of Greater Healing (3)
entries: Restores 14 (4d4 + 4) hit points.

entries.name: Potion of Superior Healing
entries: Restores 28 (8d4 + 8) hit points.

entries.name: Potion of Water Breathing
entries: For 1 hour, the drinker can breathe underwater.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The alchemist attacks twice with their dagger.

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

entries.name: Bomb
entries: The alchemist lobs a bomb at a point they can see within 80 feet. Upon impact the bomb explodes in a 10-foot radius. Creatures in the area make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Alter Bomb
entries: The alchemist quickly swaps reagents to change the damage dealt by their next bomb to acid, cold, lightning, poison, or thunder.

entries.name: Potion
entries: The alchemist drinks or administers a potion.

entries.name: Desperate Drink (1/Day
entries: When the alchemist is dealt damage, they drink a potion.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The couatls spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, 3/day each: create food and water, detect thoughts, lesser restoration, 1/day each: dream, greater restoration, scrying

entries.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained  the couatl can't constrict other targets  and the couatl has advantage on attacks against the target.

attack.targets: Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained  the couatl can't constrict other targets  and the couatl has advantage on attacks against the target

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned for 24 hours. The target is unconscious until the poisoned condition ends or a creature uses an action to shake the target awake.

entries.name: Heal
entries: The couatl touches a creature  magically healing 20 hit points of damage and ending the poisoned condition on that creature.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The couatl magically changes its form to resemble that of a humanoid or beast  or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. If its form is humanoid  it is equipped with clothing and a weapon. While shapeshifted  its statistics are the same except that it can't use Constrict and Shielding Wing and it may gain a swim speed of 60 or lose its fly speed if appropriate to its new form. If its a beast  it can use its bite attack. If its a humanoid  it may make a weapon attack  which functions identically to its bite attack.

entries.name: Shielding Wing
entries: When the couatl or a creature within 5 feet is attacked, the couatl can interpose a wing and impose disadvantage on the attack.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The hag can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The hags innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: dancing lights, disguise self, invisibility, minor illusion, 1/day: geas

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag attacks twice with its claws and then uses Hex if not in beast form.

entries.name: Beast Form
entries: The hag magically transforms into a Large or smaller beast or back into its true form. While in beast form  it retains its game statistics can't cast spells can't use Hex  and can't speak. The hags Speed increases by 10 feet  and when appropriate to its beast form it gains a climb  fly  or swim speed of 40 feet. Any equipment the hag is wearing or wielding merges into its new form.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Hex (Gaze)
entries: A creature within 60 feet that is not already under a hags hex makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. A creature under an obligation to the hag automatically fails this saving throw. On a failed saving throw  the target is cursed with a magical hex that lasts 30 days. The curse ends early if the target suffers harm from the hag or if the hag ends it as an action. Roll 1d4:
Charm Hex. The target is charmed by the hag.
Fear Hex. The target is frightened of the hag.
Ill Fortune Hex. The hag magically divines the targets activities. Whenever the target attempts a long-duration task such as a craft or downtime activity  the hag can cause the activity to fail.
Sleep Hex. The target falls unconscious. The curse ends early if the target takes damage or if a creature uses an action to shake it awake.

entries.name: Invisibility (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The hag is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the hag attacks  uses Hex  or casts a spell.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature touched by the hags claws is magically cursed for 30 days. While under this curse, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls made against the hag.

entries.name: Evil
entries: The hag radiates an Evil aura.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage  and the target is subject to the hags Curse trait.

entries.name: Sleep Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target falls asleep for 4 hours or until it takes damage or is shaken awake. Once the hag successfully hits a target  it can't make this attack again until it finishes a long rest.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The hag magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid. Equipment it is carrying isnt transformed. It retains its claws in any form. It has no true form and remains in its current form when it dies.

entries.name: Planar Travel
entries: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane  or vice versa. Alternatively  the hag is magically transported to the Material Plane  Hell  or the Abyss  arriving within 10 miles of its desired destination.

entries.name: Nightmare Haunting
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane  the hag magically touches a sleeping creature that is under the night hags Curse and is not protected by a magic circle or protection from evil and good spell or similar magic. As long as the touch persists  the target has terrible nightmares. If the nightmares last for 1 hour  the target gains no benefit from the rest  and its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10) until the curse ends. If this effect reduces the targets hit points maximum to 0  the target dies and the hag captures its soul. The reduction to the targets hit point maximum lasts until removed by greater restoration or similar magic.

entries.name: Fragmentary Dream
entries: The hag creates a terrifying illusion visible only to one creature that it can see within 120 feet. The creature makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. It takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and becomes frightened until the end of its turn on a failure, or takes half damage on a success.

entries.name: Steal Magic
entries: When a creature the hag can see within 60 feet casts a spell using a 3rd-level or lower spell slot, the hag attempts to steal its power. The caster makes a DC 14 saving throw using its spellcasting ability. On a failure, the spell fails, and the hag gains 5 (1d10) temporary hit points per level of the spell slot used.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The hag can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature that makes a bargain with the hag is magically cursed for 30 days. While it is cursed, the target automatically fails saving throws against the hags scrying and geas spells, and the hag can cast control weather centered on the creature.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The hags innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: dancing lights, disguise self, 1/day: control weather, geas, scrying

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Death Glare (Gaze)
entries: One frightened creature within 30 feet makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw  the creature drops to 0 hit points. On a success  the creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag attacks twice with its claws.

entries.name: Lightning Blast
entries: An 80-foot-long  5-foot-wide lightning bolt springs from the hags extended claw. Each creature in the area makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) lightning damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Horrific Transformation
entries: The hag briefly takes on a terrifying form or reveals its true form. Each creature within 30 feet that can see the hag makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. A creature under the hags curse automatically fails this saving throw. On a failure, the creature is frightened until the end of its next turn. If a creatures saving throw is successful, it is immune to the hags Horrific Transformation for 24 hours.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature that accepts a gift from the hag is magically cursed for 30 days. While it is cursed, the target automatically fails saving throws against the hags charm person, geas, and scrying spells, and the hag can cast control weather centered on the creature.

entries.name: Icy Travel
entries: The hag is not hindered by cold weather, icy surfaces, snow, wind, or storms. Additionally, the hag and her allies leave no trace when walking on snow or ice.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The hags innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: charm person, dancing lights, invisibility, minor illusion, passwall (ice only), 1/day: control weather (extreme cold), geas, scrying, 1/day each: cone of cold, wall of ice

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag attacks with its claws and uses Ice Bolt.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Ice Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) cold damage  and the target makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. A creature under the hags curse automatically fails this saving throw. On a failure  the creature is restrained as it begins to turn to ice. At the end of the creatures next turn  the creature repeats the saving throw. On a success  the effect ends. On a failure  the creature is petrified into ice. This petrification can be removed with greater restoration or similar magic.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The hag magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Equipment it is carrying isnt transformed. It retains a streak of white hair in any form. It returns to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Invisibility (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The hag is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the hag attacks or casts a spell.

entries.name: Cone of Cold (5th-Level; V, S)
entries: Frost blasts from the hag in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw  taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Wall of Ice (6th-level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The hag magically creates a wall of ice on a solid surface it can see within 120 feet. The wall is flat  1 foot thick  and can be up to 50 feet long and 20 feet high. The wall lasts for 10 minutes. Each 10-foot section has AC 12  30 hit points  vulnerability to fire damage  and immunity to cold  poison  and psychic damage. Destroying a 10-foot section of wall leaves behind a sheet of frigid air in the space the section occupied. A creature moving through the sheet of frigid air for the first time on a turn makes a Constitution saving throw  taking 17 (5d6) cold damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: If the wall enters a creatures space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (hags choice)
entries: The creature then makes a Dexterity saving throw  taking 35 (10d6) cold damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Ice Shield
entries: The hag adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it made by a creature it can see. If the attack misses, the attacker takes 14 (4d6) cold damage.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The crab can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage. If this damage would reduce a Small or larger target to 0 hit points  the target takes no damage from this attack.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The boss attacks three times with their shortsword.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Mark for Death
entries: The boss targets a creature within 30 feet that can see or hear them. For 1 minute or until the boss threatens a different target  the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage whenever the boss hits it with a weapon attack.

entries.name: Command Bodyguard
entries: When the boss would be hit by an attack, they command an ally within 5 feet to use its reaction to switch places with the boss. The ally is hit by the attack instead of the boss.

entries.name: Offhand Dagger
entries: When missed by an attack, the boss makes a dagger attack.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained and the crocodile can't bite a different target.

entries.name: Clockwork Nature
entries: A clockwork doesnt require air, nourishment, or rest, and is immune to disease.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: The clockwork is immune to any effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Crush
entries: The crusher moves up to its Speed in a straight line. While doing so  it can attempt to enter Large or smaller creatures spaces. Whenever the crusher attempts to enter a creatures space  the creature makes a DC 17 Dexterity or Strength saving throw (the creatures choice). If the creature succeeds at a Strength saving throw  the crushers movement ends for the turn. If the creature succeeds at a Dexterity saving throw  the creature may use its reaction  if available  to move up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. The first time on the crushers turn that it enters a creatures space  the creature is knocked prone and takes 50 (10d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature is prone while in the crushers space.

entries.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the crusher moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the attack deals an extra 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Overclock
entries: The crusher takes the Dash action.

entries.name: Fanatic
entries: The cult fanatic has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The cult fanatic is a 4th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12
+4 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): light
sacred flame
thaumaturgy
1st-level (4 slots): ceremony
command
detect evil and good
inflict wounds
2nd-level (3 slots): blindness/deafness
hold person

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Sacred Flame (Cantrip; V, S)
entries: One creature the cult fanatic can see within 60 feet makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 4 (1d8) radiant damage on a failure. This spell ignores cover.

entries.name: Command (1st-Level; V)
entries: One non-undead creature the cult fanatic can see within 60 feet that can hear and understand them makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target uses its next turn to grovel (falling prone and then ending its turn).

entries.name: Inflict Wounds (1st-Level; V, S)
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Blindness/Deafness (2nd-Level; V)
entries: One creature the cult fanatic can see within 30 feet makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the creature is blinded or deafened (cult fanatics choice) for 1 minute. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Hold Person (2nd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration)
entries: One humanoid the cult fanatic can see within 60 feet makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Fanatic
entries: The cultist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened by creatures not in their cult.

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Cultists worship forbidden gods, devils, demons, and other sinister beings
entries: Many cultists work to summon the object of their devotion to the world so it might grant them power and destroy their enemies.

entries.name: Sneak Attack
entries: The cutthroat deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when they hit with a weapon attack while they have advantage on the attack, or when the cutthroats target is within 5 feet of an ally of the cutthroat while the cutthroat doesnt have disadvantage on the attack.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries: The cutthroat takes the Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

entries.name: Rapid Attack
entries: The cutthroat attacks with their shortsword.

entries.name: Panicked Rage
entries: While a cyclops is frightened and the source of its fear is in sight, it makes attack rolls with advantage instead of disadvantage.

entries.name: Poor Depth Perception
entries: The cyclops makes all ranged attacks with disadvantage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The cyclops makes two melee attacks.

entries.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft. (see Poor Depth Perception)  one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Thick Skulled
entries: The cyclops can end one condition on itself that was imposed through a failed Wisdom saving throw.

entries.name: Big Windup
entries: When a creature hits the cyclops with a melee attack, the cyclops readies a powerful strike against its attacker. The cyclops has advantage on the next club attack it makes against the attacker before the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Panicked Rage
entries: While a cyclops is frightened and the source of its fear is in sight, it makes attack rolls with advantage instead of disadvantage.

entries.name: Poor Depth Perception
entries: The cyclops makes all ranged attacks with disadvantage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The cyclops makes two melee attacks.

entries.name: Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft. (see Poor Depth Perception)  one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Thick Skulled
entries: The cyclops can end one condition on itself that was imposed through a failed Wisdom saving throw.

entries.name: Big Windup
entries: When a creature hits the cyclops with a melee attack, the cyclops readies a powerful strike against its attacker. The cyclops has advantage on the next club attack it makes against the attacker before the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Echolocation
entries: The darkmantle can't use blindsight while deafened.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the darkmantle is indistinguishable from rock.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The darkmantle uses Darkness Aura and makes a crush attack.

entries.name: Darkness Aura
entries: A 15-foot radius area of magical darkness emanates from the darkmantle  spreading around corners and moving with it. Darkvision and natural light can't penetrate it. If the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a 2nd-level spell or lower  the spell creating the light is dispelled. The darkness aura lasts for 10 minutes or until the darkmantle takes damage.

entries.name: Crush
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). If the darkmantle made the attack with advantage  it attaches to the targets head  and the target is blinded and can't breathe. While grappling  the darkmantle can only attack the grappled creature but has advantage on its attack roll. The darkmantles speed becomes 0  and it moves with its target.

entries.name: Ethereal and Material
entries: The dead mans fingers lives simultaneously on the Ethereal and Material Planes. Its senses extend into both planes, and it can touch and be touched by creatures on both planes.

entries.name: Ethereal Shift
entries: When a creature on the Material Plane touches the dead mans fingers or hits it with a melee attack, the creature is magically transported to the Ethereal Plane. The creature can see and hear into both the Ethereal and Material Plane but is unaffected by creatures and objects on the Material Plane. It can be seen as a ghostly form by creatures on the Material Plane. It can move in any direction, with each foot of movement up or down costing 2 feet of movement.

entries.name: If the creature is still on the Ethereal Plane when the dead mans fingers dies, the creature returns to the Material Plane
entries: If this would cause a creature to appear in a space occupied by a solid object or creature, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 10 (3d6) force damage.

entries.name: Flammable
entries: After taking fire damage, the dead mans fingers catches fire and takes ongoing 11 (2d10) fire damage if it isnt already suffering ongoing fire damage. It can spend an action or bonus action to extinguish this fire.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dead mans fingers makes two tendril attacks.

entries.name: Tendril (Ethereal or Material Plane)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. A target on the Material Plane is subject to the Ethereal Shift trait.

entries.name: Ethereal Spores (While Bloodied, Ethereal Plane Only)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw  taking 31 (9d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies. If a creature killed by this attack remains on the Ethereal Plane for 24 hours  its corpse disintegrates  and a new dead mans fingers sprouts from its place.

entries.name: Telekinetic Pull (Ethereal or Material Plane)
entries: One creature within 90 feet makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is magically pulled up to 60 feet straight towards the dead mans fingers.

entries.name: Two Heads
entries: The death dog has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws made to resist being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious, and it can't be flanked.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The death dog attacks twice with its bite.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it becomes infected with a disease. Until this disease is cured  the target is poisoned. While diseased  the target makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw every 24 hours  reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure and ending the disease on a success. This hit point maximum reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

entries.name: Deep Dwarf Resistance
entries: The soldier has advantage on saving throws against illusions and to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

entries.name: Deep Dwarf Magic
entries: The deep dwarf can innately cast enlarge/reduce (self only, enlarge only) and invisibility (self only) once per long rest without using material components, using Intelligence for their spellcasting ability.

entries.name: War Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage  or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage if within 5 feet of an ally that is not incapacitated  plus 2 (1d4) damage when Enlarged.

entries.name: Enlarge (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The soldier and their equipment grow to Large size for 1 minute. They have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws  and their attacks deal an extra 2 (1d4) damage (included in their War Pick attack).

entries.name: Invisibility (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The soldier is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the soldier attacks or casts a spell.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Tactical Movement
entries: Until the end of the soldiers turn, their Speed is halved and their movement doesnt provoke opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The scout has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing or sight.

entries.name: Camouflage
entries: The scout has advantage on Stealth checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

entries.name: Deep Gnome Resistance
entries: The scout has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

entries.name: Deep Gnome Magic
entries: The deep gnome can innately cast blindness/deafness (blindness only), disguise self, and nondetection once per long rest without using material components, using Intelligence for their spellcasting ability.

entries.name: War Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Blindness (2nd-Level; V)
entries: A creature within 30 feet makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the target is blinded for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The deer has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

entries.name: Headbutt
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

name: Demilich
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but doesnt speak

entries.name: Avoidance
entries: If the demilich makes a saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a success, it takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the demilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, one of the five tiny warding gems set on its forehead or teeth shatters.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: A demilich doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Devour Soul
entries: The demilich targets one creature within 120 feet  forcing it to make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a success  or if all the large soul gems on the demilichs skull are occupied  the creature takes 40 necrotic damage  and the demilich regains the same number of hit points. If the target fails its saving throw and there is at least one unoccupied soul gem on the demilichs skull  the demilich regains 40 hit points  and the target dies instantly. Its soul is trapped in a soul gem on the demilichs skull  visible as a tiny  creature-shaped mote of light. While its soul is trapped  a creature can't be restored to life by any means. A soul that remains in a soul gem for 30 days is destroyed forever. If the demilich is defeated and a soul gem crushed  the creature is restored to life if its body is within 100 miles. A creature that succeeds on a saving throw against this effect is immune to it for 24 hours.

entries.name: A demilich begins combat with one or two empty soul gems
Cranial Transposition
entries: The dust surrounding the demilich falls to the ground. The demilich and a nonmagical, unattended skull within 30 teleport, switching places. Until the demilich moves or attacks, it is indistinguishable from a nonmagical skull, and the dust composing the demilichs wraithlike body doesnt reform around it.

entries.name: Dust Storm
entries: The dust of the demilichs body swirls in a 30-foot radius around the demilich. Each creature in the area makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. The demilich then moves up to its speed.

entries.name: Ringing Laugh
entries: Each creature within 60 feet that can hear the demilich makes a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature is frightened until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Telekinesis
entries: The demilich targets a Huge or smaller creature or an object weighing up to 1,000 pounds within 60 feet. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw. Otherwise, the demilich moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction, including up. If another creature or object stops the targets movement, both take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. At the end of this movement, the target falls if it is still in the air, taking falling damage as normal.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The demilich can take 3 legendary actions: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. The demilich regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Aligned
entries: An angel radiates a Lawful aura. Most angels also radiate a Good aura, and a few radiate Evil.

entries.name: Celestial Dissolution
entries: When an angel dies, its body and equipment dissolve into motes of light.

entries.name: Detect Alignment
entries: An angel knows the alignment, if any, of each creature within 30 feet that it can see.

entries.name: Immortal Nature
entries: An angel doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The deva makes two attacks.

entries.name: Celestial Hammer (Deva Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (5d6) radiant damage. On a hit  the target can't make opportunity attacks against the deva until the beginning of the targets next turn.

entries.name: Divine Blast
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

entries.name: Radiant Energy
entries: The deva touches a creature other than itself. If the target is unwilling  the deva makes an attack roll with a +8 bonus. The deva can choose to magically heal 60 hit points of damage and end any blindness  curse  deafness  disease  or poison on the target. Alternatively  the deva can choose to deal 60 radiant damage to the target.

entries.name: Change Form
entries: The deva magically transforms into a beast or humanoid or back into its true form. It retains its deva statistics  including speech and telepathy  except that it has the size  movement modes  and traits of its new form.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The diplodocus makes a stomp attack and a tail attack against two different targets.

entries.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it is pushed 10 feet away from the diplodocus and knocked prone.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The centipede can climb even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage and the target makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. The target is paralyzed while poisoned in this way. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The tyrannosaurus makes a bite attack and a tail attack against two different targets.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends  the tyrannosaurus can't bite a different creature and it has advantage on bite attacks against the grappled creature.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The wolf has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing and smell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The wolf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolfs allies is within 5 feet of the creature and not incapacitated.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The rat has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The giant rat has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the rats allies is within 5 feet of the creature and not incapacitated.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage. Giant rats who dwell in sewers and filth can carry debilitating disease. A creature bitten by a diseased giant rat makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or it becomes infected with sewer plague.

entries.name: Earth Glide
entries: The divi can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The divis innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: alter self (can assume Medium or Large form), detect magic, stone shape, 3/day each: creation, move earth, passwall, tongues, 1/day each: conjure elemental (earth elemental only), plane shift (to Elemental Plane of Earth only)

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The divi makes two melee attacks.

entries.name: Crushing Hand
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends  the divi can't use Crushing Hand on another target and has advantage on Crushing Hand attacks against this target  and the target can't breathe.

entries.name: Stone Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Quake
entries: Amid deafening rumbling  the ground shakes in a 10-foot radius around a point on an earth or stone surface within 90 feet. The area becomes difficult terrain. Each non-elemental creature in the area makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw  taking 24 (7d6) thunder damage and falling prone on a failure or taking half damage on a success.

entries.name: Stone Wall
entries: A permanent stone wall magically rises from an earth or stone surface within 60 feet. The wall is 6 inches thick and can be up to 20 feet high and 30 feet long. If it appears in a creatures space, the creature can choose which side of the wall to move to. Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall is an object with AC 18 and 30 hit points.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The djinni makes three scimitar attacks.

entries.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

entries.name: Lightning Blast
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (10d6) lightning damage.

entries.name: Scimitar Sweep
entries: The djinn makes a scimitar attack against each creature of its choice within its reach.

entries.name: Giant Form (1/Day
entries: The djinni magically becomes a Huge, semi-substantial creature of billowing cloud. In this form, it gains resistance to nonmagical damage, and its scimitar attacks gain a reach of 10 feet. The effect ends after 1 minute, when the djinni is incapacitated, or if the djinn becomes bloodied.

entries.name: Whirlwind
entries: A magical, 5-foot-wide, 30-foot-tall whirlwind appears in a space the djinni can see within 60 feet. The whirlwind may appear in another creatures space. If the whirlwind appears in another creatures space, or when it enters a creatures space for the first time on a turn, the creature makes a DC 18 Strength check, becoming restrained by the whirlwind on a failure. The whirlwind may restrain one creature at a time. A creature within 5 feet of the whirlwind (including the restrained creature) can use an action to make a DC 18 Strength check, freeing the restrained creature on a success. A freed creature can move to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the whirlwind.

entries.name: As a bonus action
entries: The whirlwind disappears if the djinni loses sight of it, if the djinni dies or is incapacitated, or if the djinni dismisses it as an action.
