entries.name: Precise Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is surprised  it takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The doppelganger changes its form to that of any Small or Medium humanoid creature it has seen before, or back into its true form. While shapeshifted, its statistics are the same. Any equipment is not transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Read Thoughts
entries: The doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet that it can see. Until the end of its turn, it has advantage on attack rolls and on Deception, Insight, Intimidation, and Persuasion checks against the creature.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Fanatic
entries: The cult fanatic has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

entries.name: Immunity
entries: A dragon cultist is immune to one damage type dealt by their draconic masters breath weapon.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The cult fanatic is a 4th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12
+4 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): light
sacred flame
thaumaturgy
1st-level (4 slots): ceremony
command
detect evil and good
inflict wounds
2nd-level (3 slots): blindness/deafness
hold person

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Sacred Flame (Cantrip; V, S)
entries: One creature the cult fanatic can see within 60 feet makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 4 (1d8) radiant damage on a failure. This spell ignores cover.

entries.name: Command (1st-Level; V)
entries: One non-undead creature the cult fanatic can see within 60 feet that can hear and understand them makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target uses its next turn to grovel (falling prone and then ending its turn).

entries.name: Inflict Wounds (1st-Level; V, S)
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Blindness/Deafness (2nd-Level; V)
entries: One creature the cult fanatic can see within 30 feet makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the creature is blinded or deafened (cult fanatics choice) for 1 minute. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Hold Person (2nd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration)
entries: One humanoid the cult fanatic can see within 60 feet makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The dragon turtles spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: 3/day each: control weather, water breathing, zone of truth

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 52 (7d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 21). Until this grapple ends  the dragon turtle can't bite a different creature  and it has advantage on bite attacks against the grappled creature.

entries.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 46 (6d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals double damage against objects  vehicles  and constructs.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 46 (6d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 15 feet away from the dragon turtle and knocked prone.

entries.name: Steam Breath
entries: The dragon turtle exhales steam in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw  taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

entries.name: Lightning Storm
entries: Hundreds of arcs of lightning crackle from the dragon turtle. Each creature within 90 feet makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw  taking 35 (10d6) lightning damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage.

entries.name: Retract
entries: When the dragon turtle takes 50 damage or more from a single attack or spell, it retracts its head and limbs into its shell. It immediately regains 20 hit points. While retracted, it is blinded; its Speed is 0; it can't take reactions; it has advantage on saving throws; attacks against it have disadvantage; and it has resistance to all damage. The dragon turtle stays retracted until the beginning of its next turn.

entries.name: Tail
entries: When the dragon turtle is hit by an opportunity attack, it makes a tail attack.

entries.name: Draconic Resistance
entries: The warrior is resistant to one damage type dealt by their draconic masters breath weapon.

entries.name: Draconic Smite
entries: The warriors weapon attacks deal an additional (1d6) damage of one damage type dealt by their draconic masters breath weapon.

entries.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

resistances.name: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the gargoyle is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: Gargoyles dont require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle attacks with its bite and its claws.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage  or 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage if the gargoyle started its turn at least 20 feet above the target.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Spit
entries: The gargoyle spits a steam of water 5 feet wide and 30 feet long. Each creature in the area makes a DC 12 Strength saving throw  taking 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and being pushed up to 15 feet from the gargoyle on a failure. On a success  a creature takes half damage.

name: Dread Knight
languages: the languages it knew in life

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: A dread knight doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Unholy Aura
entries: The dread knight and allies within 30 feet have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects and against features that turn undead. Other creatures of the dread knights choice within 30 feet have disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

entries.name: Cursed Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage  and the targets hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

entries.name: Fire Blast
entries: A fiery mote streaks from the dread knights finger to a point within 120 feet and blossoms into a 20-foot-radius sphere of black fire which spreads around corners. Each creature within the area makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw  taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed saving throw or half damage on a success. This damage ignores fire resistance and treats immunity to fire damage as fire resistance.

entries.name: Ice Wall
entries: The dread knight magically creates a wall of ice on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet. The wall is flat  1 foot thick  and can be up to 50 feet long and 15 feet high. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until destroyed. Each 10-foot section has AC 12  30 hit points  vulnerability to fire damage  and immunity to cold  necrotic  poison  and psychic damage.

entries.name: If the wall enters a creatures space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (creatures choice)
entries: The creature then makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw  taking 49 (14d6) cold damage on a successful save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Soul Wrack
entries: A creature within 60 feet makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw  taking 70 (20d6) necrotic damage and falling prone on a failed save or taking half damage on a success.

entries.name: Summon Fiendish Steed
entries: A fell nightmare or wyvern magically appears in an empty space within 5 feet. The steed follows the dread knights commands and acts on its turn. It may attack on the turn on which it is summoned. It remains until the dread knight dismisses it as an action or it is killed.

entries.name: Cursed Greatsword
entries: The dread knight makes a cursed greatsword attack.

entries.name: Break Magic
entries: The dread knight ends all spell effects created by a 5th-level or lower spell slot on a creature, object, or point within 30 feet.

name: Dread Knight Champion
languages: the languages it knew in life

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: A dread knight doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Unholy Aura
entries: The dread knight and allies within 30 feet have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects and against features that turn undead. Other creatures of the dread knights choice within 30 feet have disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

entries.name: Legion
entries: The dread knights sword is a +3 greatsword that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls when it attacks with its cursed greatsword. A humanoid killed by damage from this sword rises the next dusk as a zombie. While attuned to the sword, the dread knight can use a bonus action to command zombies created in this way.

entries.name: Cursed Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage  and the targets hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

entries.name: Fire Blast
entries: A fiery mote streaks from the dread knights finger to a point within 120 feet and blossoms into a 20-foot-radius sphere of black fire which spreads around corners. Each creature within the area makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw  taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed saving throw or half damage on a success. This damage ignores fire resistance and treats immunity to fire damage as fire resistance.

entries.name: Ice Wall
entries: The dread knight magically creates a wall of ice on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet. The wall is flat  1 foot thick  and can be up to 50 feet long and 15 feet high. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until destroyed. Each 10-foot section has AC 12  30 hit points  vulnerability to fire damage  and immunity to cold  necrotic  poison  and psychic damage.

entries.name: If the wall enters a creatures space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (creatures choice)
entries: The creature then makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw  taking 49 (14d6) cold damage on a successful save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Soul Wrack
entries: A creature within 60 feet makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw  taking 70 (20d6) necrotic damage and falling prone on a failed save or taking half damage on a success.

entries.name: Summon Fiendish Steed
entries: A fell nightmare or wyvern magically appears in an empty space within 5 feet. The steed follows the dread knights commands and acts on its turn. It may attack on the turn on which it is summoned. It remains until the dread knight dismisses it as an action or it is killed.

entries.name: Cursed Greatsword
entries: The dread knight makes a cursed greatsword attack.

entries.name: Break Magic
entries: The dread knight ends all spell effects created by a 5th-level or lower spell slot on a creature, object, or point within 30 feet.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The troll has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesnt function on its next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesnt regenerate.

entries.name: Severed Limbs
entries: If the troll is dealt a critical hit with a slashing weapon, one of its extremities is severed. The extremity has AC 15, 10 hit points, a Speed of 10, and the trolls Regeneration trait. The troll controls the severed extremity and perceives through it with the appropriate senses (for instance, it sees through the eyes of its severed head). As a bonus action, the troll can reattach the extremity. While the troll is missing the extremity, its maximum hit points are reduced by 10. Roll d6 to determine the severed extremity:

entries.name: 1-4: Arm
entries: If the troll has an arm, it loses an arm. It loses one of its claw attacks, and the severed arm can make a claw attack.

entries.name: 5-6: Head
entries: If the troll has a head, it loses its head. It loses its bite attack, and the severed head can make a bite attack.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes two bite attacks and three claw attacks.

entries.name: Chaotic Evil
entries: The dretch radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

entries.name: Energy-Sucking Aura
entries: A non-demon creature that takes an action or bonus action while within 10 feet of a dretch can't take another action, bonus action, or reaction until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The drider can use its climb speed even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drider has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Perception checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Web Walker
entries: The drider ignores movement restrictions imposed by webs.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The drider makes a claws attack and then either a bite or longsword attack. Alternatively  it makes two longbow attacks.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappling a target  the drider can't attack a different target with its claws.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

entries.name: Longsword (wielded two-handed)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Longbow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 120/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Stealthy
entries: The drop bear has advantage on Stealth checks in forested areas.

entries.name: Drop
entries: The drop bear takes no damage from falling 40 feet or fewer and deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits with an attack after falling at least 20 feet. A creature that takes this extra damage is knocked prone.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two melee attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4+5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends  the bear can't attack a different target with its claws.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The druid is a 4th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12
+4 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following druid spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): druidcraft
produce flame
shillelagh
1st-level (4 slots): entangle
longstrider
speak with animals
thunderwave
2nd-level (3 slots): animal messenger
barkskin

entries.name: Shillelagh (True Form Only)
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft  one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) magical bludgeoning damage.

attack.targets: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft  one target

entries.name: Bite (Medium or Large Beast Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft  one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

attack.targets: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft  one target

entries.name: Beast Form
entries: The druid magically transforms into a Large or smaller beast or back into their true form. While in beast form  they retain their game statistics can't cast spells  and can't speak. The druids Speed increases by 10 feet  and when appropriate to their beast form they gain climb  fly  or swim speeds of 40 feet. Any equipment the druid is wearing or wielding merges into their new form.

entries.name: Produce Flame (Cantrip; V, S)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 30 ft  one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) fire damage.

attack.targets: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 30 ft  one target

entries.name: Entangle (1st-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: Vines erupt in a 20-foot square centered on a spot on the ground within 120 feet. The area is difficult terrain for 1 minute. Each creature in the area when the spell is cast makes a DC 12 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is restrained by vines. A creature restrained in this way can use its action to make a Strength check (DC 12)  freeing itself on a success.

entries.name: Thunderwave (1st-Level; V, S)
entries: Thunder rolls from the druid in a 15-foot cube. Each creature in the area makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  a creature takes 9 (2d8) thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet from the druid. On a success  a creature takes half damage and is not pushed.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Speak with Nature
entries: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants.

entries.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once per turn, the dryad can use 10 feet of movement to enter a living tree and emerge from another living tree within 60 feet. Both trees must be at least Large.

entries.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Entangling Plants
entries: Plants magically erupt from the ground in a 20-foot radius around a point up to 120 feet from the dryad. Each creature of the dryads choice in the area makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure  a creature is restrained for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to make a DC 12 Strength check  freeing itself or a creature within 5 feet on a success. Additionally  the area is difficult terrain for 1 minute.

entries.name: Fey Charm
entries: A humanoid or beast within 30 feet makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically charmed. While charmed in this way  the target regards the dryad as a trusted ally and is disposed to interpret the dryads requests and actions favorably. The creature can repeat this saving throw if the dryad or the dryads allies harm it  ending the effect on a success. Otherwise  the effect lasts 24 hours. If the creature succeeds on a saving throw against Fey Charm or the effect ends for it  it is immune to Fey Charm for 24 hours.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The warrior attacks twice.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Riposte
entries: When the duelist is missed by a melee attack by an attacker they can see within 5 feet, the duelist makes a rapier attack against the attacker with advantage.

entries.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes into dust. Each creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is blinded until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the mephit is indistinguishable from a pile of dirt.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: A mephit doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Blinding Breath
entries: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of dust. Each creature in the area makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the creature is blinded for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Sleep Sand
entries: The closest creature within 60 feet with 20 hit points or fewer falls asleep for 1 minute. It awakens early if it takes damage or a creature uses an action to shake it awake. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.

entries.name: Keen Sight
entries: The eagle has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

entries.name: Earth Glide
entries: The dragon can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While the dragon remains motionless within its linked area, it is indistinguishable from a natural rocky outcropping.

entries.name: Essence Link
entries: The essence dragon is spiritually linked to a specific area or landmark. The dragon gains no benefit from a long rest when more than 1 mile away from its linked area. If the dragon dies, the area it is linked to loses its vital essence until it forms a new essence dragon, which can take centuries. When a creature first enters an area that has lost its vital essence in this way, they gain a level of fatigue and a level of strife. This fatigue and strife can be removed only by completing a long rest outside the area.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Scouring Breath
entries: The dragon breathes scouring sand and stones in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 10 (3d6) slashing damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Earth Glide
entries: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: An elemental doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Earths Embrace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends  the elemental can't burrow or use Earths Embrace and its slam attacks are made with advantage against the grappled target.

attack.targets: Until this grapple ends  the elemental can't burrow or use Earths Embrace and its slam attacks are made with advantage against the grappled target

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The efreetis innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: alter self (can assume Medium or Large form), detect magic, 3/day each: creation, gaseous form, major image, tongues, 1/day each: conjure elemental (fire elemental only), plane shift (to Elemental Plane of Fire only)

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The efreeti makes two brass sword attacks or hurls flame twice. The efreeti can replace one attack with a kick.

entries.name: Brass Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Kick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d4 + 6) bludgeoning damage  and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the efreet.

entries.name: Hurl Flame
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Fiery Wall
entries: An opaque wall of magical flame rises from the ground within 60 feet. The wall is 6 inches thick and can be up to 20 feet high and 30 feet long. Each creature within the wall when it appears makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. A creature also takes 18 (4d8) fire damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The wall disappears when the efreet is killed or incapacitated, or when it uses an action to dismiss it.

spells.name: alter self (can assume Medium or Large form)
plane shift (to Elemental Plane of Fire only)

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The efreetis innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: alter self (can assume Medium or Large form), detect magic, 3/day each: creation, gaseous form, major image, tongues, 1/day each: conjure elemental (fire elemental only), plane shift (to Elemental Plane of Fire only)

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The efreeti makes two brass sword attacks or hurls flame twice. The efreeti can replace one attack with a kick.

entries.name: Brass Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Kick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d4 + 6) bludgeoning damage  and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the efreet.

entries.name: Hurl Flame
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Fiery Wall
entries: An opaque wall of magical flame rises from the ground within 60 feet. The wall is 6 inches thick and can be up to 20 feet high and 30 feet long. Each creature within the wall when it appears makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. A creature also takes 18 (4d8) fire damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The wall disappears when the efreet is killed or incapacitated, or when it uses an action to dismiss it.

spells.name: alter self (can assume Medium or Large form)
plane shift (to Elemental Plane of Fire only)

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: The pudding can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries.name: Corrosive Body
entries: A creature that touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 9 (2d8) acid damage. A nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the black pudding corrodes after dealing damage, taking a permanent -1 penalty to damage rolls per hit. If this penalty reaches -5, the weapon is destroyed. Wooden or metal nonmagical ammunition is destroyed after dealing damage. Any other metal or organic object that touches it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The pudding can use its climb speed even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the pudding has disadvantage on attack rolls.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: An ooze doesnt require air or sleep.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target corrodes  taking a permanent -1 penalty to its AC protection per hit. If the penalty reduces the armors AC protection to 10  the armor is destroyed.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The pudding makes two pseudopod attacks. The pudding can't use Multiattack after it splits for the first time.

entries.name: Split
entries: When a Medium or larger pudding with at least 10 hit points is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two puddings that are each one size smaller. Each new pudding has half the originals hit points (rounded down).

name: Elder Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: When the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, it visibly grows older. Its original appearance is restored when it finishes a long rest.

entries.name: Misty Recovery
entries: When the vampire drops to 0 hit points, instead of falling unconscious, it turns into mist as if it had used the Mist Form legendary action. It can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to vampire form and is paralyzed for 1 hour, at which time it regains 1 hit point. While paralyzed in this way, it can be destroyed by fire damage, radiant damage, damage from a magical weapon, or a wooden stake driven through the heart, but it is otherwise immune to damage.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and hasnt taken radiant damage since its last turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Vampires most common weaknesses are sunlight and running water. When the vampire ends its turn in contact with one of its weaknesses (such as being bathed in sunlight or running water), it takes 20 radiant damage. While in contact with its weakness, it can't use its Regeneration trait or its Mist Form or Shapechange actions.

entries.name: Resting Place
entries: Every vampires lair contains a resting place, usually a coffin or sarcophagus, where the vampire must rest for at least an hour each day to recuperate its powers. This resting place is sprinkled with soil from its mortal homeland. If this soil is scattered or is subjected to a bless, hallow, or similar spell, the vampire is destroyed when reduced to 0 hit points.

entries.name: Grab (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained while grappled in this way.

entries.name: Charm
entries: The vampire targets a creature within 30 feet  forcing it to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is charmed by the vampire for 24 hours. While charmed it regards the vampire as a trusted friend and is a willing target for the vampires bite. The target repeats the saving throw each time it takes damage  ending the effect on itself on a success. If the targets saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it  it is immune to this vampires Charm for 24 hours.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target that is grappled, incapacitated, restrained, willing, or unaware of the vampires presence. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. The targets hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt, and the vampire regains this number of hit points. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. If the target is reduced to 0 hit points by this attack, it dies and rises the following night as a vampire spawn in the vampires thrall. Before the target first rises as a vampire spawn, a bless, gentle repose, or similar spell cast on the body prevents this transformation.

entries.name: Hissing Scuttle
entries: When the vampire takes radiant damage, it moves up to its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Warding Charm
entries: When a creature the vampire can see targets it with a melee attack but before the attack is made, the vampire uses Charm on that creature.

entries.name: Blood Charm
entries: The vampire uses Charm. A creature makes its initial saving throw with disadvantage if the vampire has hit it with a bite attack within the last 24 hours.

entries.name: Grab
entries: The vampire makes a grab attack.

entries.name: Mist Form
entries: The vampire transforms into a mist or back into its true form. As mist, the vampire has a flying speed of 30, can't speak, can't take actions or manipulate objects, is immune to nonmagical damage from weapons, and has advantage on saving throws and Stealth checks. It can pass through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing but can't pass through water. Anything its carrying transforms with it.

entries.name: Shapechange
entries: The vampire transforms into the shape of a Medium or smaller beast or back into its true form. While transformed, it has the beasts size and movement modes. It can't use reactions or legendary actions, and can't speak. Otherwise, it uses the vampires statistics. Anything its carrying transforms with it.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The vampire can take 1 legendary action: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8+6) piercing damage. If the elephant moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Trample Underfoot
entries: The elephant makes a stomp attack against a prone creature.

entries.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature and the elk moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 12 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Far Thoughts
entries: The dragon is aware of any creature that uses a psionic ability or communicates telepathically within 100 miles of it. As an action, the dragon can psionically observe a creature, object, or location it is familiar with within 100 miles. While observing a subject in this way, the dragon can see, hear, and communicate telepathically, but it is blind and deaf in regard to its physical senses and does not require food or water. The dragon can psionically observe a subject indefinitely and can end this effect and return to its own senses as an action.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Maddening Breath
entries: The dragon screams  stripping flesh from bone in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw  taking 16 (3d10) thunder damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Divine Grace
entries: If the empyrean makes a saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a success, it takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. Furthermore, while wearing medium armor, the empyrean adds its full Dexterity bonus to its Armor Class (already included).

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The empyreans innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: charm person, command, telekinesis, 3/day: flame strike, hold monster, lightning bolt, 1/day: commune, greater restoration, heroes feast, plane shift (self only, can't travel to or from the Material Plane)

entries.name: Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (8d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage  and the target makes a DC 25 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the target is pushed up to 30 feet away and knocked prone.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt (3rd-Level; V, S)
entries: A bolt of lightning 5 feet wide and 100 feet long arcs from the empyrean. Each creature in the area makes a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Flame Strike (5th-Level; V, S)
entries: A column of divine flame fills a 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Hold Monster (5th-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: One creature the empyrean can see within 60 feet makes a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Immortal Form
entries: The empyrean magically changes its size between Gargantuan and Medium. While Medium, the empyrean has disadvantage on Strength checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

entries.name: Attack
entries: The empyrean makes a weapon attack.

entries.name: Cast Spell
entries: The empyrean casts a spell. The empyrean can't use this option if it has cast a spell since the start of its last turn.

entries.name: Fly
entries: The empyrean flies up to half its fly speed.

entries.name: Shout
entries: Each creature within 120 feet that can hear the empyrean makes a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 24 (7d6) thunder damage and is stunned until the end of the empyreans next turn. On a success, a creature takes half damage.

spells.name: plane shift (self only, can't travel to or from the Material Plane)

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The empyrean can take 1 legendary action: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Lawful Evil
entries: The erinyes radiates a Lawful and Evil aura.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The erinyes has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The erinyes makes three attacks.

entries.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

entries.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage  and the target makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned for 24 hours or until the poison is removed by lesser restoration or similar magic.

entries.name: Lasso
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: The target is entangled by the lasso. While entangled  it can't move more than 15 feet away from the erinyes. The entanglement ends if the erinyes releases the lasso or becomes incapacitated  or if the lasso is destroyed. The lasso is an object with AC 12 and 20 HP and is immune to piercing  poison  psychic  and thunder damage. The entanglement also ends if the target or a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to succeed on a DC 16 Athletics or Acrobatics check to remove the lasso. The erinyes can't make a lasso attack while a creature is entangled.

entries.name: Parry
entries: If the erinyes is wielding a longsword and can see its attacker, it adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

entries.name: Speak with Spiders
entries: The ettercap can communicate with spiders that can hear it or that are touching the same web.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ettercap can use its climb speed even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

entries.name: Web Sense
entries: While touching a web, the ettercap knows the location of other creatures touching that web.

entries.name: Web Walker
entries: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions imposed by webs.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The ettercap attacks with its bite and claws.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Strangle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature against which the ettercap has advantage on the attack roll. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends  the ettercap automatically hits the target with its strangle attack  and the target can't breathe.

entries.name: Web
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is restrained by webs. As an action, a creature can make a DC 11 Strength check, breaking the webs on a success. The effect also ends if the webs are destroyed. They have AC 10, 1 hit point, and immunity to all damage except slashing, fire, and force.

entries.name: Reactive Heads
entries: The ettin can take two reactions each round, but not more than one per turn.

entries.name: Two Heads
entries: While both heads are awake, the ettin has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious, and it can't be flanked.

entries.name: Wakeful
entries: When one of the ettins heads is asleep, the other is awake.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The ettin makes a battleaxe attack and a club attack.

entries.name: Battleaxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature and the ettin is bloodied  the target makes a DC 15 Strength check and is knocked prone on a failure.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Axe Whirl
entries: The ettin makes a battleaxe attack against each creature within 10 feet.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The dragons innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast spells, requiring no material components. The dragon gains additional spells as it ages. 5 years old, at will: dancing lights, mage hand, minor illusion, 10 years old, 1/day: suggestion, 30 years old, 1/day: major image, 50 years old, 1/day: hallucinatory terrain

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

entries.name: Euphoria Breath
entries: The dragon breathes an intoxicating gas at a creature within 5 feet. The target makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is confused for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Prismatic Light
entries: The dragons scales pulse with light. Each creature within 15 feet that can see the dragon makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is magically blinded until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Beast Form
entries: The dragon targets one creature within 15 feet. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically transformed into a harmless Tiny beast  such as a mouse or a songbird  for 1 minute. While in this form  its statistics are unchanged  except it can't speak or take actions  reactions  or

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: The dragon and any equipment it wears or carries magically turns invisible. This invisibility ends if the dragon falls unconscious, dismisses the effect, or uses Bite, Euphoria Breath, Prismatic Light, or Beast Form.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The dragons innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast spells, requiring no material components. The dragon gains additional spells as it ages. 5 years old, at will: dancing lights, mage hand, minor illusion, 10 years old, 1/day: suggestion, 30 years old, 1/day: major image, 50 years old, 1/day: hallucinatory terrain

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

entries.name: Euphoria Breath
entries: The dragon breathes an intoxicating gas at a creature within 5 feet. The target makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is confused for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Prismatic Light
entries: The dragons scales pulse with light. Each creature within 15 feet that can see the dragon makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is magically blinded until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Beast Form
entries: The dragon targets one creature within 15 feet. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically transformed into a harmless Tiny beast  such as a mouse or a songbird  for 1 minute. While in this form  its statistics are unchanged  except it can't speak or take actions  reactions  or

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: The dragon and any equipment it wears or carries magically turns invisible. This invisibility ends if the dragon falls unconscious, dismisses the effect, or uses Bite, Euphoria Breath, Prismatic Light, or Beast Form.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The troll has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The troll has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesnt function on its next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesnt regenerate.

entries.name: Severed Limbs
entries: If the troll is dealt a critical hit with a slashing weapon, one of its extremities is severed. The extremity has AC 15, 10 hit points, a Speed of 10, and the trolls Regeneration trait. The troll controls the severed extremity and perceives through it with the appropriate senses (for instance, it sees through the eyes of its severed head). As a bonus action, the troll can reattach the extremity. While the troll is missing the extremity, its maximum hit points are reduced by 10. Roll d6 to determine the severed extremity:

entries.name: 1-4: Arm
entries: If the troll has an arm, it loses an arm. It loses one of its claw attacks, and the severed arm can make a claw attack.

entries.name: 5-6: Head
entries: If the troll has a head, it loses its head. It loses its bite attack, and the severed head can make a bite attack.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll attacks with its bite and twice with its claw. When the troll uses Multiattack  it can use Charming Murmur in place of its bite.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Charming Murmur
entries: One creature within 60 feet that can hear the troll makes a DC 12 Charisma saving throw. On a failure  it is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  its Speed is 0. The creature repeats the saving throw whenever it takes damage.

entries.name: Faerie Form
entries: The noble can magically change its size between Large, Medium, and Tiny as an action. While Tiny, the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by the nobles attacks is halved. Additionally, it has disadvantage on Strength checks and advantage on Dexterity checks. While Large, the noble has advantage on Strength checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

entries.name: Faerie Light
entries: As a bonus action, the noble can cast dim light for 30 feet, or extinguish its glow.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The nobles spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: animal messenger, detect evil and good, detect magic, disguise self, 3/day each: charm person, scrying, zone of truth, 1/day each: dream, geas, heroes feast, magic circle, polymorph (self only)

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The noble makes two glittering scimitar attacks.

entries.name: Glittering Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold  fire  lightning  or psychic damage (its choice).

entries.name: Gleaming Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. This attack ignores half or three-quarters cover. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) cold  fire  lightning  or psychic damage (its choice).

entries.name: Evil Eye (Gaze)
entries: The noble targets one creature not under the effect of a faeries Evil Eye within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw  the noble chooses one of the following effects to magically impose on the target. Each effect lasts for 1 minute.

entries.name: The target falls asleep
entries: This effect ends if the target takes damage or another creature uses an action to rouse it.

entries.name: The target is frightened
entries: This effect ends if the target is ever 60 feet or more from the noble.

entries.name: The target is poisoned
entries: It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Faerie Step
entries: The noble magically teleports up to 60 feet to a space it can see.

entries.name: Riposte
entries: When the noble is hit by a melee attack made by a creature it can see, it makes a glittering scimitar attack against the attacker.

entries.name: Vengeful Eye
entries: When the noble is hit by a ranged attack or targeted with a spell by a creature within 60 feet, it uses Evil Eye on the attacker if they can see each other.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Aligned
entries: An angel radiates a Lawful aura. Most angels also radiate a Good aura, and a few radiate Evil.

entries.name: Celestial Dissolution
entries: When an angel dies, its body and equipment dissolve into motes of light.

entries.name: Detect Alignment
entries: An angel knows the alignment, if any, of each creature within 30 feet that it can see.

entries.name: Immortal Nature
entries: An angel doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The deva makes two attacks.

entries.name: Celestial Hammer (Deva Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (5d6) radiant damage. On a hit  the target can't make opportunity attacks against the deva until the beginning of the targets next turn.

entries.name: Divine Blast
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

entries.name: Radiant Energy
entries: The deva touches a creature other than itself. If the target is unwilling  the deva makes an attack roll with a +8 bonus. The deva can choose to magically heal 60 hit points of damage and end any blindness  curse  deafness  disease  or poison on the target. Alternatively  the deva can choose to deal 60 radiant damage to the target.

entries.name: Change Form
entries: The deva magically transforms into a beast or humanoid or back into its true form. It retains its deva statistics  including speech and telepathy  except that it has the size  movement modes  and traits of its new form.

entries.name: Consume Life Energy
entries: The angel feasts on the departing life energy of a humanoid within 5 feet. The target must have been slain within the last hour. The angel magically gains temporary hit points equal to half the dead creatures maximum hit points. These hit points last until depleted. Only a spell cast with a 9th-level slot can raise the corpse from the dead.

entries.name: Champion of Truth
entries: The planetar automatically detects lies. Additionally, it cannot lie.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The planetars spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). The planetar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 1/day each: commune, control weather, raise dead

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The planetar attacks twice with its flaming sword.

entries.name: Flaming Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) ongoing fire or radiant damage (the planetars choice). A creature can use an action to extinguish this holy flame on itself or a creature within 5 feet.

entries.name: Heavenly Bolt
entries: The planetar fires a lightning bolt in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw  taking 56 (16d6) lightning damage on a failed save  or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Heal
entries: The planetar touches a creature other than itself  magically healing 60 hit points of damage and ending any blindness  curse  deafness  disease  or poison on the target.

entries.name: Consume Life Energy
entries: The angel feasts on the departing life energy of a humanoid within 5 feet. The target must have been slain within the last hour. The angel magically gains temporary hit points equal to half the dead creatures maximum hit points. These hit points last until depleted. Only a spell cast with a 9th-level slot can raise the corpse from the dead.

entries.name: Awe-Inspiring Gaze (Gaze)
entries: The planetar targets a creature within 90 feet. The target makes a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened until the end of its next turn. If the target makes its saving throw, it is immune to any angels Awe-Inspiring Gaze for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Protective Parry
entries: When a creature within 5 feet would be hit with a melee attack, the planetar applies disadvantage to the attack roll.

entries.name: Champion of Truth
entries: The solar automatically detects lies. Additionally, it cannot lie.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The solars spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). The solar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 1/day each: commune, control weather, resurrection

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The solar attacks twice with its holy sword.

entries.name: Holy Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) radiant damage.

entries.name: Column of Flame
entries: Flame erupts in a 10-foot-radius  30-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point the solar can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature in the area makes a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage and 21 (6d6) radiant damage of a failure  or half as much damage on a success.

entries.name: Consume Life Energy
entries: The angel feasts on the departing life energy of a humanoid within 5 feet. The target must have been slain within the last hour. The angel magically gains temporary hit points equal to half the dead creatures maximum hit points. These hit points last until depleted. Only a spell cast with a 9th-level slot can raise the corpse from the dead.

entries.name: Forceful Parry (While Bloodied)
entries: When a creature misses the solar with a melee attack, the solars parrying sword sparks with energy. The attacker takes 21 (6d6) lightning damage and makes a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is pushed 10 feet away and falls prone.

entries.name: Teleport
entries: The solar magically teleports up to 120 feet to an empty space it can see.

entries.name: Heal
entries: The solar touches a creature other than itself, magically healing 60 hit points of damage and ending any blindness, curse, deafness, disease, or poison on the target.

entries.name: Deafening Command
entries: The solar speaks an echoing command. Each creature of the solars choice within 30 feet that can hear the solar and understands a language makes a DC 24 Charisma saving throw. Each creature that succeeds on the saving throw takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage. Each creature that fails its saving throw immediately takes a certain action, depending on the solars command. This is a magical charm effect.

entries.name: Abase yourself! The creature falls prone
Approach! The creature must use its reaction
Flee! The creature must use its reaction
Surrender! The creature drops anything it is holding

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The solar can take 3 legendary actions: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. The solar regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Evil
entries: The nightmare radiates an Evil aura.

entries.name: Fiery Hooves
entries: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The nightmare leaves charred hoofprints.

entries.name: Fire Resistance
entries: The nightmare can grant fire resistance to a rider.

entries.name: Fiery Trail
entries: When the nightmare moves along the ground, it can choose to leave behind a trail of fire 10 feet wide and 10 feet tall, which lasts until the beginning of the nightmares next turn. A creature that begins its turn in the fire or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 10 (3d6) fire damage. The trail ignites flammable objects.

entries.name: Telepathy
entries: The nightmare gains telepathy with a range of 120 feet. It can telepathically communicate with the fiend that trained it over any distance as long as they are on the same plane of existence.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. The nightmare can move through the space of a prone creature as long as it does not end its turn there.

entries.name: Ethereal Shift
entries: The nightmare and a rider magically pass from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane or vice versa.

entries.name: Faerie Form
entries: The knight can magically change its size between Medium and Tiny as an action. While tiny, the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by the knights attacks is halved. Additionally, it has disadvantage on Strength checks and advantage on Dexterity checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

entries.name: Faerie Light
entries: As a bonus action, the knight can cast dim light for 30 feet, or extinguish its glow.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes two melee attacks.

entries.name: Glittering Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold  fire  or lightning damage (its choice).

entries.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points  the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour  even if it regains hit points  and it is asleep while poisoned in this way.

entries.name: Fey Glamour
entries: The knight targets one humanoid within 30 feet. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically charmed by the knight for 1 day. If the knight or one of the knights allies harms the target  the target repeats the saving throw  ending the effect on itself on a success. If a targets saving throw is successful  or if the effect ends for it  the creature is immune to this knights Fey Charm for a year and a day.

entries.name: Natures Shield
entries: When the knight would be hit by an attack while the knight is within 5 feet of a tree or other large plant, the knights AC magically increases by 3 against that attack as the plant interposes branches or vines between the knight and the attacker.

entries.name: Fire Form
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries.name: Fiery Aura
entries: A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the fire elemental takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

entries.name: Water Weakness
entries: The elemental takes 6 (1d12) cold damage if it enters a body of water or starts its turn in a body of water, is splashed with at least 5 gallons of water, or is hit by a water elementals slam attack.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: An elemental doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) fire damage  and the target suffers 5 (1d10) ongoing fire damage. A creature can use an action to end the ongoing damage.

entries.name: Wildfire
entries: The elemental moves up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It can enter the spaces of hostile creatures but not end this movement there. When a creature shares its space with the elemental for the first time during this movement  the creature is subject to the elementals Fiery Aura and the elemental can make a slam attack against that creature.

entries.name: Cold Weakness
entries: When the fire giant takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two greatsword attacks.

entries.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 42 (10d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 19 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Sword Sweep
entries: The giant makes a greatsword attack against each creature within 10 feet.

entries.name: Kick
entries: When hit by a melee attack by a Medium or smaller creature the giant can see within 10 feet, the giant kicks its attacker. The attacker makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 14 (3d4 + 7) bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 20 feet from the giant, and falls prone.

entries.name: Cold Weakness
entries: When the fire giant takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two greatsword attacks.

entries.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 42 (10d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 19 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Sword Sweep
entries: The giant makes a greatsword attack against each creature within 10 feet.

entries.name: Ignite Blades
entries: The greatswords of each fire giant of the giants choice within 30 feet magically kindle into flame. For the next minute  each of their greatsword attacks deal an extra 7 (2d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Pillar of Flame
entries: Each creature within a 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within 60 feet that the fire giant can see makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw  taking 56 (16d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. Unattended flammable objects are ignited.

entries.name: Kick
entries: When hit by a melee attack by a Medium or smaller creature the giant can see within 10 feet, the giant kicks its attacker. The attacker makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 14 (3d4 + 7) bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 20 feet from the giant, and falls prone.

name: Flesh Guardian
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

entries.name: Berserk
entries: When the guardian starts its turn while bloodied, roll a d6. On a 6, the guardian goes berserk. While berserk, the guardian attacks the nearest creature it can see. If it can't reach a creature, it attacks an object. The guardian stays berserk until it is destroyed or restored to full hit points.

entries.name: If a berserk guardian can see and hear its creator, the creator can use an action to try to calm it by making a DC 15 Persuasion check
entries: On a success, the guardian is no longer berserk.

entries.name: Fire Fear
entries: When the guardian takes fire damage, it is rattled until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: The guardian is immune to any effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: When the guardian is subjected to lightning damage, it instead regains hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Constructed Nature
entries: Guardians dont require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian attacks twice with its slam.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Hurl Object
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: An 80-foot-long  5-foot-wide lightning bolt springs from the guardians chest. Each creature in the area makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

name: Flumph
languages: understands Common and Undercommon but can't speak

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The flumph can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Flumph Light
entries: As a bonus action, the flumph can cast dim light for 30 feet, or extinguish its glow. The flumph can change the color of the light it casts at will.

entries.name: Telepathic Spy
entries: The flumph can perceive any telepathic messages sent or received within 60 feet, and can't be surprised by creatures with telepathy. The flumph is also immune to divination and to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, except for the Telepathic Spy feature of another flumph.

entries.name: Tippable
entries: If a flumph is knocked prone, it lands upside down and is incapacitated. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, flipping itself over and ending the incapacitated condition on a success.

entries.name: Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

entries.name: Stench Spray
entries: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  the creature exudes a horrible stench for 1 hour. While a creature exudes this stench  it and any creature within 5 feet of it are poisoned. A creature can remove the stench on itself by bathing during a rest.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The flying lion has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The griffon attacks once with its beak and once with its talons.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage  or 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage if the griffon started its turn at least 20 feet above the target  and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends  the griffon can't attack a different target with its talons.

entries.name: Flyby
entries: The snake doesnt provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of a creatures reach.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

entries.name: Spell-created
entries: The DC for dispel magic to destroy this creature is 19.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the sword is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

entries.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

entries.name: Eye Vulnerability
entries: A creature can target the fomorians eye with an attack. This attack is made with disadvantage. If the attack hits and deals at least 10 damage, creatures affected by the fomorians Charming and Mesmerizing Gaze are freed from those effects.

entries.name: Immortal Nature
entries: A titan doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The fomorian attacks twice with its warhammer.

entries.name: Warhammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Charming Gaze (Gaze)
entries: A creature within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is magically charmed by the fomorian. The creature repeats the saving throw every 24 hours and whenever it takes damage. On a successful saving throw or if the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to any fomorians Charming Gaze for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Mesmerizing Gaze (Gaze
entries: A creature within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is magically restrained. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its next turn, ending the effect on itself on a success and becoming paralyzed on a failure. While the fomorian is not in line of sight, a paralyzed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. On a successful saving throw or if the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to any fomorians Mesmerizing Gaze for 24 hours.

entries.name: Immortal Form
entries: While in its lair, the fomorian magically changes into a specific Medium humanoid resembling a human or back to its true form. Apart from its size, its statistics are unchanged. The fomorian reverts to its true form when it dies, is incapacitated, or leaves its lair.

entries.name: Forest Ways
entries: The illusionist can communicate with Small and Tiny beasts, and can innately cast blur, disguise self, and major image once each per long rest with no material components.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The mage is a 9th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14
+6 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt
light
mage hand
prestidigitation
1st-level (4 slots): detect magic
identify
mage armor
shield
2nd-level (3 slots): alter self
misty step
3rd-level (3 slots): hypnotic pattern
counterspell
fireball
4th-level (3 slots): dimension door
greater invisibility
5th-level (1 slot): cone of cold

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip; V, S)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage.

entries.name: Hypnotic Pattern (3rd-Level; S, M, Concentration)
entries: A swirling pattern of light appears at a point within 120 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of the pattern that can see it makes a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  the creature is incapacitated and its Speed is 0. The effect ends on a creature if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it out of its daze.

entries.name: Fireball (3rd-Level; V, S, M)
entries: Fire streaks from the mage to a point within 120 feet and explodes in a 20-foot radius  spreading around corners. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Dimension Door (4th-Level; V)
entries: The mage teleports to a location within 500 feet. They can bring along one willing Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. If a creature would teleport to an occupied space  it takes 14 (4d6) force damage  and the spell fails.

entries.name: Greater Invisibility (4th-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The mage or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 minute.

entries.name: Cone of Cold (5th-Level; V, S, M)
entries: Frost blasts from the mage in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw  taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Misty Step (2nd-Level; V)
entries: The mage teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet. The mage can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

entries.name: Counterspell (3rd-Level; S)
entries: When a creature the mage can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the mage attempts to interrupt it. If the creature is casting a 2nd-level spell or lower, the spell fails. If the creature is casting a 3rd-level or higher spell, the mage makes an Intelligence check against a DC of 10 + the spells level. On a success, the spell fails, and the spellcasting creature can use its reaction to try to cast a second spell with the same casting time so long as it uses a spell slot level equal to or less than half the original spell slot. If the mage casts counterspell with a higher spell slot, the interrupted spell fails if its level is less than that of counterspell.

entries.name: Shield (1st-Level; V
entries: When the mage is hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile, they gain a +5 bonus to AC (including against the triggering attack) and immunity to magic missile. These benefits last until the start of their next turn.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The scout has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing or sight.

entries.name: Forest ways
entries: The scout can communicate with Small and Tiny beasts, and can innately cast blur, disguise self, and major image once each per long rest with no material components.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Aligned
entries: The forgotten god radiates a weak alignment aura, most often Lawful and Good, Chaotic and Good, Lawful and Evil, or Chaotic and Evil. Its behavior may not match its alignment.

entries.name: Flawed Spellcasting
entries: The gods innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (save DC 17).The god can try to cast flame strike or spirit guardians at will with no material component. When the god tries to cast the spell, roll 1d6. On a 1, 2, or 3 on the die, the spell visibly fails and has no effect. The gods action for the turn is not wasted, but it can't be used to cast a spell.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: When the god fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, it seems to flicker and shrink, as if it is using up its essence.

entries.name: Divine Nature
entries: A forgotten god doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Divine Weapon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) damage (damage type based on the form of the weapon or implement) plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.

entries.name: Stunning Gaze (Gaze)
entries: The god targets a creature within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 10 (3d6) radiant damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success  the target is immune to Stunning Gaze for 24 hours.

entries.name: Divine Wrath
entries: Each creature of the gods choice within 60 feet makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Spirit Guardians (3rd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: Spirits of former divine servants surround the god in a 10-foot radius for 10 minutes. The god can choose creatures they can see to be unaffected by the spell. Other creatures treat the area as difficult terrain  and when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there  it makes a DC DC 17 Wisdom saving throw  taking 10 (3d6) radiant damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Flame Strike (5th-Level; V, S)
entries: A 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high column of divine flame appears centered on a point the god can see within 60 feet. Each creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save  or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Jumper
entries: The frog can jump up to 10 feet horizontally and 5 feet vertically without a running start.

entries.name: Fire Fear

entries.name: Multiattack
