entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Scimitar (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Sleep Gaze (Gaze, Hybrid Form Only)
entries: One creature within 30 feet of the jackalwere makes a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save  the target is magically charmed. At the beginning of the jackalweres next turn  the target repeats the saving throw. On a success  the effect ends. On a failure  the creature falls unconscious for 10 minutes. Both the charmed and unconscious conditions end if the target takes damage or a creature within reach of the target uses an action to shake the target back to its senses. If the target successfully saves against Sleep Gaze  it is immune to Sleep Gaze for 24 hours. Undead and creatures immune to charm arent affected by it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The jackalwere makes two scimitar attacks or makes one scimitar attack and uses Sleep Gaze.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The jackalwere magically changes its form, along with its equipment, to that of a specific Medium humanoid or a jackal-human hybrid or its true form, which is a Small jackal. While shapeshifted, its statistics are otherwise unchanged. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries:
The jackalwere shifts to hybrid form and uses Sleep Gaze on an unsuspecting target.
It then fights with its scimitar, staying next to at least one ally. A jackalwere is fearless when facing enemies armed with mundane weapons, but it retreats if it is outnumbered by enemies capable of bypassing its resistances.

entries.name: Strangle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature that is surprised  grappled by the kech  or that can't see the kech. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage  and the target is pulled 5 feet towards the kech and grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends  the kech automatically hits with the Strangle attack and the target can't breathe.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Stealthy Sneak
entries: The kech moves up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It can then attempt to hide.

entries.name: Detect Alignment
entries: The khalkos can detect the presence of creatures within 30 feet that have an alignment trait, and knows the alignment of such creatures.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The khalkos has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Psionic Spellcasting
entries: The khalkoss spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

entries.name: Chaos Pheromones
entries: The khalkos emits a cloud of pheromones in a 20-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners. Each non-khalkos creature in the area makes a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw. Creatures with an alignment trait make this save with disadvantage. On a failure  the creature is confused for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success. If the creature makes its saving throw or the condition ends for it  it is immune to Chaos Pheromones for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Psionic Sting
entries: The khalkos targets a creature within 30 feet  forcing it to make a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Brain Jab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated creature with a brain and an Intelligence of 6 or higher. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target becomes diseased with brain larvae. Once the khalkos has used this attack successfully, it can't use it again for 24 hours.

entries.name: Telekinetic Shield
entries: When the khalkos is hit by an attack made by a creature that it can see or sense with its Detect Alignment trait, it gains a +4 bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

entries.name: Detect Alignment
entries: The khalkos can detect the presence of creatures within 30 feet that have an alignment trait, and knows the alignment of such creatures.

entries.name: Chaos Pheromones
entries: The khalkos emits a cloud of pheromones into the air in a 10-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners. Each non-khalkos creature in the area makes a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure  the creature is confused for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success. If the creature makes its saving throw or the condition ends for it  it is immune to the chaos pheromones of khalkos spawn for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Sting
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

entries.name: Echolocation
entries: The whale can't use blindsight while deafened.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: The whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The whale has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6+4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends  the whale can't bite another target and it has advantage on bite attacks against the creature it is grappling.

entries.name: Divine Grace
entries: If the empyrean makes a saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a success, it takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. Furthermore, while wearing medium armor, the empyrean adds its full Dexterity bonus to its Armor Class (already included).

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The empyreans innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: charm person, command, telekinesis, 3/day: flame strike, hold monster, lightning bolt, 1/day: commune, greater restoration, heroes feast, plane shift (self only, can't travel to or from the Material Plane)

entries.name: Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (8d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage  and the target makes a DC 25 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the target is pushed up to 30 feet away and knocked prone.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt (3rd-Level; V, S)
entries: A bolt of lightning 5 feet wide and 100 feet long arcs from the empyrean. Each creature in the area makes a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Flame Strike (5th-Level; V, S)
entries: A column of divine flame fills a 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Hold Monster (5th-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: One creature the empyrean can see within 60 feet makes a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Immortal Form
entries: The empyrean magically changes its size between Gargantuan and Medium. While Medium, the empyrean has disadvantage on Strength checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

entries.name: Burning Gaze
entries: A line of fire 5 feet wide and 60 feet long blasts from King Fomors eye. Each creature in the area makes a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success. When King Fomor is bloodied, his Burning Gazes shape is a 60-foot cone instead of a line.

entries.name: Elite Recovery (While Bloodied)
entries: King Fomor ends one negative effect currently affecting him. He can do so as long as he has at least 1 hit point, even while unconscious or incapacitated.

entries.name: Attack
entries: The empyrean makes a weapon attack.

entries.name: Cast Spell
entries: The empyrean casts a spell. The empyrean can't use this option if it has cast a spell since the start of its last turn.

entries.name: Fly
entries: The empyrean flies up to half its fly speed.

entries.name: Shout
entries: Each creature within 120 feet that can hear the empyrean makes a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 24 (7d6) thunder damage and is stunned until the end of the empyreans next turn. On a success, a creature takes half damage.

spells.name: plane shift (self only, can't travel to or from the Material Plane)

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The empyrean can take 1 legendary action: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Multiattack

entries.name: Greatsword

entries.name: Lance (Mounted Only)

If the knight moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  they deal an extra 6 (1d12) piercing damage and the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw falling prone on a failure. This attack is made at disadvantage against targets within 5 feet.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow

entries.name: Knightly Inspiration

For the next minute inspired creatures gain an expertise die (1d4) on attack rolls and saving throws. A creature can benefit from only one Knightly Inspiration at a time and the knight cannot target themselves.

entries.name: Superior Heavy Armor Master
entries: While wearing heavy armor, the knight captain reduces bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage they take from nonmagical weapons by 5.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight captain attacks four times.

entries.name: Longsword

entries.name: Composite Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Command the Attack

entries.name: Immortal Nature
entries: The kraken doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, it can use its reaction, if available, to attack with its tentacle.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The kraken has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature grappled by the kraken  the target is swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained  its Speed is 0  it has total cover from attacks from outside the kraken  and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of the krakens turns.

entries.name: If a swallowed creature deals 50 or more damage to the kraken in a single turn, or if the kraken dies, the kraken vomits up the creature
Ink Cloud
entries: While underwater  the kraken exudes a cloud of ink in a 90-foot-radius sphere. The ink extends around corners  and the area is heavily obscured until the end of the krakens next turn or until a strong current dissipates the cloud. Each non-kraken creature in the area when the cloud appears makes a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it takes 27 (5d10) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success  it takes half damage. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Summon Storm
entries: Over the next 10 minutes  storm clouds magically gather. At the end of 10 minutes  a storm rages for 1 hour in a 5-mile radius.

entries.name: Lightning
entries: If the kraken is outside and the weather is stormy  three lightning bolts crack down from the sky  each of which strikes a different target within 120 feet of the kraken. A target makes a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage or half damage on a save.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 26). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained. A tentacle can be targeted individually by an attack. It shares the krakens hit points  but if 30 damage is dealt to the tentacle  it releases a creature it is grappling. The kraken can grapple up to 10 creatures.

entries.name: Fling
entries: One Large or smaller object or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 60 feet in a straight line. The target lands prone and takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage. If the kraken throws the target at another creature  that creature makes a DC 26 saving throw  taking the same damage on a failure.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: The kraken makes one tentacle attack.

entries.name: Fling
entries: The kraken uses Fling.

entries.name: Squeeze
entries: The kraken ends any magical effect that is restraining it or reducing its movement and then swims up to half its swim speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement, it can fit through gaps as narrow as 10 feet wide without squeezing.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The kraken can take 3 legendary actions: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Radiant Sensitivity
entries: When the ghoul takes radiant damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Perception checks that rely on sight until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Ghouls and ghasts dont require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Paralyzing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is a living creature other than an elf  it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success. If the targets saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it  it is immune to any Paralyzing Claw for 24 hours.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Chaotic Evil
entries: The lamia radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The lamias innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components. At will: charm person, disguise self (humanoid form), major image, misty step, 1/day each: geas, hallucinatory terrain, hypnotic pattern, scrying

entries.name: Dizzying Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is magically charmed for 1 hour or until it takes damage. While charmed in this way  it has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and ability checks.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 hour.

entries.name: Hypnotic Pattern (3rd-Level; S, Concentration)
entries: A swirling pattern of light appears at a point within 120 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of the pattern that can see it makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  the creature is incapacitated and its Speed is 0. The effect ends on a creature if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it out of its daze.

entries.name: Misty Step (2nd-Level; V)
entries: The lamia teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. The lamia can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

entries.name: Devils Sight
entries: The lemures darkvision penetrates magical darkness.

entries.name: Eerie Groan
entries: While the lemure can see a non-devil within 100 feet, it emits a groan that is audible within 300 feet.

entries.name: Lawful Evil
entries: The lemure radiates a Lawful and Evil aura.

entries.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Area Vulnerability
entries: The band takes double damage from any effect that targets an area.

entries.name: Band Dispersal
entries: When the band is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into 2 (1d4) lemures with 6 hit points each.

entries.name: Band
entries: The band is composed of 5 or more lemures. If it is subjected to a spell, attack, or other effect that affects only one target, it takes any damage but ignores other effects. It can share its space with Medium or smaller creatures or objects. The band can move through any opening large enough for one Medium creature without squeezing.

entries.name: Devils Sight
entries: The bands darkvision penetrates magical darkness.

entries.name: Eerie Groan
entries: While the band can see a non-devil within 100 feet, it emits a groan that is audible within 300 feet.

entries.name: Lawful Evil
entries: The band radiates a Lawful and Evil aura.

entries.name: Fists
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (5d4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: The lichs body or vestments are warded with three protective runes. When the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, one of its protective runes disappears.

entries.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it has a soul vessel, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points. The new body forms within 10 feet of the soul vessel.

entries.name: Tongueless Utterance
entries: Unless a spell has only a vocal component, the lich can cast the spell without providing a vocal component.

entries.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: A lich doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The lich is a 16th level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 20
+12 to hit with spell attacks). The lich has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt
mage hand
prestidigitation
1st-level (4 slots): detect magic
shield
silent image
thunderwave
2nd-level (3 slots): blur
detect thoughts
locate object
3rd-level (3 slots): animate dead
dispel magic
fireball
4th-level (3 slots): confusion
dimension door
5th-level (2 slots): geas
scrying
6th-level (1 slot): create undead
disintegrate
7th-level (1 slot): finger of death
teleport
8th-level (1 slot): power word stun

entries.name: Paralyzing Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) cold damage. The target makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Arc Lightning
entries: The lich targets up to 3 creatures within 60 feet. Each target makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 28 (8d6) lightning damage.

entries.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip; S)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) fire damage.

entries.name: Thunderwave (1st-Level; S)
entries: Thunder rolls from the lich in a 15-foot cube. Each creature in the area makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  a creature takes 9 (2d8) thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet from the lich. On a success  a creature takes half damage and is not pushed.

entries.name: Blur (2nd-Level; V, Concentration)
entries: The lichs form is blurred. Attack rolls against it are made with disadvantage unless the attacker has senses that allow them to perceive without sight or to see through illusions (like blindsight or truesight).

entries.name: Fireball (3rd-Level; S, M)
entries: Fire streaks from the lich to a point within 120 feet and explodes in a 20-foot radius  spreading around corners. Each creature in the area makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Confusion (4th-Level; S, M, Concentration)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of a point the lich can see within 120 feet makes a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw  becoming rattled until the end of its next turn on a success. On a failure  a creature is confused for 1 minute and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Disintegrate (6th-Level; S, M)
entries: The lich disintegrates a target within 60 feet. A Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force  or a 10-foot-cube section thereof  is automatically destroyed. A creature makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw  taking 75 (10d6 + 40) force damage on a failed save. If reduced to 0 hit points  the creature and its nonmagical gear are disintegrated  and the creature can be restored to life only with true resurrection or wish.

entries.name: Finger of Death (7th-Level; S)
entries: A creature within 60 feet makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw  taking 61 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage on a failed saving throw or half damage on a success. A humanoid killed by this spell turns into a zombie under the lichs control at the start of the lichs next turn.

entries.name: Power Word Stun (8th-Level; V)
entries: The lich targets a creature within 60 feet. If the target has more than 150 hit points  it is rattled until the end of its next turn. Otherwise  it is stunned. It can make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Eldritch Aura
entries: The lich surrounds itself with a magical, rune-covered, glowing, translucent aura in a 10-foot radius. The aura moves with the lich and casts dim light inside its area. The aura disappears at the beginning of the lichs next turn.

entries.name: Death Aura
entries: The aura casts purple light. Each living creature that ends its turn inside the aura takes 17 (5d6) necrotic damage, and the lich regains the same number of hit points.

entries.name: Shield Aura
entries: The aura casts orange light. It has 35 hit points. Whenever the lich would take damage, the aura takes the damage instead, and the aura visibly weakens. If the damage reduces the aura to 0 hit points, the aura disappears, and the lich takes any excess damage.

entries.name: Spell Shield Aura
entries: The aura casts blue light. Any spell cast with a 5th-level or lower spell slot from outside the aura can't affect anything inside the aura. Using a spell to target something inside the aura or include the auras space in an area has no effect on anything inside.

entries.name: Sabotage Spell
entries: When a creature within 60 feet casts a spell that targets the lich, the lich attempts to interrupt it. The lich makes an Intelligence check against a DC of 10 + the spells level. On a success, the spell fails, and the caster takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Shield (1st-Level; V
entries: When the lich is hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile, it gains a +5 bonus to AC (including against the triggering attack) and immunity to magic missile. These benefits last until the beginning of its next turn.

entries.name: Cast Spell
entries: The lich casts cantrip or a 1st-level spell. The lich can use 2 legendary actions to cast a 2nd-level spell or 3 legendary actions to cast a 3rd-level spell.

entries.name: Paralyzing Touch
entries: The lich uses Paralyzing Touch.

entries.name: Arc Lightning
entries: The lich uses Arc Lightning.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The lich can take 3 legendary actions: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Long Jump
entries: The lion can long jump up to 25 feet.

entries: The lion has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the lions allies is within 5 feet of the creature and not incapacitated.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage. If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Opportune Bite
entries: The lion makes a bite attack against a prone creature.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage. If this damage would reduce a Small or larger target to 0 hit points  the target takes no damage from this attack.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizardfolk attacks with its club and shield.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage  or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage if the attack is made with advantage.

entries.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Shield
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Aligned
entries: The lizardfolk radiates either an Evil or Good aura.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizardfolk attacks once with its shield and twice with its trident.

entries.name: Shield
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target makes a DC 13 Strength check. On a failure  it is knocked prone.

entries.name: Trident
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage  and the lizardfolk gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

entries.name: Supernatural Rebuke
entries: When the lizardfolk is dealt damage by a creature it can see within 60 feet, its attacker makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the attacker takes 11 (2d10) fire or radiant damage (the lizardfolks choice).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The mage is a 9th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14
+6 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt
light
mage hand
prestidigitation
1st-level (4 slots): detect magic
identify
mage armor
shield
2nd-level (3 slots): alter self
misty step
3rd-level (3 slots): clairvoyance
counterspell
fireball
4th-level (3 slots): dimension door
greater invisibility
5th-level (1 slot): cone of cold

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip; V, S)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage.

entries.name: Fireball (3rd-Level; V, S, M)
entries: Fire streaks from the mage to a point within 120 feet and explodes in a 20-foot radius  spreading around corners. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Dimension Door (4th-Level; V)
entries: The mage teleports to a location within 500 feet. They can bring along one willing Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. If a creature would teleport to an occupied space  it takes 14 (4d6) force damage  and the spell fails.

entries.name: Greater Invisibility (4th-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The mage or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 minute.

entries.name: Cone of Cold (5th-Level; V, S, M)
entries: Frost blasts from the mage in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw  taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Misty Step (2nd-Level; V)
entries: The mage teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet. The mage can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

entries.name: Counterspell (3rd-Level; S)
entries: When a creature the mage can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the mage attempts to interrupt it. If the creature is casting a 2nd-level spell or lower, the spell fails. If the creature is casting a 3rd-level or higher spell, the mage makes an Intelligence check against a DC of 10 + the spells level. On a success, the spell fails, and the spellcasting creature can use its reaction to try to cast a second spell with the same casting time so long as it uses a spell slot level equal to or less than half the original spell slot. If the mage casts counterspell with a higher spell slot, the interrupted spell fails if its level is less than that of counterspell.

entries.name: Shield (1st-Level; V
entries: When the mage is hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile, they gain a +5 bonus to AC (including against the triggering attack) and immunity to magic missile. These benefits last until the start of their next turn.

entries.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes into lava. Each creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the mephit is indistinguishable from a small magma flow.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: A mephit doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

entries.name: Heat Metal
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature wearing or holding a metal object. Hit: 9 (2d8) fire damage. If a creature is holding the object and suffers damage  it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw  dropping the object on a failure.

entries.name: Fire Breath
entries: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in the area makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw  taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Blazing Blood
entries: When the magmin takes damage that doesnt kill it, or when it is subjected to fire damage, its magma shell cracks and it is set ablaze. While ablaze, the magmin sheds bright light for 10 feet and dim light for an additional 10 feet. If the magmin is subjected to cold damage while ablaze, this flame is extinguished. The magmin can also set itself ablaze or extinguish itself as an action.

entries.name: Death Burst
entries: If the magmin dies while ablaze, it explodes in a burst of magma. Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save. Unattended flammable objects in the area are ignited.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: A magmin doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) fire damage. If the magmin is ablaze and the target is a creature  it suffers 5 (1d10) ongoing fire damage until a creature takes an action to extinguish the flame on the target.

entries.name: Spurt Magma (Ablaze Only)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) fire damage.

entries.name: Cloaked Mind
entries: When subjected to a divination effect that detects fiends or alignment, the malcubus makes a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a success, the malcubuss nature is not detected.

entries.name: Evil
entries: The malcubus radiates an Evil aura.

entries.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: The malcubus can communicate telepathically with a charmed creature over any distance, even on a different plane of existence.

entries.name: Claw (Malcubus Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Charm
entries: The malcubus targets one humanoid on the same plane of existence within 30 feet  forcing it to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is magically charmed for 1 day or until the malcubus charms another creature. The charmed creature obeys the malcubuss commands. The creature repeats the saving throw whenever it takes damage or if it receives a suicidal command. If a creatures saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it  it is immune to any malcubuss Charm for 24 hours.

entries.name: Draining Kiss
entries: The malcubus kisses a willing or charmed creature. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw  taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. The targets hit point maximum is reduced by the same amount until it finishes a long rest  and the malcubus regains hit points equal to the same amount. If the target is charmed by the malcubus  the charm ends.

entries.name: Etherealness
entries: The malcubus magically travels to the Ethereal Plane. While on the Ethereal Plane  the malcubus can see and hear into the Material Plane and can choose to make itself audible and hazily visible to creatures on the Material Plane. If a humanoid on the Material Plane invites the malcubus to do so  the malcubus can use an action to magically travel from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane.

entries.name: Dream
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane  the malcubus magically touches a sleeping humanoid that is not protected by a magic circle or protection from evil and good spell or similar magic. While the touch persists  the malcubus appears in the creatures dreams. The creature can end the dream at any time. If the dream lasts for 1 hour  the target gains no benefit from the rest  and the malcubus can use Charm on the creature even if its on a different plane of existence.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The malcubus magically changes its form to a Medium or Small humanoid or into its true form. It can fly only in its true form. While shapeshifted, its statistics are unchanged except for its size and speed. Its equipment is not transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Living Shield
entries: When a creature the malcubus can see hits it with an attack, the malcubus can give an order to a creature charmed by it within 5 feet. The charmed creature uses its reaction, if available, to swap places with the malcubus. The attack hits the charmed creature instead of the malcubus.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10+7) piercing damage. If the elephant moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 18 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10+7) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Trample
entries: The mammoth makes a stomp attack against a prone creature.

entries.name: Trunk Fling
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d6+7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pushed 10 feet away from the mammoth and knocked prone.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The manticore attacks with its bite and its claws.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. If the manticore moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Tail Spike Volley
entries: The manticore fires tail spikes in a 5-foot-wide  60-foot-long line. Each creature in the area makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Tail Whip
entries: If a creature the manticore can see hits it with a melee attack, the manticore attacks the attacker with its tail. If it hits, it can fly up to half its fly speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the attacker.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The marid can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The marids innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: alter self (can assume Medium or Large form), create or destroy water, detect magic, purify food and drink, 3/day each: control water, creation, tongues, water breathing, water walk, 1/day each: conjure elemental (water elemental only), plane shift (to Elemental Plane of Water only)

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The marid makes two trident attacks. One of these can be replaced with a net attack.

entries.name: Trident
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage. If thrown  the trident returns to the marids hand.

entries.name: Net
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one target. Hit: A Large  Medium  or Small target is restrained until it is freed. A creature can use its action to make a DC 18 Strength check  freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. The net is an object with AC 10  20 hit points  vulnerability to slashing damage  and immunity to bludgeoning  poison  and psychic damage.

entries.name: Fog Cloud
entries: The marid magically creates a heavily obscured area of fog (or, if underwater, inky water) in a 30-foot radius around a point it can see within 60 feet. The fog spreads around corners and can be dispersed by a moderate wind or current (at least 10 miles per hour). Otherwise, it disperses after 10 minutes. The marid can see through this fog.

entries.name: Water Jet (While Bloodied)
entries: The marid shoots water in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long jet. Each creature in the area makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and is pushed 20 feet away from the marid, to a maximum of 60 feet away, and knocked prone. On a success, a target takes half damage.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The marilith makes six attacks with its longswords.

entries.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19).

entries.name: Teleport
entries: The marilith magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

entries.name: Reactive Teleport
entries: When the marilith is hit or missed by a ranged attack, it uses Teleport. If it teleports within 5 feet of a creature, it can attack with its tail.

entries.name: Crossbow Expert
entries: The master assassin ignores the loading quality of light crossbows, and being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesnt impose disadvantage on the master assassins ranged attack rolls.

entries.name: Deadly Poison
entries: As part of making an attack, the master assassin can apply a deadly poison to their weapons (included below). The master assassin carries 3 doses of this poison. A single dose can coat two melee weapons or up to 10 pieces of ammunition.

entries.name: Death Strike
entries: When the master assassin scores a critical hit against a living creature that is surprised, that creature makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is reduced to 0 hit points. The creature dies if it fails two death saves before it stabilizes.

entries.name: Epic Assassinate
entries: During the first turn of combat, the master assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasnt acted. Any hit the master assassin scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit, and every creature that can see the master assassins attack is rattled until the end of the master assassins next turn.

entries.name: Evasion
entries: When the master assassin makes a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a success, they take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

entries.name: Sneak Attack
entries: The master assassin deals an extra 28 (8d6) damage when they hit with a weapon attack while they have advantage on the attack, or when the master assassins target is within 5 feet of an ally of the master assassin while the master assassin doesnt have disadvantage on the attack.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The master assassin attacks twice.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw  taking 17 (5d6) poison damage on a failure  or half as much damage on a success.

entries.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw  taking 17 (5d6) poison damage on a failure  or half as much damage on a success.

entries.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: When a creature starts its turn within 60 feet of the medusa and can see the medusas eyes, it can choose to shut its eyes until the beginning of its next turn unless it is surprised or incapacitated. Otherwise, the medusa uses its petrifying gaze on the creature. If the medusa sees its own reflection and doesnt shut its eyes, it is subject to its own gaze.

entries.name: A creature subject to the medusas petrifying gaze makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw
entries: If it rolls a natural 1 on the save, it is petrified instantly. If it otherwise fails the save, it is restrained as it begins to be petrified. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on itself on a success and becoming petrified on a failure. The petrification can be removed with greater restoration or similar powerful magic.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The medusa makes any combination of two attacks with its snake hair and longbow.

entries.name: Snake Hair
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage  plus an additional 3 (1d6) piercing damage if the target is a creature that is surprised or that can't see the medusa.

entries.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

The petrification can be removed with greater restoration or similar powerful magic.

entries.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

entries.name: The medusa queen has one legendary action it can take at the end of another creatures turn
entries: The medusa queen regains the spent legendary action at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Hide
entries: The medusa moves up to half its Speed and hides.

entries.name: Snake Hair
entries: The medusa uses Snake Hair.

entries.name: Frenzy of Snakes (1/Day
entries: The medusa uses Snake Hair on each creature within 5 feet.

entries.name: Imperious Command
entries: A creature with averted or covered eyes within 60 feet that can hear the medusa makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it looks at the medusa, making itself the target of Petrifying Gaze if it and the medusa can see each other. On a success, the creature is immune to Imperious Command for 24 hours. This is a charm effect.

entries.name: Panicked Rage
entries: While a merclops is frightened and the source of its fear is in sight, it makes attack rolls with advantage instead of disadvantage.

entries.name: Poor Depth Perception
entries: The merclops makes all ranged attacks with disadvantage.

entries.name: Aquatic
entries: The merclops can breathe underwater.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The merclops makes two melee attacks.

entries.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Harpoon
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 90 ft. (see Poor Depth Perception)  one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the merclops pulls the target up to 30 feet toward the merclops.

entries.name: Thick Skulled
entries: The merclops can end one condition on itself that was imposed through a failed Wisdom saving throw.

entries.name: Big Windup
entries: When a creature hits the merclops with a melee attack, the merclops readies a powerful strike against its attacker. The merclops has advantage on the next club attack it makes against the attacker before the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Lance (Mounted Only)

This attack is made at disadvantage against targets within 5 feet of the knight.

entries.name: Knightly Inspiration
entries: The knight inspires creatures of its choice within 30 feet that can hear and understand it. For the next minute  inspired creatures gain an expertise die on attack rolls and saving throws. A creature can benefit from only one Knightly Inspiration at a time  and the knight cannot target itself.

entries.name: Regeneration

entries.name: Bite

entries.name: Mage Bolt
entries: The mage targets a creature within 30 feet. The target makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) lightning damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The mage changes its form to that of a Medium merfolk or back into its true form. While shapeshifted, it can't use its Bite attack but its statistics are otherwise unchanged except for its size. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Darkness (2nd-Level; V
entries: Magical darkness spreads from a point within 60 feet of the mage, filling a 15-foot-radius sphere and spreading around corners. It remains for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

entries.name: Invisibility (2nd-Level; V
entries: The mage is invisible for 1 hour or until it attacks, uses Mage Bolt, or casts a spell.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While the mimic is motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate object.

entries.name: Sticky
entries: A creature, object, or weapon that touches the mimic is stuck to the mimic. A creature can use an action to make a DC 14 Strength check, freeing itself or an object or creature within reach on a success. The effect also ends when the mimic chooses to end it or when the mimic dies.

entries.name: Telepathic Sense
entries: A mimic telepathically senses the presence of humanoids within 120 feet and gains a mental image of any inanimate object desired by any of the creatures it senses. This ability is blocked by 3 feet of wood or dirt, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or a thin sheet of lead.

entries.name: Water Soluble
entries: If the mimic is splashed with at least 1 gallon of water, it assumes its true form and the DC to escape its Sticky trait is reduced to 10 until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes a bite attack and a pseudopod attack.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and the target is subjected to the mimics Sticky trait.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature stuck to the mimic. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage  and the target is restrained until it is no longer stuck to the mimic. While a creature is restrained by the mimic  the mimic can't bite a different creature.

entries.name: Swallow
entries: The mimic makes a bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature restrained by it. If the attack hits and the mimic has not swallowed another creature  the target is swallowed and no longer stuck to the mimic. A swallowed creature has total cover from attacks from outside the mimic  is blinded and restrained  and takes 5 (2d4) acid damage at the start of each of the mimics turns.

entries.name: If a swallowed creature deals 10 or more damage to the mimic in a single turn, or if the mimic dies, the target falls prone in an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the mimic and is no longer swallowed
Shapeshift
entries: The mimic changes its form to resemble an inanimate object of its approximate size or changes into its true form, which is an amorphous blob. Objects it is carrying or stuck to are not transformed. While shapeshifted, its statistics are unchanged. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: The minotaur can perfectly recall any route it has traveled.

entries.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage. The minotaur can choose to make the attack with advantage. If it does so  attacks against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the attack deals an extra 9 (2d8) damage  and the target makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  being pushed up to 10 feet away and falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Roar of Triumph
entries: If the minotaur reduced a living creature to 0 hit points since the end of its last turn, it roars and gains 10 (3d6) temporary hit points.

entries.name: Vicious Mockery (Cantrip; V)
entries: A creature within 60 feet that can hear the minstrel makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and has disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Invisibility (2nd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration)
entries: The minstrel or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the invisible creature attacks or casts a spell.

entries.name: Shatter (2nd-Level; V, S, M)
entries: An ear-splitting ringing sound fills a 10-foot-radius sphere emanating from a point the minstrel can see within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw  taking 13 (3d8) thunder damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. A creature made of stone  metal  or other inorganic material has disadvantage on its saving throw. Unattended objects in the area also take the damage.

entries.name: Hypnotic Pattern (3rd-Level; S, M, Concentration)
entries: A swirling pattern of light appears at a point within 120 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of the pattern that can see it makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  the creature is incapacitated and its Speed is 0. The effect ends on a creature if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it out of its daze.

entries.name: Martial Encouragement
entries: Until the beginning of the minstrels next turn, one creature within 30 feet that can hear the minstrel deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage whenever it deals weapon damage.

entries.name: Healing Word (1st-Level; V)
entries: The minstrel or a living creature within 60 feet regains 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points. The minstrel can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

entries: The mirage monster makes a pseudopod attack with a range of 15 feet. On a hit, the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is pulled up to 15 feet towards the mirage monster.

entries.name: Bite
entries: The mirage monster attacks with its bite.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The mirage monster can take 2 legendary actions: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Death Transformation
entries: When a goblin king is slain,whichever goblin killed them will suddenly transforminto a new goblin king (or queen), their stats replacedwith the goblin kings stats. All surrounding goblinsare inclined thereafter to obey the new goblin king.If a goblin king is slain by a non-goblinoid creature,whichever goblin volunteers for the position first isthe one transformed. Goblins are extremely hesitantto do such a thing, as responsibility and stewardshipare such hard work.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Charm Person
entries: Once per day the goblin king can castcharm personas a 3rd-level spell  allowing him tocharm three creatures within 60 feet. The goblinkings spell save DC is 14.

entries.name: Parry
entries: The goblin king adds 2 to his AC against onemelee attack that would hit him. To do this the goblinking must see the attacker and be wielding a meleeweapon.

entries.name: Brave
entries: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

entries.name: Steadfast
entries: When a defender would be pushed, pulled, or knocked prone, they are not knocked prone, and the distance of any push or pull is reduced by 10 feet.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The defender attacks twice with their warhammer.

entries.name: Warhammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Lance (Mounted Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage. If the knight moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  they deal an extra 6 (1d12) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. This attack is made at disadvantage against targets within 5 feet.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Knightly Inspiration
entries: The knight inspires creatures of their choice within 30 feet that can hear and understand them. For the next minute  inspired creatures gain an expertise die (1d4) on attack rolls and saving throws. A creature can benefit from only one Knightly Inspiration at a time  and the knight cannot target themselves.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The knight captain has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Superior Heavy Armor Master
entries: While wearing heavy armor, the knight captain reduces bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage they take from nonmagical weapons by 5.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The mountain dwarf lord attacks four times with their battleaxe.

entries.name: Battleaxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage.

entries.name: Composite Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Command the Attack
entries: The knight captain issues a command to all nonhostile creatures within 30 feet. Creatures who can see or hear the knight captain can use their reaction to make a single weapon attack with advantage.

entries.name: Knightly Inspiration
entries: The knight captain inspires creatures of their choice within 30 feet that can hear and understand them. For the next minute  inspired creatures gain an expertise die (1d4) on attack rolls and saving throws. A creature can benefit from only one Knightly Inspiration at a time  and the knight captain cannot target themselves.

entries.name: Shield Block
entries: When a creature attacks the mountain dwarf lord or a target within 5 feet, the mountain dwarf lord imposes disadvantage on that attack. To do so, the mountain dwarf lord must see the attacker and be wielding a shield.

entries.name: Handaxe
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage  or 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage if within 5 feet of an ally that is not incapacitated.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Tactical Movement
entries: Until the end of the soldiers turn, their Speed is halved and their movement doesnt provoke opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The mule is considered Large when calculating its carrying capacity.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) bludgeoning damage.

name: Mummy
languages: the languages it knew in life

entries.name: Flammable
entries: After taking fire damage, the mummy catches fire and takes 5 (1d10) ongoing fire damage if it isnt already suffering ongoing fire damage. A creature can use an action to extinguish this fire.

entries.name: Curse: Mummy Rot
entries: A mummys touch inflicts a dreadful curse called mummy rot. A cursed creature can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the creatures total number of Hit Dice for every 24 hours that elapse. If this curse reduces the targets hit point maximum to 0, the target dies and crumbles to dust. Remove curse and similar magic ends the curse.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare and then attacks with its rotting fist.

entries.name: Dreadful Glare (Gaze)
entries: The mummy targets a creature within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically frightened until the end of the mummys next turn. If the target fails the save by 5 or more  it is paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of mummies (but not mummy lords) for 24 hours.

entries.name: Rotting Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is cursed with Mummy Rot.

name: Mummy Lord
languages: the languages it knew in life

entries.name: Curse: Mummy Rot
entries: A mummys touch inflicts a dreadful curse called mummy rot. A cursed creature can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the creatures total number of Hit Dice for every 24 hours that elapse. If this curse reduces the targets hit point maximum to 0, the target dies and crumbles to dust. Remove curse and similar magic ends the curse.

entries.name: Flammable
entries: After taking fire damage, the mummy lord catches fire and takes 11 (2d10) ongoing fire damage if it isnt already suffering ongoing fire damage. A creature can use an action or legendary action to extinguish this fire.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the mummy lord fails a saving throw while wearing its scarab amulet, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, the scarab amulet shatters. The mummy lord can create a new amulet when it finishes a long rest.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mummy lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If its heart is intact, a destroyed mummy lord gains a new body in 1d4 days, regaining all its hit points. The new body forms within 10 feet of the heart.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The mummy lord is an 11th level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17
+9 to hit with spell attacks). The mummy lord has the following cleric spells prepared
which it can cast without material components:
Cantrips (at will): guidance
thaumaturgy
1st-level (4 slots): create or destroy water
detect magic
2nd-level (3 slots): augury
gentle repose
3rd-level (3 slots): animate dead
dispel magic
4th-level (3 slots): divination
guardian of faith
5th-level (2 slots): contagion
6th-level (1 slot): harm

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy lord uses Dreadful Glare and then attacks with its rotting fist.

entries.name: Dreadful Glare (Gaze)
entries: The mummy lord targets a creature within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is magically frightened until the end of the mummy lords next turn. If the target fails the save by 5 or more  it is paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of mummies and mummy lords for 24 hours.

entries.name: Rotting Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is cursed with Mummy Rot.

entries.name: Dispel Magic (3rd-Level; V, S)
entries: The mummy lord scours the magic from one creature  object  or magical effect it can see within 120 feet. A spell ends if it was cast with a 3rd-level or lower spell slot. For spells using a 4th-level or higher spell slot  the mummy lord makes a Wisdom ability check (DC 10 + the spells level) for each one  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Guardian of Faith (4th-Level; V)
entries: A Large  indistinct spectral guardian appears within an unoccupied space within 30 feet and remains for 8 hours. Creatures of the mummy lords choice that move to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw  taking 20 radiant or necrotic damage (mummy lords choice) on a failed save or half damage on a success. The spell ends when the guardian has dealt 60 total damage.

entries.name: Contagion (5th-Level; V, S)
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target contracts a flesh-rotting disease. It has disadvantage on Charisma ability checks and becomes vulnerable to all damage. The target makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. After 3 failures  the target stops making saving throws and the disease lasts for 7 days. After 3 successes  the effect ends.

entries.name: Harm (6th-Level; V, S)
entries: The mummy lord targets a creature within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the creature is diseased  taking 49 (14d6) necrotic damage. Its hit point maximum is reduced by the same amount for 1 hour or until the effect is removed with a spell that removes diseases. On a successful save  the creature takes half the damage. The spells damage can't reduce a target to less than 1 hit point.

entries.name: Blasphemous Counterspell
entries: When the mummy lord is targeted by a spell using a 4th-level or lower spell slot, the attacker makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the spell is wasted, and the caster takes 3 (1d6) necrotic damage per level of the spell slot.

entries.name: Channel Negative Energy
entries: A 60-foot-radius aura of magical negative energy surrounds the mummy lord until the end of its next turn, spreading around corners. Creatures in the aura can't regain hit points.

entries.name: Whirlwind of Sand
entries: The mummy lord, along with its equipment, magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand and moves up to 60 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, and then reverts to its normal form.

entries.name: Attack
entries: The mummy lord uses Dreadful Glare or attacks with its rotting fist.

entries.name: Blasphemous Word
entries: Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear its magical imprecation makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is stunned until the end of the mummy lords next turn.

entries.name: Dispel Magic
entries: The mummy lord casts dispel magic.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The mummy lord can take 3 legendary actions: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The worm can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Locate Mind
entries: The worm is aware of the location and relative intelligence of all creatures with Intelligence scores greater than 3 within 500 feet.

entries.name: Maddening Murmurs
entries: The worm babbles constantly. A non-aberrant creature that starts its turn within 30 feet and can hear its murmurs makes a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is confused until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm constricts once and attacks once with its bite.

entries.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained while grappled.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is killed by this attack  the worm eats its head.

entries.name: Mental Summons
entries: One creature with an Intelligence score greater than 3 within 120 feet makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it uses its reaction to move up to its Speed towards the worm by the shortest route possible, avoiding hazards but not opportunity attacks. This is a magical charm effect.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The naiad has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Speak with Nature
entries: The naiad can communicate with beasts and plants.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The naiad can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Watery Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). While grappling a creature this way  the naiad can't use Watery Grasp on a different target and can swim at full speed.

entries.name: Chaotic Evil
entries: The nalfeshnee radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The nalfeshnee has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The nalfeshnee makes a bite attack and a claws attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage. If it uses its bite on a dead  non-demon creature  it regains 27 (5d10) hit points and recharges its Horror Nimbus. It may gain this benefit only once per creature.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Chaos Blast
entries: Beams of multicolored light arc through a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 90 feet. Each creature in the area that does not have a Chaotic alignment makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw  taking 52 (8d12) force damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Horror Nimbus
entries: The nalfeshnee glows with an unholy, multicolored radiance. Each creature within 15 feet of the nalfeshnee that can see it makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature is frightened for 1minute. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Teleport
entries: The nalfeshnee magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

entries.name: Spellcasting

+6 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt
light
mage hand
prestidigitation
1st-level (4 slots): detect magic
identify
mage armor
shield
2nd-level (3 slots): alter self
misty step
3rd-level (3 slots): animate dead
counterspell
fireball
4th-level (3 slots): dimension door
greater invisibility
