entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip; V, S)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage.

entries.name: Fireball (3rd-Level; V, S, M)
entries: Fire streaks from the mage to a point within 120 feet and explodes in a 20-foot radius  spreading around corners. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Dimension Door (4th-Level; V)
entries: The mage teleports to a location within 500 feet. They can bring along one willing Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. If a creature would teleport to an occupied space  it takes 14 (4d6) force damage  and the spell fails.

entries.name: Greater Invisibility (4th-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The mage or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 minute.

entries.name: Cone of Cold (5th-Level; V, S, M)
entries: Frost blasts from the mage in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw  taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Misty Step (2nd-Level; V)
entries: The mage teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet. The mage can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

entries.name: Counterspell (3rd-Level; S)
entries: When a creature the mage can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the mage attempts to interrupt it. If the creature is casting a 2nd-level spell or lower, the spell fails. If the creature is casting a 3rd-level or higher spell, the mage makes an Intelligence check against a DC of 10 + the spells level. On a success, the spell fails, and the spellcasting creature can use its reaction to try to cast a second spell with the same casting time so long as it uses a spell slot level equal to or less than half the original spell slot. If the mage casts counterspell with a higher spell slot, the interrupted spell fails if its level is less than that of counterspell.

entries.name: Shield (1st-Level; V
entries: When the mage is hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile, they gain a +5 bonus to AC (including against the triggering attack) and immunity to magic missile. These benefits last until the start of their next turn.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature touched by the hags claws is magically cursed for 30 days. While under this curse, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls made against the hag.

entries.name: Evil
entries: The hag radiates an Evil aura.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage  and the target is subject to the hags Curse trait.

entries.name: Sleep Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target falls asleep for 4 hours or until it takes damage or is shaken awake. Once the hag successfully hits a target  it can't make this attack again until it finishes a long rest.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The hag magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid. Equipment it is carrying isnt transformed. It retains its claws in any form. It has no true form and remains in its current form when it dies.

entries.name: Planar Travel
entries: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane  or vice versa. Alternatively  the hag is magically transported to the Material Plane  Hell  or the Abyss  arriving within 10 miles of its desired destination.

entries.name: Nightmare Haunting
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane  the hag magically touches a sleeping creature that is under the night hags Curse and is not protected by a magic circle or protection from evil and good spell or similar magic. As long as the touch persists  the target has terrible nightmares. If the nightmares last for 1 hour  the target gains no benefit from the rest  and its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10) until the curse ends. If this effect reduces the targets hit points maximum to 0  the target dies and the hag captures its soul. The reduction to the targets hit point maximum lasts until removed by greater restoration or similar magic.

entries.name: Evil
entries: The nightmare radiates an Evil aura.

entries.name: Fiery Hooves
entries: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The nightmare leaves charred hoofprints.

entries.name: Fire Resistance
entries: The nightmare can grant fire resistance to a rider.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. The nightmare can move through the space of a prone creature as long as it does not end its turn there.

entries.name: Ethereal Shift
entries: The nightmare and a rider magically pass from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane or vice versa.

entries.name: Opposite Nature
entries: Normal damage heals the nilbogfor the amount done. Nilbogs can only be harmed/damaged by healing magic. Their skin resists all otherforms of harm. Potions of healing deal acid damage toa nilbog equal to the amount of hit points they wouldnormally heal, and spells that restore hit pointsinstead deal necrotic damage.

entries.name: Rat flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (3d4 + 1) bludgeoning or piercing damage.

entries.name: Fetid sling
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3(1d6) bludgeoning damage  and the target must make a DC 14 Constitutionsaving throw. On a failure  the target is poisoned for 1minute.

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Parry
entries: If the noble is wielding a melee weapon and can see their attacker, they add 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: The jelly can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The jelly can use its climb speed even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the jelly has disadvantage on attack rolls.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: An ooze doesnt require air or sleep.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). A grappled target takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of the jellys turns.

entries.name: Split
entries: When a Medium or larger jelly with at least 10 hit points is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two jellies that are each one size smaller, freeing any grappled targets. Each new jelly has half the originals hit points (rounded down).

entries.name: Camouflage
entries: The octopus has advantage on Stealth checks.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: The octopus breathes water and can hold its breath for 30 minutes while in air.

entries.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained  and the octopus can't attack a different target with its tentacles.

entries.name: Ink Cloud
entries: If underwater, the octopus exudes a cloud of ink in a 5-foot-radius sphere, extending around corners. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute unless dispersed by a strong current.

entries.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Sweeping Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.  all creatures within 5 feet. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 10 feet away from the ogre.

entries.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the zombie is reduced to 0 hit points by damage that isnt radiant or from a critical hit, its instead reduced to 1 hit point, falls prone, and is stunned until the end of its next turn, appearing to be dead.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: A zombie doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Sweeping Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.  all creatures within 5 feet. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 10 feet away from the ogre.

entries.name: Grab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled if its Medium or smaller (escape DC 14)  and until the grapple ends  the zombie can't grab another target.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target grappled by a zombie. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage  and the zombie regains hit points equal to the damage dealt

entries.name: Bodyblock
entries: If the ogre flesh heap is grappling a creature when it is hit with a weapon attack by a creature it can see, it uses the creature as a shield, adding 2 to its AC against the attack. If this causes the attack to miss, the attack hits the grappled creature instead.

entries.name: Corpulent Expulsion (Recharge 6
entries: When it takes damage, the ogre flesh heaps belly splits and releases a torrent of caustic gore in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in this area make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) acid damage on a failure and half damage on a success. The flesh heap then takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The ogres innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: darkness, invisibility, 1/day: charm person, cone of cold, gaseous form, hold person

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The ogre makes two melee attacks.

entries.name: Claw (Ogre Mage Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Iron Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage  or 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage in Small or Medium form. When the ogre hits or touches a target with its club  it can end any spell on the target that was cast with a 3rd-level or lower spell slot.

entries.name: Read Scroll
entries: The ogre casts a spell from a magical scroll without expending the scrolls magic.

entries.name: Darkness (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: Magical darkness spreads from a point within 30 feet of the ogre  filling a 15-foot-radius sphere and spreading around corners. It remains for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness  and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

entries.name: Hold Person (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: One humanoid the ogre can see within 60 feet makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute  repeating the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Invisibility (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The ogre is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the ogre attacks or casts a spell.

entries.name: Gaseous Form (3rd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The ogre and its gear becomes a hovering cloud of gas for 1 hour. Its Speed is 0  and its fly speed is 30. It can't attack  use or drop objects  talk  or cast spells. It can enter another creatures space and pass through small holes and cracks but can't pass through liquid. It is resistant to nonmagical damage  has advantage on Strength  Dexterity and Constitution saving throws  and can't fall.

entries.name: Cone of Cold (5th-Level; V, S)
entries: Frost blasts from the ogre in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw  taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The ogre changes its form into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form, which is a Large giant. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Its iron club, armor, and clothing change size with it. It reverts to its true form when it dies.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the zombie is reduced to 0 hit points by damage that isnt radiant or from a critical hit, its instead reduced to 1 hit point, falls prone, and is stunned until the end of its next turn, appearing to be dead.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: A zombie doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

entries.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Sweeping Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.  all creatures within 5 feet. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 10 feet away from the ogre.

entries.name: Grab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled if its Medium or smaller (escape DC 14)  and until the grapple ends  the zombie can't grab another target.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target grappled by a zombie. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage  and the zombie regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

entries.name: Giant Build
entries: The ogrekin counts as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift. Its melee and thrown weapons deal an extra die of damage on a hit (included below).

entries.name: Battleaxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Handaxe
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Legend lore
entries: Once every 30 days, the orcish wilding minstrel can innately cast legend lore with no material component.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The minstrel is a 5th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13
+5 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following bard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): light
mage hand
minor illusion
vicious mockery
1st-level (4 slots): charm person
disguise self
healing word
2nd-level (3 slots): enthrall
invisibility
shatter
3rd-level (2 slots): hypnotic pattern
major image

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Vicious Mockery (Cantrip; V)
entries: A creature within 60 feet that can hear the minstrel makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and has disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Invisibility (2nd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration)
entries: The minstrel or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the invisible creature attacks or casts a spell.

entries.name: Shatter (2nd-Level; V, S, M)
entries: An ear-splitting ringing sound fills a 10-foot-radius sphere emanating from a point the minstrel can see within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw  taking 13 (3d8) thunder damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. A creature made of stone  metal  or other inorganic material has disadvantage on its saving throw. Unattended objects in the area also take the damage.

entries.name: Hypnotic Pattern (3rd-Level; S, M, Concentration)
entries: A swirling pattern of light appears at a point within 120 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of the pattern that can see it makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  the creature is incapacitated and its Speed is 0. The effect ends on a creature if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it out of its daze.

entries.name: Martial Encouragement
entries: Until the beginning of the minstrels next turn, one creature within 30 feet that can hear the minstrel deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage whenever it deals weapon damage.

entries.name: Healing Word (1st-Level; V)
entries: The minstrel or a living creature within 60 feet regains 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points. The minstrel can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

entries.name: Many orc tribes use song to preserve a communal memory of history
entries: Minstrels are the keepers of the tribes wisdom and identity.

entries.name: Bloodied Frenzy
entries: While the berserker is bloodied, they make all attacks with advantage and all attacks against them are made with advantage.

entries.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: The berserkers AC equals 10 + their Dexterity modifier + their Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The berserker attacks twice.

entries.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Handaxe
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Aggressive Charge
entries: The urk moves up to their Speed towards an enemy they can see or hear.

entries.name: Warriors who fight on the front lines of an orc war horde gain a special title: urk, meaning doomed
entries:  Other orc warriors treat urks with the deference due the sacred nature of their rage and sacrifice.

name: Otyugh
languages: telepathy 120 ft. (can transmit but not receive thoughts and images)

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes two tentacle attacks.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained until the grapple ends. The otyugh has two tentacles  each of which can grapple one target and can't attack a different target while doing so.

entries.name: Tentacle Slam
entries: The otyugh slams any creatures it is grappling into a hard surface or into each other. Each creature makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  is stunned until the end of the otyughs next turn  and is pulled up to 5 feet towards the otyugh. On a success  the target takes half damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target contracts a disease. While diseased, the target is poisoned. The target repeats the saving throw every 24 hours, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure (to a minimum of 1 hit point) and becoming cured on a success. The reduction in hit points lasts until the disease is cured.

entries.name: Swallow
entries: If the otyugh has no other creature in its stomach, the otyugh bites a Medium or smaller creature that is stunned. On a hit, the creature is swallowed. A swallowed creature has total cover from attacks from outside the otyugh, is blinded and restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the otyugh's turns. If a swallowed creature deals 15 or more damage to the otyugh in a single turn, or if the otyugh dies, the otyugh vomits up the creature.

entries.name: Flyby
entries: The owl doesnt provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of a creatures reach.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The owl has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing and sight.

entries.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage. If this damage would reduce a Small or larger target to 0 hit points  the target takes no damage from this attack.

entries.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight or smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear attacks with its beak and claws.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight or smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear attacks with its beak and claws.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The panther has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) slashing damage. If the panther moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 12 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Opportune Bite
entries: The panther makes a bite attack against a prone creature.

entries.name: Good
entries: The pegasus radiates a Good aura.

entries.name: Divine Mount
entries: Over the course of a short rest, a willing pegasus can form a bond with a rider. Once this bond is formed, the rider suffers no penalties for riding the pegasus without a saddle. Additionally, if an effect forces both the pegasus and its rider to roll a saving throw, the pegasus automatically succeeds if the rider succeeds. If the pegasus bonds with a new rider, the previous bond ends.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the pegasus moves at least 20 feet toward it before the attack  the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

name: Peryton
languages: understands Common and Sylvan but can't speak

entries.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The peryton has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight or smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The peryton attacks with its gore and talons.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 18  19  or 20. If this critical hit reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points  the peryton can use a bonus action to rip the targets heart out with its teeth  killing it.

entries.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage  or 10 (2d6 + 3) damage if the peryton moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack.

entries.name: Mirror Image
entries: A magical illusion cloaks the phase monster, creating a reflection of the monster nearby and concealing its precise location. While the monster is not incapacitated, attack rolls against it have disadvantage. When a creature hits the phase monster with an attack, this trait stops working until the end of the phase monsters next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The phase monster attacks with its horns and its claws.

entries.name: Horns
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature and the phase monster moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target takes an additional 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage and makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Claws (True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage  plus an additional 5 (2d4) slashing damage if the target is prone.

entries.name: Blood-Curdling Scream
entries: The phase monster unleashes a horrific screech. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is frightened for 1 minute. While frightened by Blood-Curdling Scream  a creature must take the Dash action and move away from the phase monster by the safest available route on each of its turns  unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesnt have line of sight to the phase monster  the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save  it is no longer frightened.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The phase monster magically changes its form to that of a Small goat or into its true form. While in goat form, it loses its fly speed and Mirror Image trait. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged in each form.

entries.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The spider can see into both the Material Plane and Ethereal Plane.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

entries.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions imposed by webs.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) piercing damage and the target makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points  the target is made stable but poisoned for 1 hour  even if it regains hit points  and it is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

entries.name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: The spider magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the piercer is indistinguishable from a normal stalactite.

entries.name: Pierce
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit  one target directly underneath the piercer. Hit: 10 (3d6) piercing damage. This attack has disadvantage against a creature that is protecting its head with a shield or similar object. If the attack misses  the piercer dies.

entries.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

entries.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

entries.name: Seawise
entries: Pirate captains have an expertise die (1d4) on skill checks made to handle or navigate a ship.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The bandit captain attacks twice with their scimitar and once with their dagger or throws two daggers.

entries.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 feet  one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Parry
entries: If the bandit captain is wielding a melee weapon and can see their attacker, they add 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them.

entries.name: Fear Aura
entries: A creature hostile to the pit fiend that starts its turn within 20 feet of it makes a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to this pit fiends Fear Aura for 24 hours.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The pit fiends spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect magic, fireball, 3/day each: hold monster, sending

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The pit fiend attacks with its bite and mace.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way  the target can't regain hit points and takes 21 (6d6) ongoing poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Mace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 15 feet away from the pit fiend and knocked prone.

entries.name: Circle of Fire
entries: A 15-foot-tall  1-foot-thick  20-foot-diameter ring of fire appears around the pit fiend  with the pit fiend at the center. The fire is opaque to every creature except the pit fiend. When the ring of fire appears  each creature it intersects makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw  taking 22 (5d8) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a successful one. A creature takes 22 (5d8) damage the first time each turn it enters the area or when it ends its turn there. The fire lasts 1 minute or until the pit fiend dismisses it  becomes incapacitated  or leaves its area.

entries.name: Fireball (3rd-Level; V, S)
entries: Fire streaks from the pit fiend to a point within 120 feet and explodes in a 20-foot radius  spreading around corners. Each creature in the area makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Hold Monster (5th-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: A creature within 60 feet that the pit fiend can see makes a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is paralyzed for 1 minute. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 22). While the target is grappled, the pit fiend can't use its claw against a different creature.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Fear Aura
entries: A creature hostile to the pit fiend that starts its turn within 20 feet of it makes a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to this pit fiends Fear Aura for 24 hours.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The pit fiends spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect magic, fireball, 3/day each: hold monster, sending

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The pit fiend attacks with its bite and mace.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way  the target can't regain hit points and takes 21 (6d6) ongoing poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Mace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 15 feet away from the pit fiend and knocked prone.

entries.name: Faerie Light
entries: As a bonus action, the pixie can cast dim light for 30 feet, or extinguish its glow.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pixie has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Thorn Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 10/30 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

entries.name: Faerie Blessing
entries: The pixie targets a willing creature within 30 feet. The target gains one of the following abilities for 1 hour:

entries.name: The target gains truesight out to a range of 120 feet
The target gains the benefit of the pixies Magic Resistance trait
Faerie Curse
entries: The pixie targets a creature within 30 feet not already under a Faerie Curse. The target makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is subjected to a special magical curse for 1 hour. The curse ends if the pixie dies or is incapacitated  the pixie or one of its allies deals damage to the target  or the pixie spends an action to end the curse. Spells such as remove curse  dispel magic  and lesser restoration also end the curse. If a creature makes its saving throw or the condition ends for it  it is immune to any Faerie Curse for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: When the target fails its saving throw against this effect, the pixie chooses one of the following effects to impose on the target
The target is charmed by the pixie
If the target is already charmed by the pixie, the target falls asleep
entries: It wakes if it is shaken awake as an action or if it takes damage.

entries.name: The targets head takes on the appearance of a beasts head (donkey, wolf, etc)
entries: The targets statistics dont change  but the target can no longer speak; it can only make animal noises.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: The pixie and any equipment it wears or carries magically turns invisible until the pixie attacks, casts a spell, becomes incapacitated, or uses a bonus action to become visible.

entries.name: Champion of Truth
entries: The planetar automatically detects lies. Additionally, it cannot lie.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The planetars spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). The planetar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 1/day each: commune, control weather, raise dead

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The planetar attacks twice with its flaming sword.

entries.name: Flaming Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) ongoing fire or radiant damage (the planetars choice). A creature can use an action to extinguish this holy flame on itself or a creature within 5 feet.

entries.name: Heavenly Bolt
entries: The planetar fires a lightning bolt in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw  taking 56 (16d6) lightning damage on a failed save  or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Heal
entries: The planetar touches a creature other than itself  magically healing 60 hit points of damage and ending any blindness  curse  deafness  disease  or poison on the target.

entries.name: Awe-Inspiring Gaze (Gaze)
entries: The planetar targets a creature within 90 feet. The target makes a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened until the end of its next turn. If the target makes its saving throw, it is immune to any angels Awe-Inspiring Gaze for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Protective Parry
entries: When a creature within 5 feet would be hit with a melee attack, the planetar applies disadvantage to the attack roll.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: The plesiosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pulled up to 5 feet towards the plesiosaurus.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage and the target makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw  taking 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two melee attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4+5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends  the bear can't attack a different target with its claws.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The priest is a 5th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13
+5 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): light
sacred flame
thaumaturgy
1st-level (4 slots): ceremony
detect evil and good
guiding bolt
healing word
2nd-level (3 slots): lesser restoration
zone of truth
3rd-level (2 slots): dispel magic
spirit guardians

entries.name: Mace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. On a hit  the priest can expend a spell slot to deal 7 (2d6) radiant damage  plus an extra 3 (1d6) radiant damage for each level of the spell slot expended above 1st.

entries.name: Sacred Flame (Cantrip; V, S)
entries: One creature the priest can see within 60 feet makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw  taking 9 (2d8) radiant damage on a failure. This spell ignores cover.

entries.name: Guiding Bolt (1st-Level; V, S)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) radiant damage  and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of the priests next turn has advantage.

entries.name: Dispel Magic (3rd-Level; V, S)
entries: The priest scours the magic from one creature  object  or magical effect within 120 feet that they can see. A spell ends if it was cast with a 3rd-level or lower spell slot. For spells using a 4th-level or higher spell slot  the priest makes a Wisdom ability check (DC 10 + the spells level) for each one  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Spirit Guardians (3rd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration)
entries: Spectral forms surround the priest in a 10-foot radius for 10 minutes. The priest can choose creatures they can see to be unaffected by the spell. Other creatures treat the area as difficult terrain  and when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there  it makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw  taking 10 (3d6) radiant or necrotic damage (priests choice) on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Healing Word (1st-Level; V)
entries: The priest or a living creature within 60 feet regains 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points. The priest can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

name: Pseudodragon
languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

entries.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The pseudodragon can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically to any creature within 10 feet of it.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pseudodragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Sting
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage  and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. At the end of its next turn  it repeats the saving throw. On a success  the effect ends. On a failure  it falls unconscious for 1 hour. If it takes damage  or a creature uses an action to shake it awake  it wakes up  and the effect ends.

entries.name: Telepathic Static
entries: The pseudodragon targets one creature it can see within 10 feet  forcing it to make a DC 11 Charisma saving throw. On a failure  its stunned until the end of its next turn as it suffers a barrage of telepathic imagery.

name: Pseudodragon Familiar
languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

entries.name: Familiar

entries.name: Flyby
entries: The pteranodon doesnt provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of a creatures reach.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: The pugilists AC equals 10 + their Dexterity modifier + their Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The pugilist attacks three times with their fists.

entries.name: Fists
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Haymaker
entries: The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

entries.name: Head Shot
entries: The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the target makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is stunned until the end of the pugilists next turn.

entries.name: Opportune Jab
entries: If a creature attempts to grapple the pugilist, the pugilist attacks that creature with their fists.

entries.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can tunnel through earth and solid rock, leaving behind a 10-foot-diameter tunnel.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm attacks two different targets with its bite and its tail stinger.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  the target is swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained  it has total cover from attacks from outside the worm  and it takes 24 (7d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worms turns.

entries.name: If a swallowed creature deals 35 or more damage to the worm in a single turn, or if the worm dies, the worm vomits up all swallowed creatures
Tail Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw  taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Fighting Retreat
entries: When a creature makes an opportunity attack on the worm, the worm attacks with either its bite or its tail stinger.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: When the hydra fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, its heads lose coordination. It is rattled until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiple Heads
entries: While the hydra has more than one head, it has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious, and it can't be flanked.

entries.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head it has, the hydra can take one reaction per round, but not more than one per turn.

entries.name: Regenerating Heads
entries: The hydra has seven heads. Whenever the hydra takes 30 or more damage in one turn, one of its heads dies. If all of its heads die, the hydra dies. At the end of its turn, it grows 2 heads for each head that was killed since its last turn, unless it has taken at least 20 cold damage since its last turn.

entries.name: Toxic Secretions
entries: Water within 1 mile of the hydras lair is poisoned. A creature other than the hydra that is immersed in the water or drinks the water makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for 24 hours. On a success, the creature is immune to this poison for 24 hours.

entries.name: Wakeful
entries: When some of the hydras heads are asleep, others are awake.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra bites once with each of its heads.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Fire Breath
entries: If the pyrohydra has at least 4 heads  it breathes fire in all directions. Each creature within 30 feet makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw  taking 59 (17d6) fire damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Rush
entries: The hydra moves or swims up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If this movement would pass through the space of creatures that are not incapacitated or prone, each creature makes a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature is knocked prone and the hydra can enter its space without treating it as difficult terrain. On a success, the hydra can't enter the creatures space, and the hydras movement ends. If this movement ends while the hydra is sharing a space with a creature, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

entries.name: Wrap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained until this grappled ends. The hydra can grapple one creature for each of its heads. When one of the hydras heads is killed while it is grappling a creature, the creature that killed the head can choose one creature to free from the grapple.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The hydra can take 2 legendary actions: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Magic Resistance

Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw  becoming poisoned for 1 minute on a failure. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Scare (Quasit Form Only)
entries: A creature within 20 feet that can see the quasit makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is frightened for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success. If a creature makes its saving throw or the condition ends for it  it is immune to any quasits Scare for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The quasit magically changes its form into a bat (speed 10 ft.  fly 40 ft.)  centipede (40 ft.  climb 40 ft.)  or toad (40 ft.  swim 40 ft.)  or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form except for its movement speeds. Equipment it is carrying is not transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: The quasit magically turns invisible, along with any equipment it carries. This invisibility ends if the quasit makes an attack, falls unconscious, or dismisses the effect.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: The quipper breathes only water.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage. On a hit  the quipper can use a bonus action to make a second bite attack.

resistances.name: bludgeoning and slashing from nonmagical weapons

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The rakshasas innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect magic, mage hand, major image, 3/day each: charm person, dominate person, fly (self only), invisibility (self only), locate person, modify memory, true seeing

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes two attacks.

entries.name: Claw (True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature  it is cursed. Whenever a cursed creature takes a long rest  it is troubled by terrible visions and dreams and gains no benefit from the rest. The curse can be lifted with remove curse and similar magic.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Sweet Promises
entries: The rakshasa targets a creature that can hear it within 60 feet  offering something the target covets. The target makes a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is charmed until the end of its next turn  and stunned while charmed in this way.

entries.name: Invisibility (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The rakshasa is invisible for 1 hour or until it attacks or casts a spell.

entries.name: Fly (3rd-Level; V, S, Concentration)
entries: The rakshasa gains a fly speed of 60 feet.

entries.name: Shapeshift
entries: The rakshasa magically changes its form to that of any Medium or Small humanoid or to its true form. While shapeshifted, its statistics are unchanged.

entries.name: Read Thoughts
entries: The rakshasa magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet that it can see. Until the end of the rakshasas turn, it has advantage on attack rolls and on Deception, Insight, Intimidation, and Persuasion checks against the creature.

entries.name: Quickened Spell
entries: The rakshasa casts invisibility or fly.

entries.name: Counterproposal
entries: The rakshasa uses Sweet Promises on a creature that attacked it or attempted to target it with a spell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The raptor has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the raptors allies is within 5 feet of the creature and not incapacitated.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: The rat has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries: The raven can imitate sounds it hears frequently, such as a simple phrase or an animal noise. Recognizing the sounds as imitation requires a DC 10 Insight check.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage. If this damage would reduce a Small or larger target to 0 hit points  the target takes no damage from this attack.

entries.name: Volcanic Tyrant
entries: The dragon is immune to the effects of poisonous gases caused by volcanic environments. It also ignores difficult terrain caused by lava.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Fire Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a blast of fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The shark has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the sharks allies is within 5 feet of the creature and not incapacitated.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: The shark breathes only water.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the remorhaz, touches it, or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, or 21 (6d6) fire damage if the remorhaz is bloodied. A creature can take this damage only once on a turn. If the remorhaz has been subjected to cold damage since the end of its last turn, this trait doesnt function.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The remorhaz makes a bite attack and then a constrict attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the remorhaz  the target is swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained  it has total cover from attacks from outside the remorhaz  and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the remorhazs turns.

entries.name: If a swallowed creature deals 30 or more damage to the remorhaz in a single turn, or if the remorhaz dies, the remorhaz vomits up all swallowed creatures
Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage  and the target is subjected to the remorhazs Heated Body trait. The target is grappled (escape DC 18) and restrained while grappled. The remorhaz can grapple three creatures at once.

entries.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the remorhaz, touches it, or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 3 (1d6) fire damage. A creature can take this damage only once on a turn. If the remorhaz has taken cold damage since the end of its last turn, this trait doesnt function.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The remorhaz makes a bite attack and then a constrict attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and the target is subjected to the remorhazs Heated Body trait. The target is grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained while grappled. Until this grapple ends  the remorhaz can't grapple another creature.

name: Revenant
languages: the languages it knew in life

entries.name: Fearsome Pursuit
entries: The revenant can spend 1 minute focusing on a creature against which it has sworn vengeance. If the creature is dead or on another plane of existence, it learns that. Otherwise, after focusing, it knows the distance and direction to that creature, and so long as its moving in pursuit of that creature, it ignores difficult terrain. This effect ends if the revenant takes damage or ends its turn without moving for any reason.
