entries: The triceratops makes two Gore attacks.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8+6) piercing damage.

entries.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 17 (2d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Warning Bugle
entries: The triceratops emits a piercing call in a 30-foot cone, signaling its impending attack. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. If the triceratops uses this bonus action before moving the requisite 20 feet for Trampling Charge, the target of its charge has disadvantage on this save, and the triceratops can make a Stomp attack against the prone target without needing to use a bonus action, provided the target fails the STR save from the charge.

entries.name: Giant Attributes
entries: The troll is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

entries.name: Heightened Smell
entries: The troll's Perception is 17 while perceiving by smell.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Ravenous Frenzy (52 HP or Fewer)
entries: Desperate for a meal as its injuries mount, the troll moves up to half its speed and makes one Bite attack against a creature it can see within range. The troll then regains HP equal to half the damage dealt.

entries.name: Hardy
entries: Any critical hit against the dinosaur becomes a normal hit.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The tyrannosaurus makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 31 (4d12+5) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tyrannosaurus can't Bite another target.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 23 (4d8+5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Rending Shake
entries: While grappling a creature, the tyrannosaurus shakes its head, tearing at the creature. The grappled creature must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or take 6 (1d12) slashing damage and be thrown up to 20 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If the thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 DEX save or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

entries.name: Celestial Resilience
entries: The unicorn is resistant to radiant damage.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unicorn has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

entries.name: Sense the Unnatural
entries: The unicorn can pinpoint the location of Aberrations and Undead within 60 feet of it.

entries.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The unicorn can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

entries.name: Woodland Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of nonmagical plants doesn't cost the unicorn extra movement. In addition, the unicorn can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Horn attack, or it makes two Horn Bolt attacks.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

entries.name: Horn Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6+3) radiant damage.

entries.name: Unicorn Magic
entries: The unicorn can cast the dancing lights and druidcraft cantrips at will, requiring no material components and using WIS as the spellcasting ability.

entries.name: Healing Touch
entries: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn. The target magically regains 11 (2d8+2) HP and is freed from all curses, diseases, and poisons afflicting it.

entries.name: Shimmering Shield
entries: When a creature the unicorn can see within 30 feet of it, including the unicorn, is attacked, the unicorn can surround it with a shimmering shield of radiant light. The target adds 3 to its AC against the attack.

entries.name: Canter
entries: The unicorn moves up to half is speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Radiant Stomp
entries: The unicorn raises its hooves glowing with golden light and brings them down with a reverberating stomp. Each hostile creature within 10 feet of the unicorn must make a DC 14 STR save. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) radiant damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

entries.name: Heal Self
entries: The unicorn magically regains 11 (2d8+2) HP.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The unicorn can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The unicorn regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Demonic Resilience
entries: The unska is resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unska has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The unska makes two Claw attacks and one Tongue attack, or it makes three Ink Blast attacks.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned, the target has disadvantage on saves against the unska's Whirl of Ink. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Tongue
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 CON save, or its HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum is reduced to 0.

entries.name: Ink Blast
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6+2) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or have disadvantage on the next save it makes against the unska's Whirl of Ink before the start of the unska's next turn.

entries.name: Whirl of Ink
entries: Tattoos leap off the unska's body and latch onto a creature the unska can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 WIS save or be charmed, disoriented, or frightened (the unska's choice) until the end of its next turn. When a disoriented creature moves, it moves in a random direction.

name: Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Hungry Dead Nature
entries: The vampire doesn't require air or sleep. In addition, it must consume at least 80 ounces of blood (approximately half the blood in a Medium Humanoid's body) every 24 hours, or it loses its immunity to exhaustion and risks starvation until it does so. While it has any levels of exhaustion from starvation, the vampire can't remove levels of exhaustion until it consumes at least 160 ounces of blood.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the vampire fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Misty Escape
entries: When it drops to 0 HP outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Mist Form bonus action) instead of falling unconscious, provided it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed. While it has 0 HP in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 HP. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 HP, it regains 1 HP.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 20 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

entries.name: Resting Place
entries: The vampire has a coffin, grave, sarcophagus, or similar location just large enough for it to lie down designated as its resting place. While in its resting place, the vampire doesn't suffer exhaustion levels from starvation and has keensense out to a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the following flaws:

entries.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

entries.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

entries.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is incapacitated in its resting place, the vampire is paralyzed until the stake is removed.

entries.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

entries.name: Vampiric Resilience
entries: The vampire is immune to exhaustion.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire can use Charm. It then makes three Bite or Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a Draining Bite attack. If two Claw attacks hit one Large or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

entries.name: Bite (Bat, Rat, or Wolf Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Claw (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Draining Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 9 (2d4+4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target's HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains HP equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then fed at least one drop of the vampire's blood rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

entries.name: Charm (Vampire Form Only)
entries:
One Humanoid the vampire can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 WIS save or be magically charmed for 1 day, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire takes a bonus action to end the effect. The charmed target obeys the vampire's verbal commands and is a willing target for the vampire's Draining Bite attack. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
The vampire can have up to two creatures charmed in this way at a time. If it charms a third, the effect on the first target ends.

entries.name: Children of the Night
entries: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call 3d6 wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The Beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action. The vampire can have any number of such Beasts under its control at one time, provided the combined total CR of the Beasts is no higher than 4.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: The vampire transforms into a Tiny bat, Tiny rat, Medium wolf, or back into its true form, which is Undead. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing transforms with it, but anything it is carrying doesn't transform with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Mist Form
entries: The vampire transforms into a Medium cloud of mist or back into its true form, which is Undead. While in mist form, it can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on STR, DEX, and CON saves, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

entries.name: Move
entries: The vampire moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Call Children
entries: The vampire uses Children of the Night.

entries.name: Excessive Bleeding
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the vampire that doesn't have all its HP must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or lose 14 (4d6) HP as its wounds bleed profusely. Before the end of its next turn, the vampire has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against a creature that failed this save.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The vampire can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The vampire regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

name: Vampire Spawn
languages: the languages it knew in life

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Hungry Dead Nature
entries: As the vampire.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire spawn regains 10 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

entries.name: Resting Place
entries: As the vampire.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: As the vampire.

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: As the vampire.

entries.name: Vampiric Resilience
entries: The vampire is immune to exhaustion.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire spawn makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a Draining Bite attack. If both Claw attacks hit one Large or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Draining Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains HP equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0.

entries.name: Call Blood
entries: The vampire calls to the blood within one injured creature it can see within 10 feet of it, causing blood to pour from the creature's wounds. If the target doesn't have all its HP, it must make a DC 14 CON save, losing 7 (2d6) HP on a failed save, or losing half as much HP on a successful one. Before the end of its next turn, the vampire has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against a creature that failed the save.

entries.name: Blood-Bound
entries: If the thrall has not consumed 1 ounce of blood from a vampire within the past week, it is poisoned for 1 week, and it loses darkvision and its Limited Regeneration, Spider Climb, and Sunlight Sensitivity traits until it consumes 1 ounce of vampire blood.

entries.name: Limited Regeneration
entries: The thrall regains 2 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP and isn't in sunlight. If the thrall takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the thrall's next turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The thrall can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the thrall has disadvantage on attack rolls, and its Perception is 8 when perceiving by sight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire thrall makes two Rapier attacks.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Repay the Gift
entries: When a friendly vampire the thrall can see within 5 feet of it is hit by an attack that would reduce the vampire to 0 HP, the thrall can give some of its life force to save the vampire. The thrall loses 10 (3d6) HP, and the vampire regains HP equal to that amount.

entries.name: Hardy
entries: Any critical hit against the dinosaur becomes a normal hit.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The velociraptor has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the target and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The velociraptor makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the velociraptor can't Bite another target.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Maul
entries: The velociraptor uses its claws to rip into one creature it is grappling. The target must make a DC 12 STR save, taking 10 (4d4) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The veteran makes two Longsword attacks and two Shortsword attacks, or it makes three Longsword attacks.

entries.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10+3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Shoulder
entries: The veteran shoves a creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Parry
entries: The veteran adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the veteran must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While the violet fungus remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.

entries.name: Plant Resilience
entries: The violet fungus is resistant to exhaustion and to the paralyzed, petrified, and unconscious conditions.

entries.name: Rotting Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (2d4) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Necrotic Spores (8 HP or Fewer)
entries: The violet fungus sends out a burst of necrotic-laced spores, rapidly rotting nearby flesh. Each creature within 10 feet of the violet fungus that isn't a Construct must make a DC 10 CON save, taking 5 (2d4) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Virtuoso Lich
languages: Common plus up to two other languages

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the lich fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its HP and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

entries.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The lich has advantage on saves against any effect that turns undead.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: The lich doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Undead Resilience
entries: The lich is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

entries.name: Versatile Artist
entries: At the end of each long rest, the lich chooses one form of artistic expression, such as song, poetry, dance, fashion, paint, or similar. Until it finishes a long rest, the lich has immunity to one type of damage, which is associated with its artistic expression. For example, a lich expressing art through song or poetry has immunity to thunder damage, a lich expressing art through fashion has immunity to slashing damage, and a lich expressing art through paint has immunity to acid damage. This trait can't give the lich immunity to force, psychic, or radiant damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The virtuoso lich uses Corrupted Art. It then makes three Artistic Flourish attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

entries.name: Artistic Flourish
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8+5) damage of the type chosen with the Versatile Artist trait plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

entries.name: Call Muse
entries: The lich chooses one Beast or Humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it to be its muse. The target must succeed on a DC 17 WIS save or become the lich's muse and be charmed by the lich for 1 minute. While charmed, the muse has a speed of 0 and is incapacitated as it watches or listens to the lich's artistic expression. The muse can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's save is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the lich's Call Muse for the next 24 hours. If the muse suffers harm from the lich, it is no longer charmed. The lich can have only one muse at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous muse ends. If the lich is within 30 feet of its muse and can see its muse, the lich has advantage on its first Artistic Flourish attack each round against a creature that isn't its muse.

entries.name: Corrupted Art
entries:
The lich hums a discordant melody, paints a crumbling symbol of death in the air, performs a reality-bending pirouette, or emulates some other expression of corrupted or twisted art and targets one creature it can see, other than itself, within 60 feet. This action's effects change, depending on if the target is Undead.
- Non-Undead. The target must make a DC 17 WIS save. On a failure, a creature is blinded, charmed, or deafened (the lich's choice) until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated.
- Undead. The target regains 18 (4d8) HP. Healing that exceeds the target's HP maximum becomes temporary HP.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries:
The lich casts one of the following spells, using CHA as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).
At will: disguise self, mage hand, message, prestidigitation
3/day each: charm, hideous laughter, hold, invisibility (self only)
2/day each: dispel magic, fear, dimension door
1/day each: irresistible dance, programmed illusion, seeming

entries.name: Call Muse
entries: The lich uses Call Muse.

entries.name: Move
entries: The lich moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Cast a Spell
entries: The lich uses Spellcasting.

entries.name: Unrestrained Art
entries: The lich unleashes the full force of its artistic talents. Each creature with 15 feet of the lich must make a DC 17 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 9 (2d8) damage of the type chosen with the Versatile Artist trait and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

systemExtras.legendaryPreamble: The virtuoso lich can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The lich regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Demonic Resilience
entries: The vrock is resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The vrock has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The vrock makes one Beak attack and two Talon attacks.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Talon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10+3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Wing Spores
entries: The vrock shakes a cloud of toxic spores from its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 15 CON save. On a failure, a creature takes 28 (8d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. While poisoned, a creature takes 3 (1d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Emptying a vial of holy water on the poisoned creature also ends the effect on it.

entries.name: Startling Screech
entries: The vrock emits a horrific screech at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or be able to take either an action or bonus action on its turn, not both, and it can't take reactions.

entries.name: Carrion Sense
entries: The vulture can pinpoint, by scent, the location of carrion, dead creatures, and Undead without the Incorporeal Movement trait within 60 feet of it.

entries.name: Heightened Sight and Smell
entries: The vulture's Perception is 18 when perceiving by sight or smell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The vulture has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Defensive Bile
entries: When a creature the vulture can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the vulture can spit partially digested carrion at the creature. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 CON save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Carrion Sense
entries: The vulture can pinpoint, by scent, the location of carrion, dead creatures, and Undead without the Incorporeal Movement trait within 60 feet of it.

entries.name: Heightened Sight and Smell
entries: The vulture's Perception is 18 when perceiving by sight or smell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The vulture has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The vulture makes one Beak attack and one Talons attack.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Defensive Bile
entries: When a creature the vulture can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the vulture can spit partially digested carrion at the creature. The attacker must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or take 5 (2d4) acid damage and be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While the war horse skeleton remains motionless and prone, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate war horse skeleton.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: The skeleton doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Undead Resilience
entries: The skeleton is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Counterattack
entries: When a creature the war horse skeleton can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the skeleton can make one Hooves attack against the attacker.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The elemental doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Elemental Resilience
entries: The elemental is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, and unconscious conditions.

entries.name: Freeze
entries: If the elemental takes cold damage, it partially freezes, and its speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Purify Water
entries: If the water elemental sits in a body of slow-flowing or standing water, such as a spring, small creek, or lake, for at least 1 hour, the water becomes purified and rendered free of poison and disease. In slow-flowing water, this purification fades 1 hour after the elemental leaves the water. In standing water, this purification lasts until a contaminant enters the water while the elemental isn't in it.

entries.name: Water Form
entries: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries.name: Water Camouflage
entries: The water elemental's Stealth is 17 while in a Medium or larger body of water.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The water elemental makes two Water Tendril or Water Bolt attacks. If both Water Tendril attacks hit one creature, it can use Whelm on the target, if available.

entries.name: Water Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8+4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is Large or smaller. The water elemental can have up to three targets grappled at a time.

entries.name: Water Bolt
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (4d6+2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Whelm
entries:
The water elemental envelops one creature it is grappling, and the grapple ends. While enveloped, the target is restrained, unable to breathe unless it can breathe water, can't be hit by the elemental's Water Tendril, and it takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the elemental's turns.
When the elemental moves, the enveloped creature moves with it. The elemental can have only one creature enveloped at a time. A creature within 5 feet of the elemental, including the target, can take its action to free the target from the elemental by succeeding on a DC 15 STR check.

entries.name: Purify Blood
entries: The water elemental touches a willing creature that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target is cured of the poisoned condition and of any disease afflicting it.

entries.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
entries: The weasel's Perception is 18 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the weasel can steal one item the target is wearing or carrying, provided the item weighs no more than 5 pounds, can fit in one hand, isn't a weapon, and isn't wrapped around or firmly attached to the target. For example, a weasel could steal a hat or belt pouch but not a creature's shirt or armor.

entries.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
entries: The weasel's Perception is 18 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the weasel can steal one item the target is wearing or carrying, provided the item weighs no more than 10 pounds, isn't a weapon, and isn't wrapped around or firmly attached to the target. For example, a weasel could steal a hat or belt pouch but not a creature's shirt or armor.

entries.name: Repellent Spray
entries: When a creature the weasel can see moves to a space within 15 feet of it, the weasel can release a pungent spray at the creature. The target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. While poisoned, the creature can't move to a space within 5 feet of the weasel.

ac.note: n humanoid form, 11 (natural armor) in bear and hybrid for

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Heightened Smell
entries: The werebear's Perception is 19 when perceiving by smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The werebear makes three Claw or Greataxe attacks. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack, provided it is in the appropriate form. If two Claw attacks hit one creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 15). The werebear can grapple only one creature at a time.

entries.name: Bite (Bear or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or be cursed with the werebear lycanthropy curse (see Curse of Lycanthropy sidebar).

entries.name: Claw (Bear or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Greataxe (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12+5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: The werebear transforms into a Medum or Large bear, a Large bear-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, speed, and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Pin
entries: One creature grappled by the werebear is knocked prone, and it is restrained until the grapple ends.

ac.note: n humanoid form, 11 (natural armor) in boar or hybrid for

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Charge (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: If the wereboar moves at least 15 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Slam or Tusks attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage of the weapon's type. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the wereboar takes 14 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 HP, it is reduced to 1 HP instead.

entries.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The wereboar makes three Maul or Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tusks attack, provided it is in the appropriate form. If two Maul or Slam attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Maul (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Slam (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Tusks (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) slashing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 CON save or be cursed with the wereboar lycanthropy curse (see Curse of Lycanthropy sidebar).

entries.name: Challenging Snort (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The wereboar snorts and stomps its feet at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn and have disadvantage on the next save it makes against being knocked prone by the wereboar.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: The wereboar transforms into a Medum or Large boar, a Medium boar-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, speed, and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Heightened Smell
entries: The wererat's Perception is 17 when perceiving by smell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The wererat has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wererat's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The wererat makes three Claw or Shortsword attacks, or it makes three Hand Crossbow attacks. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack, provided it is in the appropriate form.

entries.name: Bite (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 11 CON save or be cursed with the wererat lycanthropy curse (see Curse of Lycanthropy sidebar).

entries.name: Claw (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Shortsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: The wererat transforms into a Tiny or Small rat, a Medium rat-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
entries: The weretiger's Perception is 18 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

entries.name: Pounce (Tiger or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: If the weretiger moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the weretiger can make one Bite or Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The weretiger makes four Claw or Scimitar attacks, or it makes four Longbow attacks. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack, provided it is in the appropriate form.

entries.name: Bite (Tiger or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be cursed with the weretiger lycanthropy curse (see Curse of Lycanthropy sidebar).

entries.name: Claw (Tiger or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Scimitar (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Bleed Prey
entries: The weretiger chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet of it to be its prey until the prey dies, until the weretiger dies, or until the weretiger uses this bonus action on another creature. While within 60 feet of its prey, the weretiger can pinpoint its prey's location. In addition, if the weretiger hits the prey with at least two melee weapon attacks, the weretiger rends the prey's flesh, and the prey must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or lose 7 (2d6) HP at the start of its next turn, as the wound bleeds excessively.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: The weretiger transforms into a Large tiger, a Medium tiger-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

ac.note: n humanoid form, 12 (natural armor) in wolf or hybrid for

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
entries: The werewolf's Perception is 17 while perceiving by hearing or smell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The werewolf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the werewolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The werewolf makes three Claws or Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack, provided it is in the appropriate form.

entries.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8+2) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be cursed with the werewolf lycanthropy curse (see Curse of Lycanthropy sidebar).

entries.name: Claws (Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: The werewolf transforms into a Medum or Large wolf, a Medium wolf-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, speed, and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Hungry Growl (Wolf and Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The werewolf stares down and growls at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. The werewolf has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against the frightened creature.

entries.name: Ice Walk
entries: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. In addition, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

entries.name: Pounce
entries: If the dragon moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 STR save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the dragon can make one Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Cold Breath
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 CON save, taking 22 (5d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Wight
languages: the languages it knew in life

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Martial Adept
entries: A manufactured weapon, such as a sword or bow, deals one extra die of its damage when the wight hits with it (included in the attack).

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls, and its Perception is 8 when perceiving by sight.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: The wight doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Undead Resilience
entries: The wight is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The wight makes two Longsword or Longbow attacks. It can replace one attack with a Life Drain attack.

entries.name: Life Drain
entries:
Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or its HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0.
A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the wight's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at one time.

entries.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10+3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

entries.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Command Horde
entries:
The wight commands up to five friendly skeletons or zombies to do one of the following:
- Protect. Until the start of the wight's next turn, each time a friendly creature within 5 feet of a target is attacked, the target can use its reaction to intercept the attack, becoming the target instead.
- Overwhelm. Until the start of the wight's next turn, each target has advantage on attack rolls against a creature on its turn if at least one other target is within 5 feet of the creature and the allied target isn't incapacitated.
- Shamble. Each target uses its reaction to move up to its speed in a direction chosen by the wight. If this movement provokes an opportunity attack, that attack is made with disadvantage.

entries.name: Home in the Wilds
entries: The wild warrior automatically discerns true north when outside, and checks to follow its tracks in forest, grassland, hills, or mountain terrain have disadvantage, unless the wild warrior chooses to leave obvious signs of its passage.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The wild warrior has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the warrior's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Quick Trap
entries: The wild warrior cobbles together a makeshift trap with materials at hand and throws the trap at a creature it can see within 15 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 DEX save or be restrained until the end of its next turn.

name: Will-o'-Wisp
languages: the languages it knew in life

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Ephemeral
entries: The will-o'-wisp can't wear or carry anything. In addition, it adds its WIS modifier to its AC (included above).

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The will-o'-wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

entries.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The will-o'-wisp sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The will-o'-wisp can alter the radius as a bonus action.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: The will-o'-wisp doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Undead Resilience
entries: The will-o'-wisp is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The will-o'-wisp makes two Shock attacks.

entries.name: Shock
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) lightning damage.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: The will-o'-wisp and its light magically become invisible until it attacks or uses its Beckon, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

entries.name: Beckon
entries: The will-o'-wisp pulses its lightly gently toward one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or use its reaction to move up to its speed toward the will-o'-wisp by the most direct route. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks or damaging terrain when moving.

entries.name: Consume Life
entries: When a creature the will-o'-wisp can see within 15 feet of it is reduced to 0 HP, the will-o'-wisp can consume some of that creature's fading life. The will-o'-wisp gains 7 (2d6) temporary HP, and the creature has disadvantage on the next death save it makes before the end of the wisp's next turn.

entries.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
entries: The winter wolf's Perception is 20 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

entries.name: Monstrosity Resilience
entries: The winter wolf is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The winter wolf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the winter wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Snow Camouflage
entries: The winter wolf's Stealth is 18 while in snowy terrain.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The winter wolf makes two Bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Cold Breath
entries: The winter wolf exhales a blast of freezing wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 DEX save, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Freezing Nose
entries:
The winter wolf touches its nose to a creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or one of the following parts of its body (the winter wolf's choice) is encased in ice for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target takes fire damage, it has advantage on the next save it makes to end the effect.
- Body. The target has disadvantage on CON saves and is vulnerable to the first instance of cold damage it takes each turn.
- Head. The target can't breathe or speak.
- Lower Limb. The target's speed is reduced to 0, and it has disadvantage on DEX checks and DEX saves.
- Upper Limb. The target has disadvantage on weapon attack rolls made with that limb.

entries.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
entries: The wolf's Perception is 16 while perceiving by hearing or smell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The wolf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 STR save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
entries: The wolf's Perception is 18 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Hungry Growl
entries: The wolf stares down and growls at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. The wolf has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against the frightened creature.

entries.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The wood herald's Stealth is 18 while in any terrain with ample, obscuring plant life.

entries.name: Plant Resilience
entries: The wood herald is resistant to exhaustion and to the paralyzed, petrified, and unconscious conditions.

entries.name: Woodland Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of nonmagical plants doesn't cost the wood herald extra movement. In addition, the herald can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Wooden Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12+2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Hurl Thorn
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4+1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Brambly Bark
entries: When a creature the wood herald can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the herald can extend sharp brambles along its body, dealing 2 (1d4) piercing damage to the attacker.

entries.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
entries: The worg's Perception is 19 while perceiving by hearing or smell.

entries.name: Monstrosity Resilience
entries: The worg is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Loathsome Howl
entries: The worg unleashes an unnatural howl audible out to a distance of 300 feet. Each creature of the worg's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 CHA save or be frightened of it for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Until it finishes a long rest, the worg can sense the direction but not the exact location of each creature that was frightened by Loathsome Howl.

name: Wraith
languages: the languages it knew in life

resistances.name: and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, and its Perception is 7 when perceiving by sight.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: The wraith doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Undead Resilience
entries: The wraith is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The wraith makes two Life Drain attacks.

entries.name: Life Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 18 (4d6+4) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 CON save or its HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0.

entries.name: Create Specter
entries: The wraith targets one Humanoid it can see within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

entries.name: Trail of Death
entries: The wraith moves up to 30 feet in a straight line. This distance is not reduced by moving through creatures or objects, and this movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 DEX save or be afflicted with wasting doom. While afflicted with wasting doom, a creature takes 3 (1d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Wasting doom ends if a creature starts its turn in sunlight or regains HP.

entries.name: Unravel Life
entries: When a creature the wraith can see within 30 feet of it and that isn't a Construct or Undead regains HP, the wraith can corrupt the healing energies, halving the amount of healing that creature receives.

entries.name: Intuition
entries: The wyrdling rolls two dice for initiative, taking the higher number. In addition, the wyrdling has advantage on WIS (Insight) checks.

entries.name: Read Fate
entries: The wyrdling can spend 1 minute communing with fate on behalf of one creature that remains within 10 feet of it for the duration. The creature must ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. At the end of the minute, the wyrdling pronounces the result of the target's inquiry. This trait works like the divination spell, except it can't be used to answer a specific creature's question more than once every 3 days, regardless if the creature asks a different question.

entries.name: Psychic Burst
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6+3) psychic damage.

entries.name: Pronounce Fate
entries: The wyrdling pronounces the fate, either fortune or doom (the wyrdling's choice), of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target rolls a d4 and adds (fortune) or subtracts (doom) the number rolled to the next attack roll or save it makes before the start of the wyrdling's next turn.

entries.name: Call on Fate
entries: When the wyrdling is attacked by a creature it can see, it can pluck the strands of fate around the creature, imposing disadvantage on that attack roll. If the attack misses, the wyrdling or one friendly creature it can see within 30 feet of it has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against the attacker before the end of the wyrdling's next turn.

entries.name: Clumsy
entries: While not flying, the wyvern is vulnerable to the grappled, prone, and restrained conditions.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The wyvern makes one Bite attack and one Stinger attack. While flying, it can replace one attack with a Claws attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Reflexive Tail Whip
entries: When a creature moves into a space within 15 feet of the wyvern, it can whip its tail at the creature. The target must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or be knocked prone.

resistances.name: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

entries.name: Earth Glide
entries: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the xorn doesn't disturb the material through which it moves.

entries.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The xorn's Stealth is 18 while in rocky terrain.

entries.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The xorn makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks, or it makes three Lob Stone attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6+3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Lob Stone
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Shard Belch
entries: The xorn belches a mixture of stomach gas and crystalline shards in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 DEX save or be coated in miniscule, crystalline shards until the end of its next turn. A creature coated in shards suffers bouts of pain each time it moves, reducing its speed by 10 feet and imposing disadvantage on all weapon attack rolls.

entries.name: Acidic Vapors
entries: After the black dragon uses its Acid Breath, acid clings to its mouth, throat, and nostrils for a time, evaporating as the dragon breathes. While the dragon's Acid Breath is unavailable, acidic vapors surround it, and each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 15 CON save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Acid Breath
entries: The dragon exhales acid in a 3-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 49 (11d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Charged Hide
entries: When the blue dragon hasn't exhaled its Lightning Breath, the electric charge builds up across its body. While the dragon's Lightning Breath is available, it emits wild sparks of electricity, and each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be incapacitated until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Lightning Breath
entries: The dragon exhales lightning in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 DEX save, taking 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Suffocating Heat
entries: After the brass dragon uses its Fire Breath, the air around it is devoid of moisture and lacking in breathable air. While the dragon's Fire Breath is unavailable, each creature that requires air to breathe, other than the dragon, and that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or begin suffocating. A creature that fails this save for two consecutive rounds falls unconscious until it takes damage or another creature uses an action to wake it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Sleep Breath, if available.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Fire Breath
entries: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 14 DEX save, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Sleep Breath
entries: The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or fall unconscious for 1 minute. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or another creature uses an action to wake it.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon magically transforms into a Beast or Humanoid that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form, which is Dragon. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it or is borne by the new form (the dragon's choice). It reverts to its true form if it dies. In a new form, the dragon retains its HP, ability to speak, proficiencies, and INT, WIS, and CHA scores, as well as this bonus action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Lightning Extraction
entries: After the bronze dragon uses its Lightning Breath, its body begins recharging with lightning, pulling electricity from nearby creatures. While the dragon's Lightning Breath is unavailable, each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon must make a DC 15 CON save. On a failure, a creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Repulsion Breath, if available.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Lightning Breath
entries: The dragon exhales lightning in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 49 (9d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Repulsion Breath
entries: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the dragon.

entries.name: Change Shape

In a new form, the dragon retains its HP, ability to speak, proficiencies, and INT, WIS, and CHA scores, as well as this bonus action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

entries.name: Corrosive Scales
entries: When the copper dragon hasn't spit its Acid Breath, the acid built up within the dragon causes the patina on its scales to spread to weapons that strike it. While the dragon's Acid Breath is available, any weapon made of metal that hits the dragon corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If a nonmagical weapon's penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the dragon is destroyed after dealing damage. A magical weapon can't have a penalty greater than -5, and a magical weapon removes this penalty after 24 hours or after its attuned wielder finishes a long rest.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Slowing Breath, if available.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw

entries.name: Slowing Breath
entries: As the copper dragon wyrmling, except it is a 30-foot cone, and the save DC is 14.

Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Golden Splendor
entries: When the gold dragon hasn't unleashed its Fire Breath, its scales gleam and sparkle like molten gold or a pile of gold coins. While the dragon's Fire Breath is available, each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 17 CHA save or be charmed until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10+6) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6+6) slashing damage.

entries.name: Fire Breath

entries: As the gold dragon wyrmling, except it is a 30-foot cone, and the save DC is 17.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Hallucinogenic Gas
entries: After the green dragon exhales its Poison Breath, wisps of poisonous gas laced with the alchemical taint that permeates the dragon's body linger around it. While the dragon's Poison Breath is unavailable, each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 14 WIS save or be terrified, as the gas causes the creature to experience frightful hallucinations. A terrified creature is frightened, and its speed is reduced to 0.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Poison Breath
entries: The dragon exhales poisonous gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 CON save, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Boil Over
entries: When the red dragon hasn't unleashed its Fire Breath, the heat builds and rolls outward from it. While the dragon's Fire Breath is available, it emits immense heat, and each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or take 7 (2d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10+6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6+6) slashing damage.

entries.name: Fire Breath
entries: The dragon exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 DEX save, taking 56 (16d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Freezing Fog
entries: After the silver dragon uses its Cold Breath, freezing fog surrounds it. While the dragon's Cold Breath is unavailable, each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or be restrained until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Paralyzing Breath, if available.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10+6) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6+6) slashing damage.

entries.name: Cold Breath
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 CON save, taking 54 (12d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Paralyzing Breath
entries: As the silver dragon wyrmling, except it is a 30-foot cone, and the save DC is 17.
