entries: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure:  7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success:  Half damage.

entries.name: Death Burst
entries: The magmin explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the magmin. Failure:  7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success:  Half damage.

entries.name: Touch
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

entries.name: Ignited Illumination
entries: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The mammoth makes two Gore attacks.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the mammoth moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Trample
entries: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure:  29 (4d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. Success:  Half damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Tail Spike
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 100/200 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Demonic Restoration
entries: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The marilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Reactive
entries: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.

entries.name: Pact Blade
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Constrict
entries: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. Failure:  15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

entries.name: Teleport
entries: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Snake Hair
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Poison Ray
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.

entries.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. First Failure The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Ocean Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 3 (1d6) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. HitomThe spear magically returns to the merfolk's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The merrow can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the merrow's next turn.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Harpoon
entries: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.

entries.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic), reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage—or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

entries.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entries.name: Abyssal Glaive
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The mule counts as one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

entries.name: Rotting Fist
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

entries.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure:  The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the mummy's next turn. Success:  The target is immune to this mummy's Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mummy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Undead Restoration
entries: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy's lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

entries.name: Rotting Fist
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, it gains no benefit from finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

entries.name: Channel Negative Energy
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60 ft. 25 (6d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure:  25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):
At Will: Dispel Magic, Thaumaturgy

entries.name: 1e/Day Each
entries: Animate Dead, Harm, Insect Plague

entries.name: Glare
entries: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Necrotic Strike
entries: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.

entries.name: Dread Command
entries: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Demonic Restoration
entries: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The nalfeshnee has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.

entries.name: Teleport
entries: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

entries.name: Horror Nimbus
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the nalfeshnee. Failure:  28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. Success:  The target is immune to this nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Soul Bag
entries: The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action.

The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and Resistance to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At Will: Detect Magic, Etherealness, Magic Missile

entries.name: 2e/Day Each
entries: Phantasmal Killer, Plane Shift

entries.name: Nightmare Haunting
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts Dream, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell's messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the Protection from Evil and Good spell or within a Magic Circle spell.

If the target takes damage from the Dream spell, the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag, and the target can't be raised from the dead until its soul is released.
At Will:
1/Day Each: Dream, Protection from Evil and Good, Magic Circle

entries.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entries.name: Confer Fire Resistance
entries: The nightmare can grant Resistance to Fire damage to a rider while it is on the nightmare.

entries.name: Illumination
entries: The nightmare sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

entries.name: Ethereal Stride
entries: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it teleport to the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or vice versa.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

entries.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

name: Ogre Zombie
languages: Understands Common and Giant but can't speak

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Nightmare Ray
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

entries.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At Will:

entries.name: 1e/Day Each
entries: Charm Person, Darkness, Gaseous Form, Sleep

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: The oni casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

name: Otyugh
languages: Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn't allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure:  The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn't return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success:  The Poisoned condition ends.

attack.targets: Failure:  The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn't return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two tentacles.

entries.name: Tentacle Slam
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature Grappled by the otyugh. Failure:  16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. Success:  Half damage only.

entries.name: Flyby
entries: The owl doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

entries.name: Talons
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 1 Slashing damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes two Rend attacks.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The panther takes the Disengage or Hide action.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The spider can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane while on the Material Plane and vice versa.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two Bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target becomes Stable, and it has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While Poisoned, the target also has the Paralyzed condition.

entries.name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: The spider teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: The piranha can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target doesn't have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The pirate makes two Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Enthralling Panache.

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Enthralling Panache
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure:  The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

entries.name: Pistol
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Captain's Charm
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure:  The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.

entries.name: Diabolical Restoration
entries: If the pit fiend dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

entries.name: Fear Aura
entries: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. Failure:  The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success:  The target is immune to this pit fiend's aura for 24 hours.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the pit fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pit fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The pit fiend makes one Bite attack, two Devilish Claw attacks, and one Fiery Mace attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 18 (3d6 + 8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure:  The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points and takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

entries.name: Devilish Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 26 (4d8 + 8) Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Fiery Mace
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 22 (4d6 + 8) Force damage plus 21 (6d6) Fire damage.

entries.name: Hellfire Spellcasting
entries: The pit fiend casts Fireball (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21). It can replace one Fireball with Hold Monster (level 7 version) or Wall of Fire.
At Will:

entries.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

entries.name: Exalted Restoration
entries: If the planetar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The planetar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The planetar makes three Radiant Sword attacks or uses Holy Burst twice.

entries.name: Radiant Sword
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Holy Burst
entries: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the planetar can see within 120 feet. Failure:  24 (7d6) Radiant damage. Success:  Half damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
At Will: Detect Evil and Good

entries.name: 1e/Day Each
entries: Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Raise Dead

entries.name: Divine Aid
entries: The planetar casts Cure Wounds, Invisibility, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: The plesiosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two Rend attacks.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 9 (1d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The priest makes two attacks, using Mace or Radiant Flame in any combination.

entries.name: Mace
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Radiant Flame
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:
At Will: Light, Thaumaturgy
1/Day Each: Spirit Guardians

entries.name: Divine Aid
entries: The priest casts Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, or Lesser Restoration, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entries.name: Mace
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Radiant Flame
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:
At Will: Light, Thaumaturgy

entries.name: Divine Aid
entries: The priest casts Bless, Healing Word, or Sanctuary, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

name: Pseudodragon
languages: Understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pseudodragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The pseudodragon makes two Bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Sting
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pseudodragon can see within 5 feet. Failure:  5 (2d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or More: While Poisoned, the target also has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

entries.name: Flyby
entries: The pteranodon doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm makes one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 22 (3d8 + 9) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

entries.name: Tail Stinger
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 16 (2d6 + 9) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Swallow
entries: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). Failure:  The target is swallowed by the worm, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 (5d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the Prone condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The quasit has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the quasit's next turn.

entries.name: Scare
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 20 feet. Failure:  The target has the Frightened condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

entries.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The quasit shape-shifts to resemble a bat (Speed 10 ft., Fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., Climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., Swim 40 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: The quasit casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
At Will: Invisibility

entries.name: Greater Magic Resistance
entries: The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and the attack rolls of spells automatically miss it. Without the rakshasa's permission, no spell can observe the rakshasa remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.

entries.name: Fiendish Restoration
entries: If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes three Cursed Touch attacks.

entries.name: Cursed Touch
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target gains no benefit from finishing a Short  or Long Rest.

entries.name: Baleful Command
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, each enemy in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the rakshasa. Failure:  28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions until the start of the rakshasa's next turn.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The rakshasa casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At Will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion

entries.name: 1e/Day Each
entries: Fly, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift

entries.name: Agile
entries: The rat doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries: The raven can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a whisper or chitter. A hearer can discern the sounds are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

entries.name: Fire Breath
entries: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure:  24 (7d6) Fire damage. Success:  Half damage.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The shark has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: The shark can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Heat Aura
entries: At the end of each of the remorhaz's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the remorhaz takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

entries.name: Swallow
entries: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). Failure:  The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.

If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the remorhaz and has the Prone condition. If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. If target is a Large or smaller creature and the rhinoceros moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The roc makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. 28 (3d12 + 9) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Talons
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from both talons, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

entries.name: Swoop
entries: If the roc has a creature Grappled, the roc flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and drops that creature.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The roper makes two Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 60 ft. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of six tentacles, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the grapple ends.

The tentacle can be damaged, freeing a creature it has Grappled when destroyed (AC 20, HP 10, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). Damaging the tentacle deals no damage to the roper, and a destroyed tentacle regrows at the start of the roper's next turn.

entries.name: Reel
entries: The roper pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

entries.name: Iron Scent
entries: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Antennae
entries: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object—armor or a weapon—worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, the creature with the object. Failure:  The object takes a -1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor or weapon.

entries.name: Destroy Metal
entries: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn't being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.

entries.name: Running Leap
entries: With a 10-foot running start, the tiger can Long Jump up to 25 feet.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The tiger makes two Rend attacks.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The tiger takes the Disengage or Hide action.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

entries.name: Shark Telepathy
entries: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The sahuagin makes two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Aquatic Charge
entries: The sahuagin swims up to its Swim Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.

entries.name: Fire Aura
entries: At the end of each of the salamander's turns, each creature of the salamander's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the salamander takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The salamander makes two Flame Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Constrict.

entries.name: Flame Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. HitomThe spear magically returns to the salamander's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

entries.name: Constrict
entries: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the salamander can see within 10 feet. Failure:  11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The satyr has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the satyr pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

entries.name: Mockery
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the satyr can see within 90 feet. Failure:  5 (1d6 + 2) Psychic damage.

entries.name: Sting
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The hag can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Vile Appearance
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form. Failure:  The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success:  The target is immune to this hag's Vile Appearance for 24 hours.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Death Glare
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one Frightened creature the hag can see within 30 feet. Failure:  If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it drops to 0 Hit Points. Otherwise, the target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.

entries.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The hag casts Disguise Self, using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13). The spell's duration is 24 hours.
At Will: Disguise Self

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: The seahorse can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Bubble Dash
entries: While underwater, the seahorse moves up to its Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

entries.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow has Disadvantage on D20 Test.

entries.name: Draining Swipe
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. If a Humanoid is slain by this attack, a Shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

entries.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in Dim Light or darkness, the shadow takes the Hide action.

entries.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The shambling mound makes three Charged Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Engulf.

entries.name: Charged Tendril
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the shambling mound pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.

entries.name: Engulf
entries: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. Failure:  The target is pulled into the shambling mound's space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it takes 10 (3d6) Lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. When the shambling mound moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature Grappled by this action at a time.

name: Shield Guardian
languages: Understands commands given in any language but can't speak

entries.name: Bound
entries: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

entries.name: Spell Storing
entries: A spellcaster who wears the guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian makes two Fist attacks.

entries.name: Fist
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

warnings: no abilities or actions parsed

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Cold Breath
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure:  18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success:  Half damage.

entries.name: Paralyzing Breath
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. First Failure The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

name: Skeleton
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

entries.name: Exalted Restoration
entries: If the solar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The solar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The solar makes two Flying Sword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slaying Bow.

entries.name: Flying Sword
entries: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +15, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. 22 (4d6 + 8) Slashing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage. HitomThe sword magically returns to the solar's hand or hovers within 5 feet of the solar immediately after a ranged attack.

entries.name: Slaying Bow
entries: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, one creature the solar can see within 600 feet. Failure:  If the creature has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. It otherwise takes 24 (4d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The solar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):
At Will: Detect Evil and Good

entries.name: 1e/Day Each
entries: Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Resurrection

entries.name: Divine Aid
entries: The solar casts Cure Wounds (level 2 version), Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entries.name: Blinding Gaze
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature the solar can see within 120 feet. Failure:  The target has the Blinded condition for 1 minute. Failure or Success:  The solar can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Radiant Teleport
entries: The solar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the solar at its destination space. Failure:  11 (2d10) Radiant damage. Success:  Half damage.

name: Specter
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

entries.name: Life Drain
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

entries.name: Inscrutable
entries: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes three Claw attacks.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Mind-Rending Roar
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each enemy in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure:  35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the sphinx's next turn.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At Will: Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation

entries.name: 1e/Day Each
entries: Dispel Magic, Legend Lore, Locate Object, Plane Shift, Remove Curse, Tongues

entries.name: Arcane Prowl
entries: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

entries.name: Weight of Years
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure:  The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success:  The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Inscrutable
entries: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Roar.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Roar
entries: The sphinx emits a magical roar. Whenever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a Long Rest):

entries.name: First Roar
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure:  The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute.

entries.name: Second Roar
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure:  The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

entries.name: Third Roar
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure:  44 (8d10) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success:  Half damage only.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Thaumaturgy

entries.name: 1e/Day Each
entries: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Greater Restoration, Heroes' Feast, Zone of Truth

entries.name: Arcane Prowl
entries: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

entries.name: Weight of Years
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure:  The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success:  The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

entries.name: Fiendish Restoration
entries: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Necrotic Ray
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At Will: Detect Magic, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Water Breathing

entries.name: 2e/Day Each
entries: Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Hold Person, Lightning Bolt

entries.name: Needle Sword
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Enchanting Bow
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

entries.name: Heart Sight
entries: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). Failure:  The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
At Will: Invisibility

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries: The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

entries.name: Blurred Form
entries: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: Death Burst
entries: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure:  5 (2d4) Fire damage. Success:  Half damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.

entries.name: Steam Breath
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure:  5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit's next turn. Success:  Half damage only. Failure or Success:  Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

entries.name: Proboscis
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can't make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns.
The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.

attack.targets: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.

entries.name: Stone Club
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Boulder
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

name: Stone Golem
languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem can't shape-shift.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.

entries.name: Force Bolt
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. 22 (4d10) Force damage.

entries.name: Slow
entries: The golem casts the Slow spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks, using Storm Sword or Thunderbolt in any combination.

entries.name: Storm Sword
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Lightning damage.

entries.name: Thunderbolt
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +14, range 500 ft. 22 (2d12 + 9) Lightning damage, and the target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions until the start of the giant's next turn.

entries.name: Lightning Storm
entries: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder originating from a point the giant can see within 500 feet. Failure:  55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success:  Half damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At Will: Detect Magic, Light
1/Day Each: Control Weather

entries.name: Incubus Form
entries: When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an Incubus, using that stat block instead of this one.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.

entries.name: Fiendish Touch
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage.

entries.name: Charm
entries: The succubus casts Dominate Person (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15).

entries.name: Draining Kiss
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature Charmed by the succubus within 5 feet. Failure:  13 (3d8) Psychic damage. Success:  Half damage. Failure or Success:  The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

entries.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The succubus shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small Humanoid or back into its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its Fly Speed is available only in its true form. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

entries.name: Bites
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (2d4) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

entries.name: Swarm of Grasping Hands
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 20 (4d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) Necrotic damage if the swarm is Bloodied. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: If the swarm has a Climb Speed, the swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

entries.name: Bites
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 6 (2d4 + 1) Poison damage, or 3 (1d4 + 1) Poison damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny piranha. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: The swarm can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Bites
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target doesn't have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage, or 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny rat. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

entries.name: Bites
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 5 (2d4) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny raven. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

entries.name: Beaks
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

entries.name: Cacophony
entries: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature in the swarm's space. Failure:  The target has the Deafened condition until the start of the swarm's next turn. While Deafened, the target also has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny snake. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

entries.name: Bites
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage—or 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied—plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tarrasque has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Reflective Carapace
entries: If the tarrasque is targeted by a Magic Missile spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. On a 1-5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. 36 (4d12 + 10) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and can't teleport.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. 28 (4d8 + 10) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 30 ft. 23 (3d8 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Thunderous Bellow
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 27, each creature and each object that isn't being worn or carried in a 150-foot Cone. Failure:  78 (12d12) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened and Frightened conditions until the end of its next turn. Success:  Half damage only.

entries.name: Swallow
entries: Strength Saving Throw: DC 27, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). Failure:  The target is swallowed, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions and can't teleport, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns.

If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the Prone condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

entries.name: Onslaught
entries: The tarrasque moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.

entries.name: World-Shaking Movement
entries: The tarrasque moves up to its Speed. At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot Emanation originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose  Concentration and, if Medium or smaller, have the Prone condition. The tarrasque can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The tiger takes the Disengage or Hide action.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: Mace
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 100/400 ft. 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The tough makes two attacks, using Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

entries.name: Warhammer
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 100/400 ft. 13 (2d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Hail of Bark
entries: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 180 ft. 28 (4d10 + 6) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Animate Trees
entries: The treant magically animates up to two trees it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each tree uses the Treant stat block, except it has Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, it can't speak, and it lacks this action. The tree takes its turn immediately after the treant on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the treant. A tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, the treant dies, or it is more than 120 feet from the treant. The tree then takes root if possible.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The triceratops makes two Gore attacks.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. 19 (2d12 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller and the triceratops moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

entries.name: Loathsome Limbs
entries: If the troll ends any turn Bloodied and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the troll's limbs is severed, falls into the troll's space, and becomes a Troll Limb. The limb acts immediately after the troll's turn. The troll has 1 Exhaustion level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains Hit Points.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 15 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three Rend attacks.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Charge
entries: The troll moves up to half its Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The limb regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the limb takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the limb's next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Troll Spawn
entries: The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll. If the limb isn't destroyed within 24 hours, roll 1d12. On a 12, the limb turns into a Troll. Otherwise, the limb withers away.

entries.name: Rend
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The tyrannosaurus makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and can't be targeted by the tyrannosaurus's Tail.

entries.name: Tail
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 15 ft. 25 (4d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entries: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Radiant Horn
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The unicorn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Druidcraft

entries.name: 1e/Day Each
entries: Calm Emotions, Dispel Evil and Good, Entangle, Pass without Trace, Word of Recall

entries.name: Unicorn's Blessing
entries: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn and casts Cure Wounds or Lesser Restoration on that creature, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entries.name: Charging Horn
entries: The unicorn moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Radiant Horn attack.

entries.name: Shimmering Shield
entries: The unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target gains 10 (3d6) Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. The unicorn can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Misty Escape
entries: If the vampire drops to 0 Hit Points outside its resting place, the vampire uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can't use Shape-Shift, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 Hit Points in mist form, it can't return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the Paralyzed condition until it regains any Hit Points, and it regains 1 Hit Point after spending 1 hour there.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Vampire Weakness
entries: The vampire has these weaknesses:

entries.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

entries.name: Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

entries.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire has the Incapacitated condition in its resting place, the vampire has the Paralyzed condition until the weapon is removed.

entries.name: Sunlight
entries: The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

entries.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: The vampire makes two Grave Strike attacks and uses Bite.

entries.name: Grave Strike (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two hands.

entries.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure:  6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a Vampire Spawn under the vampire's control.

entries.name: Shape-Shift
entries: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it shape-shifts into a Tiny bat (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 20 ft. [hover]), or it returns to its vampire form. Anything it is wearing transforms with it.
While in bat form, the vampire can't speak. Its game statistics, other than its size and Speed, are unchanged.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. It has Resistance to all damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

entries.name: Charm
entries: The vampire casts Charm Person, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17), and the duration is 24 hours. The Charmed target is a willing recipient of the vampire's Bite, the damage of which doesn't end the spell. When the spell ends, the target is unaware it was Charmed by the vampire.

entries.name: Deathless Strike
entries: The vampire moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Grave Strike attack.

entries.name: Beguile
entries: The vampire casts Command, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17). The vampire can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Vampiric Connection
entries: While the familiar and its vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with the familiar telepathically, and the vampire can perceive through the familiar's senses.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: The familiar makes two Umbral Dagger attacks.

entries.name: Umbral Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, the target becomes Stable but has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While it has the Poisoned condition, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

entries.name: Deathless Agility
entries: The familiar takes the Dash or Disengage action.

entries.name: Demonic Restoration
entries: If the vrock dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

entries.name: Magic Resistance

entries: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Spores
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the vrock. Failure:  The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. While Poisoned, the target takes 5 (1d10) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Emptying a flask of Holy Water on the target ends the effect early.

entries.name: Stunning Screech
entries: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the vrock (demons succeed automatically). Failure:  10 (3d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the vrock's next turn.

entries.name: Water Form

entries.name: Whelm
entries: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the elemental's space. Failure:  22 (4d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition, is suffocating unless it can breathe water, and takes 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the elemental's turns. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at a time with Whelm. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature out of it by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. Success:  Half damage only.

entries: The werebear makes two attacks, using Handaxe or Rend in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

Failure:  The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Werebear under the DM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success:  The target is immune to this werebear's curse for 24 hours.

entries.name: Illumination

entries.name: Vanish
entries: The wisp and its light have the Invisible condition until the wisp's  Concentration ends on this effect, which ends early immediately after the wisp makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.
