entries: While motionless indistinguishable from ice-covered willow tree.

entries.name: Ice Melt
entries: If it takes fire damage its icicles partially melt. Until the end of the ice willow's next turn creatures have advantage on saves vs. the willow's Icicle Drop and Icicle Spray.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slam attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) cold.

entries.name: Icicle Drop
entries: Shakes several spear-like icicles loose. Each creature within 10 ft. of the willow must make a DC 15 Dex save taking 9 (2d8) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) cold on a failed save or half damage if made.

entries.name: Icicle Spray
entries: Flings icicles in a 30' cone. All in area make a DC 15 Dex save taking 18 (4d8) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) cold on a failed save or half damage if made.

entries.name: Melting Icicles
entries: When the ice willow takes fire it can immediately use Icicle Drop if available.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: Can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Cold Physiology
entries: Can't abide constant warmth. Each hr it spends in an area with temperature above 40 degrees Fahrenheit worm must make DC 15 Con save or suffer one level of exhaustion that can't be removed until it finishes a long rest in area with temperature below 40 degrees.

entries.name: Heat Sensitivity
entries: Has disadvantage on attack rolls when within 5 ft. of a strong source of heat that isn't a warm-blooded creature's natural warmth such as a torch or campfire. In addition the iceworm can pinpoint the location of warm-blooded creatures within 90' of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

entries.name: Slippery
entries: Has advantage on saves and ability checks made to escape a grapple.

entries.name: Icy Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage + 7 (2d6) cold.

entries.name: Icy Spit
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit 20/60' one creature. 10 (2d6+3) cold and target is coated in freezing viscous slime. While coated creature's speed reduced by 10 ft. and has disadvantage on 1st attack roll it makes on each of its turns. Creature including target can use action to clean off the slime ending effect.

entries.name: Essential Oiliness
entries: Has advantage on saves and ability checks made to escape a grapple or end restrained condition.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: Can hold its breath for 1 hr.

entries.name: Penguin Telepathy
entries: Can magically command any penguin within 120' of it using a limited telepathy.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries: Double damage to objects/structures.

entries.name: Wing Slap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Pelagic Bile
entries: The imperator regurgitates its stomach contents in a 60' cone. All in area make a DC 17 Dex save. On a failure a creature takes 17 (5d6) acid and 17 (5d6) poison and is poisoned for 1 min. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. Swallowed creatures are then regurgitated falling prone in a space within 10 ft. of the imperator.

entries.name: Toboggan Charge
entries: The imperator moves up to 30' in a straight line over ice or snow and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move that creature must make a DC 17 Str save. On a failure a creature takes 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Beak attack and two Wing Slap attacks.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 24 (3d12+5) piercing damage. If target is a Large or smaller creature it must make DC 17 Dex save or be swallowed by the imperator. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained it has total cover vs. attacks and other effects outside the imperator and it takes 21 (6d6) acid at the start of each of the imperator's turns. If the imperator takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it the imperator must make DC 17 Con save at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures which fall prone in a space within 10 ft. of the imperator. If the imperator dies a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 ft. of movement exiting prone.

entries.name: Muster the Legions
entries: When the imperator is reduced to half its hp or lower it magically calls 1d4 swarms of penguins. The penguins arrive on initiative count 20 of the next round acting as allies of the imperator and obeying its telepathic commands. The penguins remain for 1 hr until the imperator dies or until the imperator dismisses them as a bonus action.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Med penguin. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temp hp.

entries.name: Tobogganing Tide
entries: The swarm can move at double its walking speed over ice and snow.

entries.name: Beaks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 0 ft., one creature, in the swarm's space. 21 (6d6) piercing damage or 10 (3d6) if the swarm has half its hp or fewer.

entries.name: Toboggan Charge
entries: The swarm moves up to 20' in a straight line over ice or snow and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move that creature must make a DC 14 Str save. On a failure a creature takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and 10 (3d6) piercing damage and is knocked prone. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

entries.name: Aqueous Form
entries: Can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: Can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Flyby
entries: Doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

entries.name: Immortal Nature
entries: Doesn't require food drink or sleep

entries.name: Luminous
entries: Sheds dim light in a 5 ft. radius.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Weapon attacks are magical.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slam attacks or three Astral Bolt attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage + 18 (4d8) cold.

entries.name: Astral Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, 120 ft., one target, 18 (4d6+4) radiant and the next attack roll made vs. the target before the end of the incandescent one's next turn has advantage.

entries.name: Celestial Inspiration
entries: Inspires one creature it can see within 60' of it. Whenever target makes attack roll or save before start of incandescent one's next turn target can roll a d4 and add number rolled to the attack roll or save.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: Ionic Form
entries: Whenever subjected to lightning it takes no damage and instead regains hp equal to lightning dealt. Its Supercharge then recharges. If it takes cold while supercharged it must roll a d6. On a 1 or 2 it loses the supercharged state.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: Doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Pseudopod attacks.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d6+3) bludgeoning damage + 9 (2d8) lightning.

entries.name: Discharge (Supercharged Only)
entries: Sends shock of lightning through its supercharged pseudopod at onecreature it can see within 5 ft. of it ending supercharged state. Target: 27 (6d8) lightning (DC 15 Con half). Three bolts of lightning then leap to as many as three targets each must be within 20' of first target. Target can be creature or object and each can be targeted by only one bolt. Each target: 13 (3d8) lightning (DC 15 Con half).

entries.name: Charged Motion (Supercharged Only)
entries: Dash or Dodge action.

entries.name: Supercharge
entries: Gathers ambient electricity to supercharge itself for 3 rounds. While supercharged slime gains +2 bonus to its AC and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. At end of the third round if the slime hasn't used the Discharge action it suffers feedback taking 18 (4d8) force. Its supercharged state then ends.

entries.name: Elemental Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are imbued with its elemental power. When the jinnborn hits with any weapon the weapon deals an extra 1d6 lightning (included in the attack).

entries.name: Flamboyant Defense
entries: While it is wearing no armor and wielding no shield its AC includes its Cha modifier.

entries.name: Knows the Ropes
entries: Has proficiency with airships sandships or waterborne ships (the jinnborn's choice). It adds its proficiency bonus to any check it makes to control the chosen type of ship and it adds its proficiency bonus to any saves made while on the chosen type of vehicle.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage + 3 (1d6) lightning.

entries.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit 80/320' one target 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage + 3 (1d6) lightning.

entries.name: Parry
entries: + 2 to its AC vs. one melee attack that would hit it if it can see attacker and wielding melee weapon.

entries.name: Shrill Screech
entries: When agitated the jubjub bird makes a near constant shrill and high scream giving it advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks.

entries.name: Stubborn
entries: Has advantage on saves vs. being charmed. In addition Wis (Animal Handling) checks are made with disadvantage vs. the jubjub bird.

entries.name: Unpredictable
entries: Opportunity attacks vs. the jubjub bird are made with disadvantage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Bites or one Bite and one Constrict.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 10 ft., one creature,. 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage + 7 (2d6) poison and the target must make DC 13 Con save or be poisoned for 1 min. The target can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 14 (2d10+3) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until grapple ends creature is restrained and bird can't constrict another target.

attack.targets: Until grapple ends creature is restrained and bird can't constrict another target

entries.name: Impassioned Riposte
entries: When a creature the jubjub bird can see misses it with an attack while within 10 ft. of it the jubjub bird can make one Bite attack vs. the attacker.

entries.name: Aura of Honesty
entries: Creature that enters space within 10 ft. of sheriff for 1st time on a turn or starts turn there: DC 13 Cha save or be unable to speak deliberate lie until it starts its turn more than 10 ft. away from sheriff. Creatures affected by this are aware of it and sheriff knows whether creature in area succeeded/failed save.

entries.name: Sheriff's Duty
entries: Knows if it hears a lie and can't speak deliberate lie.

entries.name: Unfailing Memory
entries: Remembers every creature that has ever spoken to it. If creature has spoken to sheriff and speaks to sheriff again while polymorphed or disguised sheriff has advantage on Int (Investigation) Wis (Insight) and Wis (Perception) checks to identify or recognize that creature.

entries.name: Saber
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Bitter Truth
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) psychic and target: disad- vantage on next save vs. sheriff's Aura of Honesty for next 1 min.

entries.name: Hop Away
entries: Takes the Dash or Disengage action.

entries.name: Impaling Charge
entries: If it moves 20+' straight toward a target and then hits it with Horn attack on same turn karkadann impales target on its horn grappling the target if it is a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends the target is restrained takes 18 (4d8) piercing damage at start of each of its turns and karkadann can't make horn attacks vs. other targets.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Hooves or one Horn and one Hooves.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 15 (2d8+6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 24 (4d8+6) piercing damage.

entries.name: Toss
entries: One Large or smaller creature impaled by karkadann is thrown up to 30' in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 ft. it was thrown. If target is thrown at another creature that creature must make DC 15 Dex save or take same damage and be knocked prone.

entries.name: Healing Touch
entries: Touches another creature with its horn. The target magically regains 22 (4d8+2) hp and is cured of all diseases and poisons afflicting it.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Stinging Dust
entries: Is surrounded by a cloud of swirling dust and small stones. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the khamaseen must make DC 12 Con save or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn. On a successful save the creature is immune to the khamaseen's Stinging Dust for the next 24 hrs.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage + 5 (2d4) lightning.

entries.name: Choking Cloud
entries: Surrounds itself with large cloud of dust and debris. Each creature within 10 ft. of the khamaseen must make DC 12 Con save or be incapacitated for 1 min. While incapacitated the creature is unable to breathe and coughs uncontrollably. An incapacitated creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Shock
entries: If a creature wearing metal armor or wielding a metal weapon or shield moves within 5 ft. of khamaseen it takes 5 (2d4) lightning (DC 12 Dex negates).

name: Khargi
languages: understands Abyssal and Infernal but can't speak

entries.name: Deadly Infestation
entries: A creature that touches the khargi or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) poison as stinging insects rise up to protect the khargi.

entries.name: Death Swarms
entries: When it dies the insects crawling across and within it burst from its body forming 2d4 swarms of insects that appear in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. of khargi's space.

entries.name: Infested Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals + 2d6 poison (included below).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite attack and two Leg attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 14 (2d8+5) piercing damage + 7 (2d6) poison.

entries.name: Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d4+5) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) poison.

entries.name: Swarming Breath
entries: Exhales biting stinging insects in a 30' cone. Each creature in that area: 31 (9d6) poison (DC 16 Con half).

entries.name: Adaptive Carapace
entries: When it takes acid cold force lightning or thunder it can magically attune itself to that type of damage. Until end of its next turn khargi has resistance to damage of the triggering type and when it hits with any weapon target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage of the triggering type.

entries.name: Drake Mount
entries: Has formed a bond with Med or larger drake mount (found in this or other books or use the statistics of a giant lizard). Regardless of the drake's intelligence it acts as a controlled mount while carrying a drake rider obeying the rider's spoken commands. Mounting and dismounting the drake costs the drake rider only 5 ft. of movement.

entries.name: Mounted Warrior
entries: While the drake rider is mounted its mount can't be charmed or frightened.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

entries.name: Sure Seat
entries: While mounted and not incapacitated the drake rider can't be knocked prone dismounted or moved vs. its will.

entries.name: Trained Tactics
entries: The drake rider commands its mount to move up to 30' in a straight line moving through the space of any Large or smaller creature and performing one of the following tactical maneuvers. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.Barrel Roll: The mount flies up and over one creature in the line ending its movement at least 10 ft. past the target. As the drake rider hangs upside down at the top of the loop it makes one Spear attack vs. the target with advantage. On a hit the rider rolls damage dice three times. The mount must have a flying speed to use this maneuver.Corkscrew Roll: The mount swims in a corkscrew around the creatures in the line. Each creature in the line must make DC 13 Dex save or be incapacitated with dizziness until the end of its next turn. The mount must have a swimming speed to use this maneuver.Weaving Rush The mount weaves back and forth along the line. Each creature in the line must make DC 13 Str save or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Spear attacks. If the rider is mounted its mount can then make one Bite Claw Slam or Tail attack.

entries.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit 5 ft. or range 20/60' one target 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage or 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Failsafe Equipment
entries: The drake rider wears wing-like arm and feet flaps folded on its back. If its mount dies or it is dismounted the rider descends 60' per round and takes no damage from falling if its mount was flying or it gains a swimming speed of 30' for 1 min if its mount was swimming.

entries.name: Aura of Draconic Virtue
entries: Kobolds within 30' of an empyrean kobold have advantage on attack rolls and ability checks. At the start of each of its turns empyrean kobold can choose to exclude any number of kobolds from this aura (no action required).

entries.name: Elemental Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deal extra 3d8 acid cold fire lightning or poison (included below) kobold's choice.

entries.name: Immortal Nature
entries: Doesn't require food drink or sleep

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Claws. Can replace one Claw with Divine Command.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d6+4) slashing damage + 13 (3d8) acid cold fire lightning or poison (the kobold's choice).

entries.name: Invoke the Dragon Gods
entries: Exhales elemental energy in 60' cone. Each creature in area: 49 (14d6) acid cold fire lightning or poison (the kobold's choice; DC 16 Dex half).

entries.name: Divine Command
entries: Chooses a creature it can see within its Aura of Draconic Virtue and directs a kobold within aura to attack target. Kobold can make one weapon attack vs. target as a reaction.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: Magically turns invisible until it attacks/concentration ends (as if on a spell). Items worn/carried are invisible with it.

entries.name: Draconic Ascension
entries: When a kobold it can see is reduced to 0 hp empyrean can reincarnate the kobold as a wyrmling dragon of a type befitting that kobold and its virtues. Empyrean can provide ascension to up to two kobolds each hr with this reaction.

entries.name: Blessed Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When the hunter hits with any weapon the weapon deals an extra 3d8 radiant (included in the attack).

entries.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: Can see 60' into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane and vice versa.

entries.name: Hidden Hunter
entries: While the ghost hunter remains motionless it is invisible to Undead.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

entries.name: Undead Hunter
entries: Advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find and track Undead.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit 30/120' one target 9 (1d6+6) piercing damage + 13 (3d8) radiant.

entries.name: Flame Jet
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit 5 ft. or range 60' one target 18 (4d6+4) fire. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire the target takes 5 (1d10) fire at the start of each of its turns.

entries.name: Holy Strike
entries: The ghost hunter flips up its eyepatch to reveal a holy relic embedded within the empty socket. Each creature within 30' of the ghost hunter must make a DC 17 Dex save taking 36 (8d8) radiant on a failed save or half damage if made. If an Undead fails the save it is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Shortsword or Hand Crossbow attacks. It can replace one attack with Flame Jet attack.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 9 (1d6+6) piercing damage + 13 (9d8) radiant.

entries.name: Grappling Hook
entries: The ghost hunter launches its grappling hook at a Large or larger object or structure or at a Huge or larger creature it can see within 60' of it and is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the target with o provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Elusive Hunter
entries: Takes the Dodge or Hide action.

entries.name: Flame Burst
entries: When a hostile creature enters a space within 5 ft. of the ghost hunter the hunter can release a burst of fire from its clockwork hand. The creature must make DC 17 Dex save or take 7 (2d6) fire and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes vs. the ghost hunter before the end of the ghost hunter's next turn.

entries.name: Expert Wrestler
entries: Can grapple creatures that are two sizes larger than itself and can move at its full speed when dragging a creature it has grappled. If hunter grapples a Med or smaller creature target has disadvantage on its escape attempts. Hunter has advantage on ability checks and saves made to escape a grapple or end the restrained condition.

entries.name: Hardy Defense
entries: While hunter is wearing no armor and wielding no shield its AC includes its Con modifier.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: Can hold its breath for 30 min.

entries.name: Leviathan Hunter
entries: Advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find and track Large or larger creatures with swimming speed.

entries.name: Marine Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals an extra 2d8 cold or poison (included below) hunter's choice.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: 3 Slams or 1 Harpoon and 2 Slams.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage + 9 (2d8) cold or poison (hunter's choice) and target is grappled (escape DC 17). Hunter can grapple only one target at a time.

entries.name: Harpoon
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit 5 ft. or range 20/60' one target 12 (2d6+5) piercing damage + 9 (2d8) cold or poison (hunter's choice) and harpoon sticks in target. While harpoon is stuck target takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at start of each of its turns hunter can't make Harpoon attacks vs. other targets and target and hunter can't move further than 60' away from each other. A creature including target can take its action to detach harpoon by succeeding on a DC 17 Str check. Alternatively cord connecting the leviathan hunter to the harpoon can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 25; immunity to bludgeoning poison and psychic) dislodging harpoon into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the target and preventing hunter from using Recall Harpoon.

attack.targets: or range 20/60' one target 12 (2d6+5) piercing damage + 9 (2d8) cold or poison (hunter's choice) and harpoon sticks in target

entries.name: Crush
entries: One creature grappled by hunter: 33 (8d6+5) bludgeoning damage (DC 17 Str half).

entries.name: Recall Harpoon
entries: Pulls on the cord connected to its harpoon returning harpoon to its empty hand. If harpoon is stuck in a creature that creature must make DC 17 Str save or be pulled up to 20' toward the hunter.

entries.name: Grappled Redirect
entries: If it is target of an attack it can see while grappling a creature it can hold the grappled creature in the way and the grappled creature becomes attack's target instead.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

entries.name: Planar Attunement
entries: At the start of each of its turns it chooses one of the following damage types: acid cold fire lightning necrotic radiant or thunder. It has resistance to the chosen damage type until start of its next turn.

entries.name: Planar Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals extra 3d8 damage of the type chosen with Planar Attunement (included below).

entries.name: Planes Hunter
entries: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find and track Celestials Fiends and Elementals.

entries.name: Snaring Blade
entries: If it scores a critical hit vs. a creature target can't use any method of extradimensional movement including teleportation or travel to a different plane of existence for 1 min. The creature can make a DC 16 Cha save at the end of each of its turns ending effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Longsword attacks.

entries.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (1d8+4) slashing damage or 9 (1d10+4) slashing damage if used with two hands + 13 (3d8) acid cold fire lightning necrotic radiant or thunder (see Planar Attunement).

entries.name: Warping Whirlwind
entries: Bends reality around it slicing nearby creatures with sword strikes from across the planes. Each creature within 10 ft. of the planes hunter must make a DC 16 Dex save taking 18 (4d8) slashing damage and 18 (4d8) acid cold fire lightning necrotic radiant or thunder (see Planar Attunement) on a failed save or half damage if made.

entries.name: Planar Traveler
entries: Can transport itself to a different plane of existence. This works like the plane shift spell except hunter can only affect itself and can't use this action to banish an unwilling creature to another plane.

entries.name: Planar Step
entries: Teleports along with any equipment up to 30' to an unoccupied spot it sees. Glowing swirls of elemental energy appear at origin and destination when it uses this.

entries.name: Parry
entries: + 4 to its AC vs. one melee attack that would hit it if it can see attacker and wielding melee weapon.

entries.name: Crafty
entries: The sapper has advantage on ability checks made to pick locks or to detect disarm or set traps.

entries.name: Evasion
entries: If subject to effect that allows Dex save for half damage takes no damage on success and only half if it fails.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries: Double damage to objects/structures.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: 3 Mining Picks. Can replace 1 with Throw Explosive.

entries.name: Mining Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Throw Explosive
entries: Throws a minor explosive at one creature it can see within 30' of it. Target: 9 (2d8) force and is knocked prone (DC 13 Dex half damage and isn't knocked prone).

entries.name: Explosive Charge
entries: Throws a powerful explosive at a point it can see on the ground within 60' of it. Each creature within 15 ft. of that point: 9 (2d8) fire and 9 (2d8) force and is pushed up to 10 ft. away from the point and knocked prone (DC 13 Dex half damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone). If creature fails save by 5+ it is also deafened for 1 min. Alternatively sapper can place the explosive in a space within 5 ft. of it and delay the explosion until end of sapper's next turn or when a creature moves to a space within 5 ft. of the explosive whichever happens first.

entries.name: Toxic Ichor
entries: While submerged in water it's ichor taints water within 10 ft. of it. When a creature enters area for the 1st time on a turn or starts its turn there that creature must make DC 15 Con save or be poisoned while it remains in area and for 1 min after it leaves. A poisoned creature that is no longer in the water can re-save at end of each of its turns ending effect on itself on a success. If purify food and drink spell is cast on a space within 5 ft. of lotus or on space it occupies trait ceases to function for 1 min.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Waterwalker
entries: Can walk across surface of water as if it were solid ground. Otherwise works like water walk but isn't itself magical.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Tainted Claw or Poisonous Water Jet attacks.

entries.name: Tainted Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage + 9 (2d8) poison and target poisoned 1 min (DC 15 Con negates poison). A poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Poisonous Water Jet
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 15 (3d8+2) poison.

entries.name: Enter Reflection
entries: Touches a body of water large enough to hold it and becomes a reflection on water's surface. While in this form has immunity to B/P/S damage from nonmagical attacks and resistance to B/P/S from magical attacks. While a reflection speed is 5 ft. can't use Tainted Claw and can revert to its true form as a bonus action. If it takes damage that isn't bludgeoning piercing or slashing while a reflection forced back into its true form.

name: Leashed Lesion
languages: understands Void Speech but can't speak

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage + 5 (2d4) necrotic. The lesion and any creature grappled by its Life Tether regain hp equal to the necrotic dealt.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Draining Burst
entries: Selects a point it can see within 120' of it. Each creature within 20' of that point must make a DC 12 Con save taking 13 (3d8) necrotic on a failed save or half damage if made. The lesion and any creature grappled by its Life Tether each gain 13 (3d8) temp hp.

entries.name: Life Tether
entries: Attaches a symbiotic tether to a creature sitting in the recess in its back. A creature in the recess that isn't attached to the tether takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the end of the lesion's turn and the lesion regains hp equal to the damage dealt. While the tether is attached the creature is grappled by the lesion. The lesion or the creature can detach the tether as a bonus action. Lesion can have its symbiotic tether attached to only one creature at a time.

entries.name: Sense Magic
entries: Senses magic within 120' of it at will. This otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Slam or Psychic Lash attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d8+2) bludgeoning damage + 9 (2d8) psychic.

entries.name: Psychic Lash
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit 5 ft. or range 120' one target 17 (3d8+4) psychic.

entries.name: Dispelling Burst
entries: Emits a psychic burst that disrupts magic within 30' of it. Each creature in the area: 27 (6d8) psychic (DC 15 Int half). Each spell of 3rd level or lower in the area immediately ends and wanderer gains 5 temp hp for each spell ended this way.

entries.name: Teleport
entries: Magically teleports itself and up to six willing creatures holding hands with wanderer with items worn/carried to location it is familiar with up to 100 miles away. If destination is a location rich in magical energy (ex: ley line) can teleport up to 300 miles away.

entries.name: Drain Magic Item
entries: Drains the magic from an item it is holding. Magic item with charges loses 1d6 charges item with limited uses per day loses one daily use and single-use item such as potion or spell scroll is destroyed. All other magic items have their effects suppressed for 1 min. Wanderer gains 5 temp hp each time it drains a magic item. A drained item regains its magic after 24 hrs.

entries.name: Absorb Spell
entries: When a creature wanderer can see within 30' of it casts spell wanderer can absorb spell's energy countering it. Works like counterspell except wanderer must always make spellcasting ability check no matter spell's level. Its ability check for this is +7. If it successfully counters the spell it gains 5 temp hp/spell level.

resistances.name: nonmagic B/P/S attacks not made w/cold iron weapons

entries.name: Draw Life Essence
entries: Can spend 10 min coaxing life essence out of willing creature taking only agreed amount of time from creature's max lifetime. Essence appears as rosy mist that rises from mouth nose or skin of creature and snakes into carved crystal vial in broker's cloak where it takes the form of a crimson liquid. Creature that drinks such a vial gains life stored within it provided broker gave vial willingly. If broker draws all remaining life from creature creature dies and can be returned to life only via wish spell.

entries.name: Life Reading
entries: If it spends 1 min studying a mortal creature it can see within 30' of it broker can determine the remainder of that creature's natural life to the second.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Necrotic Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals + 4d8 necrotic (included below).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Rapier attacks.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage + 18 (4d8) necrotic.

entries.name: Life Feast
entries: Pulls life from hostile creatures within 30' of it that aren't Constructs or Undead. Each such creature in the area: 36 (8d8) necrotic (DC 18 Con half). Broker gains temp hp equal to the single highest amount of necrotic dealt and has advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Quick-Footed
entries: Takes Dash Disengage or Dodge.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from normal rock.

entries.name: Light Absorption
entries: When it starts its turn within 5 ft. of a source of light light is reduced while eater remains within 100' of light source. Bright light becomes dim and dim becomes darkness. If eater reduces light source's light to darkness eater sheds multicolored bright light in 20' radius and dim light for additional 20' for 1 hr and light source is extinguished if it is nonmagical flame or dispelled if it was created by 2nd level or lower spell.

entries.name: Light Sense
entries: Can pinpoint location of any light source within 100' of it and sense general direction of any within 1 mile.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Emergency Flare (Recharges: Short/Long Rest)
entries: When it takes damage can emit brilliant flash of light. Each creature within 30': blinded 1 min (DC 12 Con negates). Blinded creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Brittle
entries: If it takes cold it partially freezes; its speed is reduced by 10 ft. and its AC is reduced by 2 until end of its next turn.

entries.name: Choking Air Form
entries: Can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there and it can move through a space as narrow as 1ft. wide with o squeezing. In addition when creature starts turn in same space as soot creature: 7 (2d6) poison and be unable to breathe until it starts its turn outside soot's space (DC 15 Con negates).

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from tangled mass of blackened dusty webbing.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slams or one Slam and one Constrict.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) poison.

entries.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends target is restrained and soot can't Constrict another target.

attack.targets: Until this grapple ends target is restrained and soot can't Constrict another target

entries.name: Engulfing Sootstorm
entries: Spins violently in place spreading out tendrils of thick poisonous ash. Each creature within 20' of it:21 (6d6) poison and speed is halved (DC 15 Dex half damage and speed isn't reduced). Speed reduction lasts until creature uses action cleaning off the ash.

entries.name: Danger From Above
entries: If it jumps 10 ft.+ straight toward a creature from a higher position than the target such as leaping down from a tree it has advantage on next attack roll it makes vs. that creature.

entries.name: Standing Leap
entries: Its long jump is up to 30' and its high jump is up to 15 ft. with or with o a running start.

entries.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Claw Swipes or one Face Clamp and two Claw Swipes.

entries.name: Claw Swipe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 9 (2d4+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Face Clamp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 9 (2d4+4) piercing damage and lemur attaches to target's head. If lemur is already attached to the target when it hits with this attack it doesn't deal damage. Instead target is blinded until end of its next turn. While attached to the target lemur can attack no other creature except target but has advantage on its attack rolls. Lemur's speed also becomes 0 it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed and it moves with target. Creature including target can use action to detach lemur via DC 14 Str check. On its turn lemur can detach itself from target by using 5 ft. of move.

attack.targets: Lemur's speed also becomes 0 it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed and it moves with target

damage: and slashing attacks not made with silvered weapons

entries.name: Hold Breath (Crocodile or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Can hold its breath for 15 min.

entries.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Two Tail Swipe or Khopesh attacks or it makes one Bite and one Tail Swipe.

entries.name: Bite (Crocodile or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d10+2) piercing damage and target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends the target is restrained and werecrocodile can't bite another. If target is a Humanoid it must make DC 12 Con save or be cursed with werecrocodile lycanthropy.

entries.name: Tail Swipe (Crocodile or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit 5 ft. 1 tgt not grappled by werecrocodile. 7 (2d4+2) bludgeoning damage and target knocked prone (DC 12 Str negates prone).

entries.name: Khopesh (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d8+2) slashing damage or 7 (1d10+2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: Transforms into a Large crocodile or into a crocodile-humanoid hybrid or back into its true form which is Humanoid. Its stats other than size are the same in each form. Any equipment worn/carried isn't transformed. Reverts to its true form if it dies.

damage: and slashing attacks not made with silvered weapons

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: Can hold its breath for 10 min.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Javelin attacks or one Bite attack and two Javelins. It can replace one Javelin with Net.

entries.name: Bite (Otter or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid is cursed with wereotter lycanthropy (DC 11 Con negates curse).

entries.name: Javelin (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit 5 ft. or range 30/120' one target 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Net (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit 5/15 ft. one target Large or smaller creature hit by net is restrained until freed. Net has no effect on creatures that are formless or Huge or larger. Creature including target can use action to free restrained target via DC 11 Str check. Dealing 5 slashing to net (AC 10) frees target with o harming it ending effect and destroying net.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: Transforms into a Med otter-humanoid hybrid or into Large otter or back into true form: Humanoid. Stats other than size are same in each form. Items worn/ carried not transformed. Reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

entries.name: Metal Sense
entries: Can pinpoint by scent location of any Small or larger ferrous metal such as an iron deposit or steel armor within 100' of it. It can sense general direction of such metal within 1 mile.

entries.name: Tunneler
entries: Can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 15-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

entries.name: Mulitattack
entries: Makes one Bite and two Adamantine Claws.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 34 (5d10+7) piercing damage and target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until grapple ends target restrained attacker can't Bite another.

entries.name: Adamantine Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 29 (5d8+7) slashing damage. This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Metal Volley
entries: Shakes itself launching shards from its hide. Each creature within 20 feet: 45 (13d6) slashing damage (DC 18 Dex half).

entries.name: Metal Eater
entries: Swallows one Med or smaller ferrous metal object within 5 ft. of it. If the object is being held or worn by a creature that creature must make DC 18 Str save or malmbjorn swallows the object. If the creature holding or wearing the object is also grappled by the malmbjorn it has disadvantage on this save. Nonmagical objects are digested and destroyed at the start of malmbjorn's next turn. Magic objects remain intact in malmbjorn's stomach for 8 hrs then are destroyed. Artifacts are never destroyed in this way.

entries.name: Ironhide
entries: When hit by a metal weapon fur-like metal spikes grow out of its hide until end of its next turn. While spikes remain its AC increases 2 and any critical hit vs. it becomes a normal hit.

entries.name: Keen Sight
entries: Advantage: sight Wis (Percept) checks.

entries.name: Snake Hunter
entries: Has advantage on saves vs. being poisoned.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 1 piercing.

entries.name: Corral
entries: A creature in the swarm's space must make DC 12 Dex save to leave its space. The creature has advantage on its save if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

entries.name: Keen Sight
entries: Advantage: sight Wis (Percept) checks.

entries.name: Snake Hunter
entries: Has advantage on saves vs. being poisoned.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: Can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny meerkat. Swarm can't regain hp or gain temp hp.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 0 ft., one creature, in the swarm's space. 10 (4d4) piercing damage or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

entries.name: Grassland Camouflage
entries: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in grassland terrain.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

entries.name: Pounce
entries: If the megantereon moves at least 20' straight toward a creature and then hits with Claw attack on the same turn that target must make DC 14 Str save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone the megantereon can make one Bite attack vs. it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Running Leap
entries: With a 10 ft. running start the megantereon can long jump up to 20'.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an Undead or Construct it must make DC 12 Con save or lose 2 (1d4) hp at the start of each of its turns due to a bleeding wound. The creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with successful DC 12 Wis (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Changing Form
entries: Automatically changes based on presence light.Day Form. While more than half midnight sun is in darkness it appears as a glowing orb of light but sheds no light. In this form it deals radiant has immunity to radiant and vulnerability to necrotic.Night Form. While more than half the midnight sun is in bright or dim light it appears as an orb of darkness. In this form it deals necrotic has immunity to necrotic and has vulnerability to radiant.Twilight Form. While half of it is in bright or dim light and half is in darkness it appears as split orb of light and darkness. It deals force.

entries.name: Energy Being
entries: Can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide with o squeezing and it can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn that creature takes 3 (1d6) damage of the type determined by the sun's current form.

entries.name: Reality Inversion
entries: When creature starts turn in sun's space or within 5 ft. any circumstance trait or feature that would grant it advantage instead grants disadvantage and vice versa until start of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Energy Blast attacks.

entries.name: Energy Blast
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit 5 ft. or range 120' one target 14 (3d6+4) damage of the type determined by the sun's current form.

entries.name: Energy Pulse
entries: Each creature within 15 ft. of it: 28 (8d6) damage of type determined by sun's form (DC 15 Con half).

entries.name: Mindleech Aura
entries: When a charmed creature enters a space within 15 ft. of the mindshard on a turn or starts its turn within 15 ft. of the mindshard that creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic.

entries.name: Translucent
entries: Is invisible to creatures more than 60' away from it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Refracted Light Beam attacks.

entries.name: Refracted Light Beam
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit 5 ft. or range 60' one target 10 (2d6+3) radiant.

entries.name: Light Construction
entries: Bends light toward a point it can see within 60' of it creating a colorful pattern on that point. Each creature within 20' of that point: 14 (4d6) psychic and is charmed and incapacitated for 1 min (DC 14 Wis half damage and isn't charmed or incapacitated). A charmed and incapacitated creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Refract Mind
entries: Pulls a Humanoid with 0 hp into its body refracting creature into fragments of itself. Humanoid dies and 2d4 cultists appear in unoccupied spaces within 15 ft. of mindshard. The cultists which share Humanoid's appearance and memories act as allies of mindshard and obey its telepathic commands. A Humanoid must have an Int score of 5 or higher to be refracted.

entries.name: Enthralling Defense
entries: When a creature the mindshard can see within 30' of it hits it with an attack that creature must make DC 14 Cha save or be charmed until end of its next turn.

entries.name: Charge
entries: If it moves 10 ft.+ straight to foe and hits with gore attack on same turn target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature it must make DC 14 Str save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

entries.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: Can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

entries.name: Ravening Hunger
entries: When it reduces a creature to 0 hp with melee attack on its turn can take a bonus action to consume creature's heart. Its hp max increases by 5 for every ten hearts it consumes in this way.

entries.name: Ravening Madness
entries: Disadvantage on Int checks and saves. Considers every creature hostile and doesn't benefit from Help action or similar spells/effects that involve help to/from friendly creatures. Doesn't stop spellcaster from restoring hp to it or curing ravening with magic.

entries.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn it can choose to have advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn but attack rolls vs. it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite and two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage and minotaur gains temp hp equal to damage. Target: DC 13 Con save or infected with ravening (below).

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from normal vine.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Tendril attacks.

entries.name: Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 20 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends the creature is restrained and takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The monkey's bane vine has two tendrils each of which can grapple only one target.

attack.targets: The monkey's bane vine has two tendrils each of which can grapple only one target

entries.name: Lubricious Plumage
entries: Its skin exudes an oil that permeates its plumage. The moon weaver can't be restrained by magical or nonmagical webbing and it ignores all movement restrictions caused by webbing.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Emboldening Song
entries: Delivers a burst of beautiful song that motivates and emboldens one friendly creature the moon weaver can see within 60' of it. If the target can hear the song it gains one Embolden die a d6. Once within the next 10 min the target can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check attack roll or save it makes.

resistances.name: piercing or slashing from nonmagical attacks not made w/silvered weapons

entries.name: Deathly Origins
entries: Can be turned and damaged by holy water as Undead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Nightmare Leap
entries: Once on its turn can use half its move to step magically into dreams of sleeping creature within 5 ft. of it. Emerges from dreams of another sleeper within 1 mile of 1st appearing in unoccupied space within 5 ft. of 2nd. Each sleeper suffers a level of exhaustion as nightmares prevent restful sleep (DC 14 Wis negates). Creature that fails save by 5+ also suffers long-term madness.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Briny Embrace if it has a creature grappled. Then two Claws or one Bite and one Claw.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage and target is grappled (escape DC 14). It has two claws each of which can grapple only one target.

attack.targets: It has two claws each of which can grapple only one target

entries.name: Briny Embrace
entries: Fills lungs of a creature grappled by it with seawater. Creature:  DC 14 Con save or begin suffocating. A suffocating but conscious creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. Effect also ends if creature escapes grapple.

entries.name: Whispered Terrors
entries: Bombards the minds of up to 3 creatures it can see within 60' of it with nightmares: 18 (4d8) psychic and frightened until end of its next turn (DC 14 Wis half not frightened). If creature fails by 5+ also suffers short-term madness.

entries.name: Alien Nature
entries: Doesn't require air or sleep.

entries.name: Transparent
entries: Advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks while motionless or in dim light.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Dissolving Bite attack and one Tendrils attack.

entries.name: Dissolving Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage + 9 (2d8) acid and the moonweb regains hp equal to the acid dealt.

entries.name: Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one creature,. 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage and target paralyzed for 1 min (DC 14 Con not paralyzed). Target can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Etheric Pulse
entries: Releases burst of ethereal energy. Each creature within 30' of it: DC 14 Con save or become partially ethereal. A partially ethereal creature's attacks deal normal damage to the moonweb even if the attacks are nonmagical but all other creatures have resistance to the partially ethereal creature's nonmagical damage. Also moonweb can pinpoint location of partially ethereal creature and moonweb has advantage on attack rolls vs. it. A partially ethereal creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: Magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

name: Moppet
languages: understands one language known by its creator but can't speak

entries.name: Construct Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: False
entries: [+]Appearance[/+] Motionless: indistinguishable from normal doll.

entries.name: Psychic Pool
entries: Absorbs psychic energy from creatures in its nightmare holding up to four Psychic Points. As a bonus action while casting a spell within 5 ft. of moppet owner can expend points equal to spell's level to cast with o using spell slot.

entries.name: Psychic Burst
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit 5 ft. or range 60' one target 9 (2d6+2) psychic. If moppet scores a critical hit it gains one Psychic Point.

entries.name: Waking Nightmare
entries: Each creature with Int 3+ within 60' of moppet: DC 13 Int save. Fail: creature enters collective fugue state with all that failed unconscious but doesn't drop anything held/fall prone. All in fugue face hostile nightmare creature with brown bear's stats but deals psychic instead of piercing or slashing. Creature appearance is up to GM but should reflect mutual fears of affected creatures. Fight with nightmare creature works as normal except all action takes place in minds of affected. When affected creature is reduced to 0 hp moppet gains one Psychic Point. If nightmare creature or moppet is reduced to 0 hp all in fugue awaken. Spell slots or class features used in nightmare combat are expended but magic item charges or uses aren't. If creature in fugue takes damage from source other than nightmare creature can immediately re-save with advantage success ends effect on itself. If creature's save is succeeds/effect ends for it creature immune to moppet's Waking Nightmare next 24 hrs.

entries.name: Nimble Moves
entries: Takes the Dash or Disengage action.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: Can breathe air and water.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from bed of lotus flowers.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Poisonous Tendrils
entries: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the mortifera must make DC 15 Con save or be poisoned for 1 min. A poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Fanged Tentacles and two Slams or it makes three Slams. It can replace two Slams with Chomp.

entries.name: Fanged Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 9 (2d4+4) piercing damage + 9 (2d8) poison and target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends the target is restrained and mortifera can't use its Fanged Tentacles on another.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (1d12+4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Chomp
entries: One creature grappled by mortifera is pulled up to 5 ft. to mortifera's central maw which chomps on creature. Target: 10 (3d6) piercing damage and 13 (3d8) poison (DC 15 Str half).

entries.name: Poison Spray

entries.name: Bog Melt
entries: A creature afflicted with bog melt curse can't regain hp and its hp max is reduced by 7 (2d6) for every 24 hrs that elapse. Also when cursed creature starts its turn within 30' of a creature it can see it has a 50% chance of going into a rage until end of its turn. While raged cursed creature must attack nearest creature. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack cursed creature stalks off in a random direction seeking a target for its rage. Curse lasts until lifted by remove curse spell or similar. If curse reduces creature's hp max to 0 creature dies and body dissolves into viscous puddle of goo. Carnivorous creatures with an Int of 3 or lower that can see or smell the goo must make DC 15 Wis save or drink the goo. After 1 min creature's Bite Claw or Slam attack becomes infused with the curse and any creature hit by that attack: DC 15 Con save or be cursed with bog melt.

Muraenid can also use this action to exert fine control on objects such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

If target suffers any harm can re-save success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: False
entries: [+]Appearance[/+] Motionless: indistinguishable from ordinary tree.

entries.name: Vegetative Clone
entries: A vegetative clone resembles the creature hit by the nariphon's Thorn attack. Each clone uses stats of an awakened tree except it has the target's size speed and any special senses such as darkvision. Clones are extensions of the nariphon and it can see and hear what a clone sees and hears as if it was in the clone's space. The nariphon can switch from using its senses to using a clone's or back again as a bonus action. Nariphon can have no more than six vegetative clones under its control at one time. Each clone remains until killed or until the nariphon dismisses it (no action required).

entries: Four Roots or Thorns attacks.

entries.name: Roots
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 18 (2d10+7) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until the grapple ends target is restrained and it takes 3 (1d6) poison at the start of each of its turns. The nariphon has four roots each of which can grapple only one target.

attack.targets: The nariphon has four roots each of which can grapple only one target

entries.name: Thorns
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit 30/120' one target 17 (3d6+7) piercing damage and target must make DC 18 Wis save or thorn falls to the ground and instantly grows into a vegetative clone (see above) under nariphon's control.

entries.name: Bury
entries: One creature grappled by nariphon is knocked prone dragged into ground and buried just below surface ending grapple. Victim is restrained unable to breathe or stand up. Creature including victim can use action to free buried creature via DC 18 Str.

entries.name: Elemental Traveler
entries: Doesn't require air food drink sleep or ambient pressure.

entries.name: Enchanted Shell
entries: A dome of magic covers the nautiloid just large enough to contain its shell. The nautiloid can control the ambient pressure temperature water levels and breathable air levels (for air-breathing passengers) inside allowing creatures and objects within it to exist comfortably in spite of conditions outside. Creatures and objects within the shell have total cover vs. attacks and other effects outside the nautiloid. Creatures inside the shell can exit whenever they want but nothing can pass into the shell's dome unless the nautiloid allows it. Area inside dome is a magnificent palace carved into nautiloid's shell complete with open ‘air' balconies used as entrances/exits and numerous covered chambers that can comfortably hold up to 50 passengers. Palace is 60' long 30' wide and 80' tall. When it dies any creatures inside dome are expelled into unoccupied spaces near the closest exit.

entries.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The nautiloid can magically communicate simple ideas emotions and images telepathically with any creature inside the magical dome that surrounds it shell. Similarly it can hear and understand any creature inside the dome regardless of the language it speaks.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 21 (3d10+5) piercing damage + 9 (2d8) poison.

entries.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 30 ft., one target, 18 (2d12+5) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends target is restrained nautiloid can automatically hit target with its Tentacles and nautiloid can't make Tentacles attacks vs. other targets.

entries.name: Jet Propulsion
entries: Releases a magical burst of pressure that propels it backwards in a line that is 90' long and 10 ft. wide. Each creature within 15 ft. of the space the nautiloid left and each creature in that line must make a DC 18 Con save. On a failure a creature takes 45 (10d8) force and is pushed up to 20' away from the nautiloid and knocked prone. On a success a creature takes half the damage but isn't pushed or knocked prone.

entries.name: Withdraw
entries: When a creature the nautiloid can see targets it with an attack the nautiloid can pull its body into its shell gaining a +5 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn.

name: Necrotech Bonecage Constrictor
languages: understands Common and Darakhul but can't speak

entries.name: Necrotic Prison
entries: Creatures restrained by its Encage automatically stabilize at 0 hp and take no further damage from Encage. If creature damaged from another source while restrained suffers death save failure as normal but immediately stabilizes if not its final death save.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage + 7 (2d6) necrotic.

entries.name: Encage
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage. If target is a Med or smaller creature DC 16 Dex save or be caged within body of bonecage constrictor. Caged creature is restrained has cover vs. attacks and other effects outside constrictor and it takes 10 (3d6) necrotic at start of each of constrictor's turns. While caged creature can see outside constrictor but can't target those outside constrictor with attacks or spells nor can it cast spells or use features that allow it to leave constrictor's body. In addition creatures caged within constrictor can't make attack rolls vs. creatures outside constrictor. Constrictor can have up to 6 Med or smaller creatures restrained at a time. If constrictor takes 20+ damage on a single turn from any source it must make DC 16 Con save at end of that turn or all caged creatures fall prone in a space within 10 ft. of constrictor. If any of the damage is thunder constrictor has disadvantage on the save. If constrictor dies caged creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from corpse via 10 ft. of move exiting prone.

entries.name: Crush

If a creature is within 5 ft. of both points it has disadvantage on the save but it takes damage from only one effect not both.

entries.name: Concentrated Shot

entries.name: Gasp to Survive
entries: Chooses a creature it dealt psychic to within last min. Target: 14 (4d6) psychic and believes it is suffocating including choking and being unable to speak (DC 15 Wis half damage and doesn't believe it is suffocating). At the start of each of suffocating creature's turns it must make a DC 15 Wis save. It has disadvantage on this save if it took psychic since start of its prior turn. If it fails three such saves before succeeding on three such saves it falls unconscious for 1 hr returns to breathing normally and stops making this save. On its third successful save effect ends for the creature.
