entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (1d8+4) slashing damage or 9 (1d10+4) slashing damage if used with 2 hands + 13 (3d8) necrotic or radiant (commander's choice).

entries.name: Battle Cry
entries: Commander shouts a frightful and rallying battle cry. Each hostile creature within 30 of it that can hear the cry: DC 16 Wis save or be frightened for 1 min. A frightened creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. Each friendly creature within 30' of the commander and that can hear the cry has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before start of commander's next turn.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: Cha (DC 16): At will: command protection from evil and good3/day ea: cure wounds (level 3) find steed (as an action)1/day: revivify

entries.name: Bolster Soldier
entries: When a friendly creature the field commander can see is hit with weapon attack the commander calls out encouragement and creature gains 5 (1d10) temp hp.

spells.name: command protection from evil and good
cure wounds (level 3) find steed (as an action)

warnings: compact spell list; spell separators absent in source

entries.name: Armor of Foresight
entries: While it is wearing no armor and wielding no shield its AC includes its Dex and Wis modifiers (included above).

entries.name: Divine Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals extra 3d8 necrotic or radiant (included below) servant's choice.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Uses its Awe-Inspiring Presence. Then 3 Divine Bursts or 1 Blinding Rod and 2 Divine Bursts. It can replace one attack with Spellcasting.

entries.name: Blinding Rod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (2d6+1) bludgeoning damage + 13 (3d8) necrotic or radiant (the first servant's choice) and target must make DC 17 Con save or be blinded and deafened until end of its next turn.

entries.name: Divine Burst
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit 5 ft. or range 120' one target 23 (4d8+5) necrotic or radiant (the first servant's choice).

entries.name: Awe-Inspiring Presence
entries: Each creature of servant's choice within 30' of it and aware of it: DC 17 Wis save or unable to use bonus actions or reactions until start of servant's next turn.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: Wis (DC 17): At will: bane protection from evil and good spare the dying thaumaturgy3/day ea: cure wounds (level 5) dispel evil and good divination speak with dead1/day ea: commune (as an action) holy aura resurrection

entries.name: Healing Hands
entries: Touches a creature within 5 ft. of it: creature regains 14 (4d6) hp.

spells.name: bane protection from evil and good spare the dying thaumaturgy
cure wounds (level 5) dispel evil and good divination speak with dead
commune (as an action) holy aura resurrection

warnings: compact spell list; spell separators absent in source

entries.name: Ritual Cleansing
entries: The fixer can take 10 min to perform a cleansing ritual on a creature object or an area within 30' that is no larger than a 20' cube. For the next 8 hrs the affected creature or object is hidden from divination magic as if it was under the effects of the nondetection spell. In an area that is ritually cleansed divination spells of 4th level or lower don't function and creatures within the area can't be scried.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Shortsword or Sling attacks.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage + 3 (1d6) poison.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit 30/120' one target 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage + 3 (1d6) poison.

entries.name: Cleaner
entries: Can cast the prestidigitation and unseen servant spells at will requiring no material components and using Wis as the spellcasting ability

entries.name: Burning Cold
entries: A creature with resistance to cold doesn't have resistance to the cold dealt by the frost-afflicted. A creature with immunity to cold is unaffected by this trait.

entries.name: Icy Nature
entries: The frost-afflicted is infused with minor elemental power and it requires only half the amount of food and drink that a typical humanoid of its size needs.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Frigid Punch or Frost Bolt attacks.

entries.name: Frigid Punch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 4 (1d4+2) bludgeoning damage and 5 (2d4) cold.

entries.name: Frost Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) cold.

entries.name: Frigid Flare
entries: When a creature hits the frost-afflicted with weapon attack ice bursts from the frost-afflicted. Each creature within 5 ft. of the frost-afflicted must make a DC 13 Con save taking 5 (2d4) cold on a failed save or half damage if made.

entries.name: Evasion
entries: If subject to effect that allows Dex save for half damage takes no damage on success and only half if it fails.

entries.name: Parasite Sense
entries: Advantage on attacks vs. poisoned creatures.

entries.name: Plant-Powered Mobility
entries: Opportunity attacks made vs. duelist have disadvantage. If the duelist is prone at the start of its turn it can immediately stand with o costing movement.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Slam attack and two Shortsword attacks or it makes two Thorn Shot attacks.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 9 (1d6+6) piercing damage.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 15 (2d8+6) bludgeoning damage and target: DC 15 Con save. On failure target takes 14 (4d6) poison and is poisoned 1 min. On success target takes half damage and isn't poisoned. Poisoned target can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Thorn Shot
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit 30/120' one target 10 (2d4+5) piercing damage + 7 (2d6) poison.

entries.name: Spore Cloud
entries: When it takes damage from a ranged attack emits a burst of thick yellow spores that surround infested duelist and heavily obscure area within 5 ft. of it. Spores dissipate at start of duelist's next turn.

entries.name: Knowledge Charm
entries: Carries a minor magical charm gifted to it by the organization. While wearing or carrying the charm infiltrator has proficiency in any two skills and is fluent in any one language (not included above). This proficiency and fluency last until charm is lost or destroyed or until infiltrator performs a 10-minute ritual to change the proficiency and fluency provided by the charm. If infiltrator dies charm becomes nonmagical.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Shortsword attacks and one Dagger attack. It can replace one attack with Spellcasting.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit 5 ft. or range 20/60' one target 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit 80/320' one target 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: Int (DC 13): At will: mage hand message minor illusion3/day ea: charm person sleep1/day: invisibility

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries: Takes the Dash Disengage or Hide action.

warnings: compact spell list; spell separators absent in source

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Uses Fast Talk then three Rapier or Quip attacks. It can replace one attack with use of Spellcasting.

entries.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage + 7 (2d6) poison.

entries.name: Quip
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 14 (3d6+4) psychic.

entries.name: Fast Talk
entries: The merchant captain baffles a creature it can see within 30' of it with barrage of jargon quick speech and big words. The target must make DC 15 Cha save or have disadvantage on the next Wis save it makes before the end of the merchant captain's next turn.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: Cha (DC 15): At will: comprehend languages mage hand mending3/day ea: calm emotions enthrall heroism1/day ea: confusion freedom of movement

entries.name: Inspiration
entries: When a creature within 30' of the merchant captain fails an attack roll ability check or save the captain can force it to reroll the die. The target must use the new roll.

warnings: compact spell list; spell separators absent in source

name: Npc: Warlock Of The Genie Lord

entries.name: Elemental Weapons
entries: When it hits with any weapon deals extra 3d6 acid cold fire lightning or thunder (included below) warlock's choice.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Elemental Burst or Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with use of Spellcasting.

entries.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit 5 ft. or range 20/60' one target 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage + 10 (3d6) acid cold fire lightning or thunder (warlock's choice).

entries.name: Elemental Burst
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit 5 ft. or range 120' one target 14 (3d6+4) acid cold fire lightning or thunder (warlock's choice).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: Cha (DC 15). At will: levitate water breathing3/day ea: fire shield fly gust of wind1/day ea: conjure minor elementals (as an action) wall of stone

entries.name: Genie Lord's Favor
entries: When it takes acid cold fire lightning or thunder warlock has advantage on next Elemental Burst attack it makes before end of its next turn provided Elemental Burst deals same damage as damage warlock took.

spells.name: fire shield fly gust of wind
conjure minor elementals (as an action) wall of stone

warnings: compact spell list; spell separators absent in source

entries.name: Air Senses
entries: Can't use blindsight underwater or in an area with o air.

entries.name: Air Weapons
entries: When it attacks it conjures a weapon out of the air itself weapon appearing and disappearing in the blink of an eye. Air weapon is a swirl of wind in the shape of a simple or martial weapon but always deals 2d6 damage of the same type as that weapon. Air weapon shaped like a ranged weapon uses the range of that weapon except acolyte doesn't have disadvantage on ranged attack rolls when attacking a target beyond weapon's normal range. Air weapons don't use any other weapon properties of weapons they mimic. Air weapon attacks are magical.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Air Weapon attacks. If acolyte hits one creature with two Air Weapon attacks target: DC 15 Str save or be pushed up to 15 ft. away from acolyte.

entries.name: Air Weapon
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit 10 ft. or range defined by chosen weapon one target 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage slashing or piercing as defined by chosen weapon.

entries.name: Wind's Rebuke
entries: Draws breath out of one creature it can see within 60' of it. Target: DC 15 Con save. Fail: all of the breath is drawn from target's lungs and it immediately begins suffocating for 1 min or until it falls unconscious. It can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Buoying Wind
entries: Summons winds to break the fall of up to 5 falling creatures it can see within 60' of it. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60' per round for 1 min. If a falling creature lands before effect ends it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet.

entries.name: Drift
entries: When a creature moves to within 15 ft. of the wind acolyte the acolyte can fly up to half its flying speed.

entries.name: Magic Evasion
entries: If it is subjected to a spell or magical effect that allows it to make a save to take only half damage it instead takes no damage if it makes the save and only half damage if it fails.

entries.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: At the end of its turn any spell or magical effect with duration that is affecting the nullicorn such as hold monster or mage armor immediately ends.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Nullifying Blight
entries: A creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms 1d4 hrs after infection: fatigue light-headedness and blurry vision. When infected creature casts a spell or activates a magic item itchy rash appears and spreads as more magic is used. Until disease is cured when infected creature starts its turn wielding or wearing magic item and each time it casts a spell or activates a magic item it loses 5 (2d4) hp. At end of each long rest infected creature must make a DC 13 Con save. Fail: hp the creature loses each time it uses magic increases by 2 (1d4). A creature that makes 3 saves recovers.

entries.name: Sense Magic
entries: Senses magic within 120' of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Hooves attacks and one Void Horn attack.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Void Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (1d8+4) force and target must make DC 13 Con save or contract the nullifying blight disease (above).

entries.name: Ripple of darkness
entries: Each creature within 20' of the nullicorn: 18 (4d8) necrotic and contracts the nullifying blight disease (above; DC 13 Con half and doesn't contract it).

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary oak tree.

entries.name: Grasping Branches
entries: Can have up to six Grasping Branches at a time. Each Grasping Branch can be attacked (AC 16; 25 hp; vulnerability to lightning; immunity to poison and psychic). Destroying a Grasping Branch deals no damage to the oaken sentinel which can extend a replacement branch on its next turn. A Grasping Branch can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 16 Str check vs. it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Grasping Branch or Rock attacks. It can replace one attack with use of Fling.

entries.name: Grasping Branch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 50 ft., one target, 19 (3d8+6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends the target is restrained and takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage at start of each of its turns and sentinel can't use same Grasping Branch on another target.

attack.targets: Until the grapple ends the target is restrained and takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage at start of each of its turns and sentinel can't use same Grasping Branch on another target

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit 60/240' one target 22 (3d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Fling
entries: One Med or smaller creature grappled by the oaken sentinel is thrown up to 60' in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 ft. it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature that creature must make DC 16 Dex save or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

name: Obeleric
languages: understands Common and Void Speech but can't speak

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from normal boulder.

entries.name: Ricochet Charge (Defensive Form Only)
entries: If it moves 15 ft.+ straight to target and then hits target with Boulder Bash attack on same turn target has disadvantage on save vs. being knocked prone. If target is prone obeleric can move up to 15 ft. straight to 2nd target with o provoking opportunity attacks from 1st target and make one Boulder Bash attack vs. 2nd target as a bonus action if 2nd target is within its reach.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Tentacle Slam or Acid Spit attacks.

entries.name: Boulder Bash (Defensive Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 14 (2d10+3) bludgeoning damage and target knocked prone (DC 13 Str not prone).

entries.name: Tentacle Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) bludgeoning damage + 3 (1d6) acid.

entries.name: Spit Acid
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit 20/60' one target 9 (2d6+2) acid. A creature hit by this takes additional 3 (1d6) acid at the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Defensive Roll
entries: Can roll itself into a boulder-like defensive form or back into its tentacled true form. While in defensive form it has resistance to B/P/S damage from nonmagical attacks can't make Tentacle Slam or Spit Acid attacks and can't use Reflux.

entries.name: Reflux
entries: When the obeleric takes bludgeoning it can vomit acid at one creature within 5 ft. of it. That creature must make DC 13 Dex save or take 3 (1d6) acid.

entries.name: Lava Walker
entries: Can move across lava surface as if harmless solid ground. In addition can swim through lava at its walk speed.

entries.name: One with Lava
entries: Can't be surprised by creatures within 5 ft. of lava and  can sense any creature touching same pool of lava it is touching.

entries.name: Sharp Fragments
entries: When it takes bludgeoning each creature within 5 ft. of it takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage as shards of obsidian fly from it.

entries.name: Volcanic Rejuvenation
entries: Regains 10 hp at the start of its turn if at least part of its body is in contact with lava. If it takes cold dmage this doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Biteks or one Bite and one Constrict.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage. Target: DC 15 Con save or take 5 (2d4) piercing damage at start of each of its turns as shards of obsidian lodge in wound. Any creature can use action to remove shards with DC 12 Wis (Medicine) check. Shards crumble to dust if target receives magical healing.

entries.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends target is restrained and takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns and ophidian can't use Constrict on another target.

attack.targets: Until this grapple ends target is restrained and takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns and ophidian can't use Constrict on another target

entries.name: Lava Splash
entries: Writhes and flails splashing lava at everything. Each creature within 20' of it: 21 (6d6) fire (DC 15 Dex half). To use this must be touching or within 5 ft. of lava.

name: Offal Walker
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

entries.name: Gut Lassos
entries: Can have up to three gut lassos at a time. Each gut lasso can be attacked (AC 13; 5 hp; immunity to poison). Destroying a lasso deals no damage to the offal walker which can extrude a replacement gut lasso on its next turn. A gut lasso can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 13 Str check vs. it.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Lasso attack for each gut lasso it has then uses Reel.

entries.name: Lasso
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, 30 ft., one target, 3 (1d4+1) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends the target is restrained and the offal walker can't use the same gut lasso on another target.

attack.targets: Until this grapple ends the target is restrained and the offal walker can't use the same gut lasso on another target

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. one target 8 (2d6+1) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Reel
entries: Pulls one creature grappled by it up to 25 ft. straight toward it.

entries.name: Imposing Figure
entries: Uses its Str modifier instead of its Cha when making Intimidation checks (included above).

entries.name: I Work for the Boss
entries: If subjected to an effect that would force it to make an Int Wis or Cha save while it is within 30' of its superior can use the superior's Int Wis or Cha modifier for the save instead of its own.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Fists or three Throw Brics. If it hits one Med or smaller creature with both Fist attacks target knocked prone (DC 13 Str negates prone).

entries.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 14 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Throw Brick
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit 20/60' one target 9 (2d4+4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Handful of Sandy Rocks
entries: Scatters rocks and blinding sand in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in that area: 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn (DC 13 Dex half damage and isn't blinded).

entries.name: Intimidating Rebuff
entries: When a creature the alleybasher can see within 30' of it targets it with an attack ogre can make a Str (Intimidation) check taking half a step forward snarling or otherwise spooking the attacker. If check is equal to or higher than attack roll attacker must reroll the attack using lower of the two results.

entries.name: Infernal Runes
entries: Its tattoos give it a +2 bonus to its AC (included above). In addition the ogre has advantage on saves vs. spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Unholy Blade
entries: Infused with unholy power the ogre's weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals an extra 2d6 necrotic (included below).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Greatsword attacks.

entries.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 19 (4d6+5) slashing damage + 7 (2d6) necrotic.

entries.name: Dark Word
entries: Speaks an infernal word of unmaking at up to two creatures it can see within 120' of it. Each target: DC 16 Con save or take 22 (5d8) necrotic.

entries.name: Gauntleted Backhand
entries: When a creature within 5 ft. of the ogre misses the ogre with melee attack the attacker must make DC 16 Dex save or be knocked prone

entries.name: Arcane Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals an extra 1d8 force (included below).

entries.name: Artisan's Prowess
entries: If a magic item requires an action to activate ogre can activate it as a bonus action instead.

entries.name: Sense Magic
entries: Senses magic within 120' of it at will. Otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Battleaxes or three Arcane Bolts.

entries.name: Battleaxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 13 (2d8+4) slashing damage or 15 (2d10+4) slashing damage if used with two hands + 4 (1d8) force.

entries.name: Arcane Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 12 (2d8+3) force.

entries.name: Curse Item
entries: Curses one magic item it can see within 60' of it. If item is being worn or carried by a creature creature must make DC 15 Cha save to avoid curse. For 1 min cursed item suffers one curse described below based on type.

entries.name: Scent of Death
entries: Any creature that isn't Undead and that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the kadag ogre: poisoned until the start of its next turn (DC 15 Con negates and target immune to the kadag ogre's Scent of Death for 1 hr).

entries.name: Undead Affinity
entries: An Undead has disadvantage on attack rolls vs. the kadag ogre if the ogre hasn't attacked that Undead within the past 24 hrs. In addition each skeleton and zombie within 30' of the kadag ogre that has no master follows ogre's verbal commands until a master asserts magical control over it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Spear attacks.

entries.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit 10 ft. or range 20/60' one target 12 (2d6+5) piercing damage or 14 (2d8+5) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Master of Death
entries: Empowers up to three friendly Undead it can see within 30' of it. Each can use a reaction to move up to half its speed and make one melee weapon attack. In addition an empowered Undead gains 5 (2d4) temp hp for 1 min. The kadag ogre can't empower Undead with Int score of 10 or higher.

entries.name: Devouring Charge (Boar Form Only)
entries: If it moves at least 20' straight toward a target and then hits it with Tusk attack on the same turn the target must make DC 14 Str save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone the ogre can make one Bite attack vs. it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: Advantage: saves vs. charmed; Immune: magic sleep.

entries.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: Can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Spear or Tusk attacks and one Bite attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 9 (1d10+4) piercing damage and the ogre gains 5 (2d4) temp hp.

entries.name: Spear (Ogre Form Only)
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit 10 ft. or range 20/60' one target 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage or 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Tusk (Boar Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: Transforms into a Large boar or back into its true ogre form. Its stats are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Reverts on death.

entries.name: Stone Chomper
entries: The rockchewer ogre deals double damage to stone objects and structures with its bite attack.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slams or one Bite and one Slam.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 18 (3d8+5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 15 (3d6+5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit 60/240' one target 21 (3d10+5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature it is knocked prone (DC 15 Str negates prone).

entries.name: Chew Rock
entries: Thoroughly crushes a rock in its large maw reducing it to rubble.

entries.name: Gravel Spray
entries: Spits out a 15 ft. cone of crunched up rock. All in area make a DC 15 Dex save taking 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage or half damage if made. Can use this action only if it has used Chew Rock within the past min.

entries.name: Quick Chew
entries: Uses Chew Rock.

entries.name: Rock Catching
entries: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the rockchewer ogre the ogre can with successful DC 10 Dex save catch the missile and take no bludgeoning from it.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

entries.name: Tentacle Senses
entries: Can't use its tremorsense while grappled or restrained.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Tentacle Lash attack and one Void Bite attack or it makes three Void Spit attacks.

entries.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) psychic and target blinded until end of its next turn as jumbled visions and voices of the Void fill its mind (DC 15 Int not blind).

entries.name: Void Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (1d10+5) piercing damage + 9 (2d8) necrotic.

entries.name: Void Spit
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 12 (2d8+3) necrotic.

entries.name: Volatile Stomach
entries: When it takes bludgeoning piercing or slashing can regurgitate some of its stomach contents. Each creature within 5 ft. of it: 4 (1d8) necrotic and be poisoned until end of its next turn (DC 15 Con negates). A pool of Void infused stomach contents forms in a space ogre can see within 5 ft. of it and lasts until start of ogre's next turn. A creature that enters pool for first time on a turn or starts its turn there: 4 (1d8) necrotic.

name: Old Salt
languages: the languages it knew in life

entries.name: Experienced Sailor
entries: Advantage on Str (Athletics) checks made to climb while on a sailing ship and on Dex (Acrobatics) checks to maintain its footing while on a sailing ship.

entries.name: Seaside Rejuvenation
entries: If at least one of its accusers is still alive or if its name hasn't been cleared destroyed old salt gains new body in 13 days regaining all hp and becoming active again. New body appears on beach or dock nearest one of its living accusers.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Desiccating Slam attacks.

entries.name: Desiccating Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 12 (2d8+3) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) necrotic. Target's hp max reduced by amount equal to necrotic taken (DC 15 Con negates hp max). Reduction lasts until target finishes long rest. Target dies if effect reduces its hp max to 0.

entries.name: Wave of Seawater
entries: Throws its hand forward sending wave of seawater in a 30' cone. Each creature in that area: 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and begins choking as its lungs fill with seawater (DC 15 Dex half damage and isn't choking). A creature that can breathe water doesn't choke from failing this save. A choking creature can make a DC 15 Con save at the end of each of its turns coughing up seawater and success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries: Take Dash Disengage or Hide.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary pile of leaves.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: Doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Rotting Leaves
entries: When a creature hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it mold spores and decomposing matter fly from the wound. Each creature within 5 ft. of it: poisoned until the end of its next turn (DC 13 Con negates).

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage + 13 (3d8) acid and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends target is restrained ooze can automatically hit target with its Pseudopod and ooze can't make Pseudopod attacks vs. others.

entries.name: Release Spores
entries: Releases spores from the mold coating its leaves. Each creature within 20' of ooze: 14 (4d6) poison and is choking (DC 13 Con half damage and isn't choking). A choking creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: Eye-Watering Stench
entries: Gives off an odor so pungent it can bring tears to the eyes. A creature that starts its turn within 20' of the ooze: disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn (DC 13 Con negates).

entries.name: Flammable
entries: If it takes fire damage it bursts into flame until the end of its next turn. When it hits with Pseudopod attack while on fire the Pseudopod deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: Doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage + 3 (1d6) poison.

entries.name: Digest Corpse
entries: Dissolves a corpse in its space that is less than 1 week old. It regains 1d6 hp per size category of the creature it consumes. For example it regains 1d6 hp when consuming a Tiny creature or 4d6 hp when consuming a Large creature. The corpse is then destroyed and this action can't be used on it again.

entries.name: Split
entries: When a Med or larger manure ooze is subjected to slashing damagesplits into 2 new oozes if it has 10+ hp. Each new ooze has half original's hp rounded down. New oozes are one size smaller than original.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: Corrosive Form
entries: A creature that touches it or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 10 (3d6) acid.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: Doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Pseudopod and three Weapon Thrashes.

entries.name: Weapon Thrash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d4+5) bludgeoning damage/P/S (the ooze's choice) damage.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d4+5) bludgeoning damage + 18 (4d8) acid.

entries.name: Shed Oozling
entries: When it has more than 10 hp and is subjected to acid cold lightning or slashing it can lose 10 hp to create an oozling: same stats as scintillating ooze except it is Tiny has 10 hp can't make Weapon Thrashes and can't use this reaction or legendary actions.

entries.name: Move
entries: Up to its speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Grasping Pseudopod
entries: Launches a pseudopod at one creature it can see within 30' of it. Target must make DC 17 Str save or be pulled up to 30' toward the ooze.

entries.name: Lunging Attack (2)
entries: Makes one Weapon Thrash attack at a creature it can see within 10 ft. of it.

entries.name: False
entries: [+]Appearance[/+] Until it attacks indistinguishable from a large school of fish.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: Doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Symbiotically Bound
entries: The ooze and fish's life force have become entwined. Share stats as if one creature and can't be separated.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: Can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Mesmerizing Spiral then 3 Pseudopods and Engulf.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage target is grappled (escape DC 16).

entries.name: Engulf
entries: Engulfs one Huge or smaller creature grappled by it. Engulfed target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water and it must make DC 16 Con save at start of each of the ooze's turns or take 21 (6d6) acid. If ooze moves engulfed target moves with it. Ooze can have 2 Huge or up to 8 Large or smaller creatures engulfed at a time. Engulfed creature or creature within 5 ft. of ooze can take its action to remove engulfed creature from ooze via DC 16 Str check putting engulfed creature in an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 ft. of ooze.

entries.name: Mesmerizing Spiral
entries: The fish inside it swim rapidly in a hypnotic spiral. Each creature within 20' of it that can see the fish: incapacitated 1 min (DC 16 Wis negates). While incapacitated its speed is reduced to 0. Incapacitated creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. If a creature's save is successful or effect ends for it creature is immune to Mesmerizing Spiral of all shoal oozes for the next 24 hrs.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: Hollow Cylindrical Form (Stretched Body Only)
entries: Creatures can occupy space in center of cylinder formed by the ooze and each such space is always within ooze's reach regardless of cylinder's size.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The sinkhole ooze doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Seizing Pseudopods
entries: Can have up to 6 tendril-like Pseudopods at a time. Each can be attacked (AC 10; 10 hp; immunity to acid poison and psychic). Destroying Pseudopod deals no damage to ooze which can extrude a replacement on its next turn. Pseudopod can also be broken if creature takes an action and makes DC 14 Str check.

entries.name: Slimy Appearance (Stretched Body Only)
entries: While it remains motionless is indistinguishable from interior of the pit or hole in the ground it is stretched across though interior walls appear wet.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Pseudopod attacks.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 15 ft., one creature,. 9 (1d10+4) bludgeoning damage + 3 (1d6) acid and target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends target is restrained and takes 3 (1d6) acid at start of each of its turns and ooze can't use same Pseudopod on another target.

attack.targets: Until this grapple ends target is restrained and takes 3 (1d6) acid at start of each of its turns and ooze can't use same Pseudopod on another target

entries.name: Stretch Body
entries: Stretches body around inner walls of a pit sinkhole or other circular opening in the ground. Stretched this way it forms a hollow cylinder up to 25 ft. tall up to 25 ft. radius. Ooze can end stretch as a bonus action occupying nearest unoccupied space to the hole.

entries.name: Pluck (Stretched Body Only)
entries: When 1+ creature falls down center of its cylinder can try to grab up to 2 of them. Each must make DC 14 Dex save or grappled (escape DC 14) in Pseudopod.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from that work of art.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The sinoper ooze doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Paint Splash attacks.

entries.name: Paint Splash
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit 5 ft. or range 20/60' one creature. 18 (3d8+5) acid and target is coated in paint. Roll a die. Even result: target is coated in a warm color paint such as red orange or yellow. Odd result: target is coated in a cool color paint such as blue green or purple. A creature including target can use its action to remove the paint.

entries.name: Foment Pigment
entries: Activates latent magic in its paint burning/freezing paint off creatures affected by Paint Splash. Each creature coated in paint within 60' of it: 35 (10d6) cold (if coated in cool color) or fire (warm color) and poisoned 1 min (DC 16 Con half damage and isn't poisoned). Each affected creature no longer coated in paint.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from patch of snow.

entries.name: Ice Walk
entries: Can move across icy surfaces with o ability check. Difficult terrain of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra move.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: Doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Snow Blindness
entries: When a creature that can see the snow ooze starts its turn within 30' of it that creature is blinded until the start of its next turn (DC 15 Con negates). This doesn't function while ooze is in dim light or darkness.

entries.name: Snow Burrower
entries: Can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand earth and mud.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Pseudopod attacks.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 14 (3d6+4) bludgeoning damage + 9 (2d8) cold.

entries.name: Avalanche
entries: Rumbles forward stirring up snow. Moves up to 30' in straight line and can move through space of any Large or smaller creature. 1st time it enters creature's space during this move that creature: 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and 18 (4d8) cold and buried in slushy snow (DC 15 Dex half damage not buried). Buried creature is restrained and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature including buried creature can use action to free buried creature via DC 15 Str check. A buried creature with swim speed has advantage on this check.

entries.name: Construct Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: 2 Paint Slashes or 1 Capture Image and 1 Paint Slash.

entries.name: Capture Image
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 22 (4d10) force and target captured as image on flat surface of phantasm's choice within 60' of it (DC 15 Cha negates). While an image target appears on surface as a painting drawing or similar and is incapacitated and restrained. Target can see and hear outside surface but can't target those outside surface with spells or cast spells or use features that allow it to leave surface. If surface where target is captured takes damage target takes half. If surface is reduced to 0 hp target freed. Dispel magic (DC 15) cast on surface also frees captured creature. If phantasm takes 20+ damage on a single turn phantasm must make DC 15 Cha save at end of that turn or lose focus releasing all captured creatures.

entries.name: Paint Slash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage + 16 (3d10) poison.

entries.name: Painting Sensor
entries: While touching one artwork can see and hear through another it has previously touched as if it was in that artwork's space if within 1 mile of it. “Artwork” can mean any painting drawing or design on a flat surface including pattern on a wall or in a book.

entries.name: Painting Portal
entries: Uses 10 ft. of move to step magically into one artwork within reach and emerge from 2nd artwork within 100' of 1st appearing in unoccupied space within 5 ft. of 2nd. If both are Large or larger can bring up to 3 willing creatures.

entries.name: Echolocation
entries: Can't use its blindsight while deafened.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries: Double damage to objects/structures.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: Can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite attack and one Tail Fin attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 19 (3d8+6) piercing damage. If target is a Large or smaller creature: swallowed by the worm (DC 16 Dex negates). A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained it has total cover vs. attacks and other effects outside the worm and it takes 14 (4d6) acid at the start of each of the worm's turns. If the worm takes 25+ damage on a single turn from a creature inside it worm must make DC 18 Con save at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures which fall prone in a space within 10 ft. of the worm. If worm dies a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape the corpse by using 15 ft. of movement exiting prone.

entries.name: Tail Fin
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 16 (3d6+6) slashing damage + 16 (3d6+6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Red Acid Spume
entries: Exhales crimson stomach acid in 30' cone if worm is underwater or 50' line × 5 ft. wide if above water. Each creature in area: 31 (9d6) acid (DC 16 Dex half).

entries.name: Elemental Demise
entries: If the peri dies its body disintegrates into a warm breeze leaving behind only the equipment the peri was wearing or carrying.

entries.name: Wind Slash
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit 5 ft. or range 60' one target 9 (2d4+4) slashing damage + 7 (2d6) lightning or thunder (the peri's choice).

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: Magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Storm Wave or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the peri wears or carries is invisible with it.

entries.name: Storm Wave
entries: Throws its arms forward releasing a blast of stormy wind in a 30' line that is 5 ft. wide. All in line make a DC 12 Dex save. On a failure a creature takes 7 (2d6) lightning and 7 (2d6) thunder and is pushed up to 10 ft. away from the peri. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed.

entries.name: Celestial Weapons
entries: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon does extra 2d4 radiant (included below).

entries.name: Immortal Nature
entries: Doesn't require food drink or sleep

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Piscine Curse
entries: When a creature reduces the pescavitus to 0 hp that creature is cursed for 5 days (DC 13 Cha negates). Cursed creature can be detected as a fiend with spells such as detect evil and good. In addition for the duration cursed creature gains only half the benefit of magic that restores hp and gains no benefits from finishing a long rest. A creature that consumes any amount of the flesh of a pescavitus is automatically cursed. Curse can be lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: Can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d6+3) bludgeoning damage + 5 (2d4) radiant.

entries.name: Air Bubble (Recharge: Short/Long Rest)
entries: Creates an air bubble around the heads of any number of creatures that are touching it. A creature that benefits from an air bubble can breathe underwater and gains swim speed of 20' if it doesn't already have a swim speed. The air bubbles hold enough air for 24 hrs of breathing divided by number of breathing creatures that received an air bubble.

entries.name: Healing Touch
entries: Touches another creature. Target magically regains 5 (1d8+1) hp and is freed from any disease poison blindness or deafness.

entries.name: Fiery Feathers
entries: Sheds 10 ft. radius bright light dim light extra 10 ft..

entries.name: Rebirth
entries: If reduced to 0 hp it erupts in a burst of flame. Each creature within 10 ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) fire and the phoenixborn regains hp equal to the total damage taken.

entries.name: Talon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Hurl Flame
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) fire.

entries.name: Fiery Feathers and Rebirth
entries: As above but rebirth: 7 (2d6).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Talon or Hurl

entries.name: Flame attacks
entries: It can replace one attack with use of Spellcasting.

entries.name: Talon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage + 3 (1d6) fire.

entries.name: Hurl Flame
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) fire.

entries.name: Fire Jet
entries: Shoots a jet of fire in a 30' line that is 5 ft. wide. Each creature in line: 14 (4d6) fire (DC 13 Dex negates).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: Cha (DC 13): At will: mage hand minor illusion light prestidigitation2/day ea: charm person continual flame mage armor1/day: dispel magic

spells.name: mage hand minor illusion light prestidigitation
charm person continual flame mage armor

warnings: compact spell list; spell separators absent in source

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The porcillina has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

entries.name: Poisonous Flesh
entries: A creature that touches the porcellina or consumes the meat of the porcellina must make DC 11 Con save or become poisoned for 1 hr.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) piercing damage and the target must make DC 11 Dex save or be knocked prone. The DC increases by 1 for each other porcellina that hit the target since the end of this porcellina's previous turn to a max of DC 15.

entries.name: Squeal
entries: When a porcellina is hit with an attack it can let out a blood-curdling scream. Each creature within 10 ft. of the porcellina must make DC 11 Wis save or become frightened until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Elemental Attacks
entries: Her weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon it deals extra 5d6 damage of Roiling Elements type.

entries.name: Elemental Aura
entries: At start of each of her turns each creature within 5 ft. of her takes 10 (3d6) damage of Roiling Elements type. Creature that touches her or hits her with melee attack while within 10 ft. of her: 10 (3d6) damage of Roiling Elements type. Nonmagical weapon that hits her is destroyed after dealing damage.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: Choose to succeed failed save.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Roiling Elements
entries: At the start of each of her turns she chooses one of the following damage types: acid cold fire lightning or thunder. She has immunity to that damage type until the start of her next turn.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries: Double damage to objects/structures.

entries.name: Elemental Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 32 (4d10+10) bludgeoning damage + 17 (5d6) damage of the type determined by Roiling Elements.

entries.name: Storm Blast
entries: The primordial matriarch emits elemental energy in a 90' cone. Each creature in the area: 21 (6d6) damage of the type determined by Roiling Elements and suffers one of the following effects depending on the damage type (DC 20 Dex half damage and no additional effect unless specified below).Acid Blast Fail: creature is covered in acid. At the start of each of its turns it takes 7 (2d6) acid until it or another creature takes an action to scrape or wash off the acid.Cold Blast Fail: creature is restrained by ice until end of its next turn or until it or another creature takes an action to break it free. Success: creature's speed is reduced by 10 ft. until end of its next turn.Fire Blast Fail: creature catches fire. Until it or another creature takes an action to douse the fire creature takes 7 (2d6) fire at the start of each of its turns.Lightning Blast Fail: creature incapacitated until end of its next turn. Succcess: creature can't take reactions until start of its next turn.Thunder Blast Fail: creature is deafened for 1 min. At the end of each of its turns a deafened creature can repeat the save ending deafness on itself on a success. Success: creature is deafened until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Uses Storm Blast then two Elemental Lashes.

entries.name: Create Elementals
entries: Magically creates up to 3d6 mephits 2 air earth fire or water elementals 2 ice elementals (Tome of Beasts 2) or 1 rockslide elemental (Tome of Beasts 3). Elementals arrive at start of her next turn acting as her allies and obeying her spoken commands. Elementals remain for 1 hr until she dies or until matriarch dismisses them as a bonus action. She can have any number of Elementals under her control at one time provided the combined total CR of the Elementals is no higher than 10.

entries.name: Elemental Adaptation
entries: When she would take acid cold fire lightning or thunder she can change the element selected with Roiling Elements to that type of damage gaining immunity to that damage type including the triggering damage.

entries.name: Elemental Change
entries: Changes the damage immunity granted by Roiling Elements.

entries.name: Fly
entries: Up to half her flying speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Create Elemental (2)
entries: Uses Create Elementals.

entries.name: Return to Mother (3)
entries: Absorbs Elemental within 10 ft. of her gaining temp hp equal to 10 times the CR of Elemental absorbed.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Life From Death
entries: When it dies explodes in burst of raw creation. 50' radius area centered on it is blanketed in lush native flora providing food to feed 12 Large or smaller creatures for 6 (1d12) days. Creatures in area dead up to 1 day are returned to life with 4 (1d8) hp.

entries.name: Primordial Form
entries: Can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide with o squeezing. A creature that touches it or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) acid cold fire lightning or thunder (surge's choice). Also it can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The 1st time it enters a creature's space on a turn that creature takes 7 (2d6) acid cold fire lightning or thunder (surge's choice). A creature that starts its turn in surge's space: blinded and deafened until it starts its turn outside surge's space (DC 18 Con negates).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Elemental Strike attacks.

entries.name: Elemental Strike
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit 15 ft. or range 60' one target 28 (4d10+6) acid cold fire lightning or thunder (surge's choice).

entries.name: Primordial Storm
entries: Rain of energies produces one of: Restorative Rain Each non Construct/Undead creature within 30' of the surge regains 27 (5d10) hp. Area becomes difficult terrain as nonmagical plants in the area become thick and overgrown.Ruinous Rain Each creature within 30' of the surge: 27 (5d10) acid and 27 (5d10) fire and is coated in burning acid (DC 18 Dex half damage not coated in acid). A creature coated in acid: 5 (1d10) acid and 5 (1d10) fire at the start of each of its turns until it or another creature takes an action to scrape/wash off the acid.

resistances.name: nonmagic B/P/S attacks not made w/cold iron weapons

entries.name: Beguiling Aura
entries: The mere sight of the púca is a temptation for road-weary travelers. Whenever a creature that can see it starts its turn within 30' of it creature is charmed 1 min (DC 15 Wis negates). A charmed creature must take Dash action and move toward púca by safest available route on each of its turns trying to get within 5 ft. of the horse to mount it. Each time creature takes damage and at end of each of its turns it can re-save ending effect on itself on success. If creature's save succeeds or effect ends creature immune to púca's Beguiling Aura next 24 hrs.

entries.name: Nightmarish Ride
entries: If a creature mounts the púca creature paralyzed and restrained by chains on púca's back until the next dawn (DC 15 Cha negates paralysis and restrained). While it has a rider captured this way púca takes Dash or Disengage actions on each of its turns to flee with rider. After it moves 100' it disappears with captured rider magically racing along a nightmarish landscape. At the next dawn it returns to the space where it disappeared or the nearest unoccupied space the rider lands in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of púca and púca flees. At the end of the ride rider suffers one level of exhaustion.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Chain Whip attacks and one Hooves attack.

entries.name: Chain Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 15 (2d10+4) bludgeoning damage and target grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Med or smaller creature and púca doesn't have 2 others grappled. Until grapple ends target restrained.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage and target must make DC 15 Str save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Blessings of the Sea Gods
entries: Has advantage on saves while flying over or swimming in ocean waters.

entries.name: Hardy Ocean Explorers
entries: Considered a Med creature when determining its carrying capacity. Holds its breath 30 min.

entries.name: Oceanic Recall
entries: Can perfectly recall any path it has traveled above or within an ocean.

entries.name: Peck
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Quick and Nimble
entries: When a creature the puffinfolk can see targets it with melee or ranged weapon attack puffinfolk darts out of the way and attacker has disadvantage on the attack.

name: Pyrite Pile
languages: understands Dwarvish and Terran but can't speak

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from normal pile of gold nuggets.

entries.name: Gold Fever
entries: When a Humanoid or xorn that can see the pile starts its turn within 60' of pile creature must make DC 15 Wis save or be charmed until end of its next turn. Charmed creature must take Dash action and move toward pile by safest available route on its next turn trying to get within 5 ft. of pile.

entries.name: Metal Sense
entries: Can pinpoint by scent the location of precious metals within 60' of it and can sense the general direction of Small or larger deposits of such metals within 1 mile.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slam attacks. If the pyrite pile hits one Med or smaller creature with both attacks the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends the target takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The pyrite pile can have only one creature grappled at a time.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 15 (3d6+5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Hurl Nugget
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit 20/60' one target 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Eat Gold
entries: Absorbs 52 (8d12) gp worth of nonmagical items and coins made of precious metals ignoring copper worn or carried by one creature grappled by it and the pile regains hp equal to half that. Absorbed metal is destroyed.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from clump of crabgrass.

entries.name: Flaming Seedpod Regrowth
entries: Has four Flaming Seedpods. Used Flaming Seedpods may regrow each turn. If podthrower starts its turn with less than four Flaming Seedpods roll a d6. On a roll of 5 or 6 it regrows 1d4 Flaming Seedpods to a max of 4.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If it takes necrotic or if it is grappled and removed from the ground this trait doesn't function at start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Grass Blades or two Flaming Seedpods.

entries.name: Grass Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Flaming Seedpod

Each time host takes damage rafflesian takes same amount. If host is subjected to effect that would force it to save host can use its save bonuses or rafflesian's. If both are subjected to same effect only one is affected rafflesian's choice. Rafflesian and host otherwise retain their own stats and take separate turns. entries.name: Last Resort
