Each creature within 20' of it: 18 (4d8) thunder (DC 15 Con half).Endless Ringing: Endless piercing ringing. It must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue this ringing and it can end the ringing at any time. While using Endless Ringing it can't move or use Bell Toll. When a creature enters a space within 60' of it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there the creature must make DC 15 Con save or be deafened and unable to cast spells with verbal components until tstart of its next turn.Herald of Dread: Chimes one terror-inducing note. Each creature within 60' of it: frightened for 1 min (DC 15 Wis negates). A creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. If a creature's save is successful or effect ends for it creature is immune to crier's Herald of Dread for next 24 hrs.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: Choose to succeed failed save.

entries.name: Spiny Defense
entries: A creature that touches the sinstar or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage and if the target is a Humanoid it must make DC 19 Con save or contract the thrall sickness disease (see the Thrall Sickness trait).

entries.name: Thrall Sickness
entries: A Humanoid infected with this disease manifests symptoms 1d4 days after infection which include excessive thirst increased desire for exposure to sunlight and the appearance of itchy bumps on the skin. This disease wears down the victim's psyche while slowly transforming its body. Until the disease is cured at the end of each long rest the infected creature must make a DC 19 Con save. On a failure the creature's Dex and Int scores are each reduced by 1d4. The reductions last until the infected creature finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. The infected creature dies if the disease reduces its Dex or Int score to 0. A Humanoid that dies from this disease transforms into a star thrall under the complete psychic control of the sinstar that infected it. This otherworldly disease can be removed by the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Alluring Whispers then three Spines or Psychic Lash attacks.

entries.name: Spines
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit 5 ft. or range 20/60' one target 16 (4d6+2) piercing damage and if the target is a Humanoid it must make DC 19 Con save or contract the thrall sickness disease (see the Thrall Sickness trait).

entries.name: Psychic Lash
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, 120 ft., one target, 18 (3d8+5) psychic.

entries.name: Alluring Whispers
entries: The sinstar telepathically whispers soothing and beckoning words in the minds of all Humanoids within 120' of it. Each target must make DC 19 Wis save or be charmed for 1 min. While charmed a creature is incapacitated and if it is more than 5 ft. away from the sinstar it must move on its turn toward the sinstar by the most direct route trying to get within 5 ft. of the sinstar and touch it. The creature doesn't avoid opportunity attacks but before moving into damaging terrain such as lava or a pit and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the sinstar the creature can repeat the save. A charmed creature can also re-save at end of each of its turns. If the save is successful the effect ends on it. A creature that successfully saves is immune to this sinstar's Alluring Whispers for the next 24 hrs.

entries.name: Spines
entries: Makes one Spines attack.

entries.name: Teleport
entries: Magically teleports up to 120' to an unoccupied spot it sees.

entries.name: Detonate Thrall (2)
entries: Orders one of its star thralls to explode. Each creature within 10 ft. of the thrall must make a DC 19 Dex save taking 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a failed save or half damage if made.

entries.name: Spiny Defense
entries: A creature that touches the star thrall or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage and must make DC 13 Con save or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the star thrall is on the same plane of existence as the sinstar that created it the star thrall can magically convey what it senses to the sinstar and the two can communicate telepathically.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage + 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

entries.name: Shoot Spines
entries: Sprays spines in a burst around itself. Each creature within 15 ft. of it must make a DC 13 Dex save. On a failure a creature takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage and is paralyzed until the end of its next turn. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn't paralyzed.

entries.name: Distraction
entries: Each creature with Int 5+ that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the slithy tove must make DC 13 Wis save or be incapacitated until start of its next turn as it hears imaginary murmurings and sees movement in its peripheral vision. On success creature has advantage on saves vs. the Distraction of all slighty toves for the next 24 hrs.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Claws or one Claw and one Lick.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 12 (3d4+5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Lick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 9 (1d8+5) bludgeoning damage and target must make DC 13 Str save or be pulled up to 10 ft. toward the slithy tove.

entries.name: Musk of Clumsiness
entries: Discharges musk in 30' cone. Each creature in area: 10 (3d6) poison and poisoned 1 min (DC 13 Con half damage and isn't poisoned). When poisoned creature moves 5 ft.+ on its turn it must make DC 13 Dex save or fall prone stepping in a hole hitting its head on a branch tripping over a rock bumping into an ally or some other clumsy act. Poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Hidden Step
entries: Magically teleports along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying up to 30' to an unoccupied space it can see and takes the Hide action.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Regains 15 hp at start of its turn if it has 1+ hp.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Slimy Tentacles and three Talons. If it hits one creature with two Talonss the target must make DC 18 Str save or take 11 (2d10) piercing damage and be knocked prone.

entries.name: Slimy Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 20 (3d8+7) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends target is restrained and takes 18 (4d8) acid at the start of each of its turns and snallygaster can't use its Slimy Tentacles on another target.

attack.targets: Until this grapple ends target is restrained and takes 18 (4d8) acid at the start of each of its turns and snallygaster can't use its Slimy Tentacles on another target

entries.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 20 (2d12+7) piercing damage.

entries.name: Screech
entries: Squawks a screeching whistle in 60' cone. Each creature in area: 49 (14d6) thunder and stunned 1 min (DC 18 Con half not stunned). Stunned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Nimble Flier
entries: Takes the Dash or Disengage action. It must be flying to use this bonus action.

entries.name: Parry Spell
entries: If it succeeds on save vs. spell of 5th level or lower that targets only snallygaster spell has no effect. If snallygaster succeeds on save by 5+ spell is reflected back at spellcaster using slot level spell save DC attack bonus and spellcasting ability of caster

name: Snatch Bat
languages: understands Deep Speech and Umbral but can't speak

entries.name: Flyby
entries: Doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

entries.name: Treasure Sense
entries: Can pinpoint by scent the location of precious metals gemstones and jewelry within 60' of it and can sense the general direction of such objects within 1 mile of it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Claw attacks or two Claw attacks and one Pilfering Bite attack.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit 5.' one target 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Pilfering Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 10 (2d4+5) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage the snatch bat can steal one item the target is wearing or carrying provided the item weighs no more than 10 pounds isn't a weapon and isn't wrapped around or firmly attached to the target. Ex: snatch bat could steal a hat or belt pouch but not a creature's shirt or armor. Bat holds stolen item in its long neck-arm and must regurgitate that item (no action required) before it can make another Pilfering Bite.

attack.targets: Instead of dealing damage the snatch bat can steal one item the target is wearing or carrying provided the item weighs no more than 10 pounds isn't a weapon and isn't wrapped around or firmly attached to the target

entries.name: Grassland Camouflage
entries: Advantage: Dex (Stealth) to hide in grassland.

entries.name: Scarecrow
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of sodwose: frightened until the end of its next turn (DC 15 Wis negates and is immune to sodwose's Scarecrow for the next 24 hrs).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Grass Whip attacks.

entries.name: Grass Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 15 ft., one creature,. 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage and target must make DC 15 Str save or be pulled up to 10 ft. to sodwose.

entries.name: Entangle
entries: Compels all plants and roots within 20' of a point on the ground it can see within 60' of it to grasp and pull at nearby creatures for 1 min. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there creature is restrained by grasses and roots (DC 15 Str negates). A creature including the restrained creature can take an action to free it by making a DC 15 Str check.

entries.name: Grass Step
entries: Teleports along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying up to 30' to an unoccupied spot it sees. The origin and destination spaces must contain grass.

entries.name: Set Snare
entries: Creates a snare in a square area it can see within 30' of it that is 5 ft. on a side and 50%+ grass. 1st creature to moves into that space within next min: DC 15 Str save or be restrained by grasses. A creature including restrained creature can use action to free restrained creature via DC 15 Str check. It can have at most 3 snares set at a time. If it sets a 4th oldest ceases to function.

name: Soil Snake
languages: understands creator's languages but can't speak

entries.name: Construct Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Grassland Camouflage
entries: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in grassland terrain.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite attack and one Tail Whip attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 14 (2d8+5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Tail Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Charging Swallow
entries: Partially submerges in the ground and slithers forward scooping up soil and creatures as it goes. The soil snake moves up to 30' in a straight line and can move through the space of any Med or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move that creature: 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and is buried as it is swallowed bounced through the hollow inside of the soil snake and deposited back in its space under a pile of soil (DC 14 Dex half damage and isn't buried). A buried creature is restrained and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature including the buried creature can take its action to free the buried creature by succeeding on a DC 14 Str check.

entries.name: Soil Blast
entries: Expels soil in a 30' cone. Each creature in that area: 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone (DC 14 Dex half damage not prone).

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Protective Frenzy
entries: For 1 min after a splinter matron's tree takes damage she has advantage on attack rolls vs. any creature that damaged her tree and when she hits such a creature with her Claw the Claw deals an extra 1d8 slashing.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Claw or Splinter attacks.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 14 (3d6+4) slashing damage + 7 (2d6) poison. If the target is a creature other than an Undead or Construct: 4 (1d8) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns as splinters break off from the claws and dig into the wound (DC 15 Con negates piercing). Any creature can take an action to remove the splinters with successful DC 14 Wis (Medicine) check. The splinters fall out of the wound if target receives magical healing.

entries.name: Splinter
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit 30/120' one target 22 (4d8+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Splinter Spray
entries: Blasts a spray of splinters in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area: 45 (10d8) piercing damage and is blinded for 1 min (DC 15 Dex half damage and isn't blinded). A blinded creature can make a DC 15 Con save at end of each of its turns ending effect on itself on a success

entries.name: Construct Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary stained-glass window or artwork.

entries.name: Flyby
entries: Doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Blessed Wings then two Wing Slice or Radiant Wing attacks.

entries.name: Wing Slice
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Radiant Wing
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 6 (1d8+2) radiant.

entries.name: Blessed Wings
entries: Marks one creature it can see within 30' of it with holy power. If the target is a hostile creature the next attack roll made vs. the target before the start of the moth's next turn has advantage. If the target is a friendly creature it gains a +2 bonus to AC until the start of the moth's next turn.

entries.name: Mutagenic Venom
entries: Produces potent poison that envenoms Humanoid victim and slowly transforms it into new diopsid. While envenomed treats all diopsid as if charmed by them. Every 24 hrs that elapse victim : DC 16 Con save reducing hp max by 5 (2d4) on failure. Reduction lasts until creature finishes long rest after venom removed. Creature dies if this reduces hp max to 0. Humanoid that dies from this horrifically transformed becoming new diopsid and losing all memory of its former life. Poison remains within creature's body until removed by greater restoration or similar.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Stinger attack and two Tentacle attacks.

entries.name: Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 26 (4d10+4) piercing damage. If Humanoid succumbs to diopsid's venom (DC 16 Con negates see Mutagenic Venom).

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 17 (3d8+4) bludgeoning damage. Target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is an up to Large creature and diopsid doesn't have 2 grappled.

entries.name: Share Senses
entries: While within 300' of an envenomed Humanoid diopsid sees through target's eyes and hears what target hears until start of its next turn gaining benefits of any special senses target has. On subsequent turns diopsid can use a bonus action to extend duration of this effect until start of its next turn.

entries.name: Control Envenomed
entries: While within 300' of an envenomed Humanoid diopsid can telepathically suggest course of activity to it. Humanoid must make DC 16 Wis save or pursue the activity suggested to it. Success: Humanoid takes 11 (2d10) psychic and has disadvantage next time it makes this save. Works like suggestion spell and Humanoid unaware of diopsid's influence.

entries.name: Tendril Whip Regrowth
entries: Has 12 tendrils. If all are destroyed can't use Tendril Whip. Destroyed tendrils regrow when it finishes long rest.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: 3 Bites or Slams and 2 Whips. Can replace 1 Bite with Trap.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 18 (3d8+5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 10 ft., one creature,. 15 (3d6+5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Tendril Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 20 ft., one creature,. Target grappled (escape DC 16). Until grapple ends target restrained stargazer can't use same tendril on another. Tendril destroyable (AC 10; hp 20; immune to poison and psychic). Destroying tendril doesn't damage stargazer.

entries.name: Wing Trap
entries: If it has no creatures trapped snaps its appendages shut. Each creature within 5 ft. of it: 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and trapped ending grapple if grappled (DC 16 Dex half damage not trapped). Creature grappled by stargazer: disadvantage on the save. Trapped creature blinded restrained has total cover vs. attacks and effects outside stargazer and takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage at start of each stargazer turn. Trapped creature can take its action to escape by making a DC 16 Str check. Stargazer can have up to 2 creatures trapped at a time. While it has 1+ creature trapped can't burrow and can't Bite creatures outside its Wing Trap.

entries.name: Reel
entries: Pulls up to 2 creatures grappled by it up to 15 ft. straight to it.

entries.name: Wing Trap Snap
entries: When 1+ creatures step onto a space on ground within 10 ft. directly above a hidden stargazer stargazer can burrow up to 10 ft. and snap its wing-like appendages shut emerging on the ground in space directly above where it was buried and that contains one or more other creatures. Each creature must make DC 16 Dex save or be trapped as if it failed save vs. Wing Trap.

name: Starving Specter
languages: the languages it knew in life

entries.name: Aura of the Forgotten
entries: Beasts and Humanoids within 10 ft. of the starving specter have disadvantage on saves.

entries.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: Can see 60' into the Ethereal Plane.

entries.name: Life Hunger
entries: When a creature specter can see regains hp specter's next Bite deals extra 7 (2d6) necrotic on a hit.

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: Move through others/objects as difficult terrain. Takes 5 (1d10) force if it ends turn in object.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Unnerving Visage
entries: When a creature that can see specter's faces starts its turn within 30' of it at least one of specter's faces shifts to look like one of the creature's departed loved ones or bitter enemies if specter isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. Creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic and is frightened of specter until start of its next turn (DC 14 Wis negates both). Unless surprised a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the save at start of its turn. If creature does so it can't see the specter until the start of its next turn when it can avert again. If creature looks at specter in the meantime it must immediately save.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite attack and one Bladed Arm attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) piercing damage + 3 (1d6) necrotic.

entries.name: Bladed Arm
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) slashing damage. This attack can target a creature on the Ethereal or Material Plane.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: Doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slam attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage + 3 (1d6) acid. Target petrified 1 min (DC 14 Con). Petrified creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Dissolve Stone
entries: Touches petrified creature or nonmagical object or structure made of crystal or stone within 5 ft. of it ingesting some. If object isn't being worn or carried touch destroys a 6-inch cube of it and slime regains 10 (3d6) hp. If object is being worn or carried by a creature creature can make DC 14 Dex save to avoid slime's touch. If target is a petrified creature: 21 (6d6) acid (DC 14 Con half). Being petrified doesn't give creature resistance to this damage. Slime regains hp equal to half the damage taken. If object touched is stone armor or stone shield worn or carried it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to AC it offers. Armor reduced to AC 10 or shield that drops to +0 bonus is destroyed. If object touched is a held stone weapon it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If penalty drops to -5 it is destroyed

entries.name: Diurnal
entries: At night or when underground it has disadvantage on initiative rolls and Wis (Perception) checks.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Speak with Plants
entries: Can communicate with plants as if they shared a language.

entries.name: Variable Illumination
entries: Sheds bright light in a 5 ft. to 20' radius and dim light for extra number of feet equal to chosen radius. It can alter radius as a bonus action. It can't use this trait if it hasn't been exposed to sunlight in past 24 hrs.

entries.name: Radiant Leaf
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 4 (1d4+2) slashing damage + 5 (2d4) radiant.

entries.name: Light Ray
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) radiant.

entries.name: Healing Radiance (Recharge: Short/Long Rest)
entries: Radiates a warm light. Each friendly creature within 10 ft. of the sprite regains 5 (2d4) hp. It can't use this action if it hasn't been exposed to sunlight in the past 24 hrs.

name: Swampgas Shade
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it dies within its bound region shade returns to life in 1d4 days and regains all hp. This doesn't function if shade is put to rest which occurs after its corpse has been reburied outside swamp.

entries.name: Swampbound
entries: Is bound to a region of swamp within 1 mile of its body. If shade leaves region loses its Soul Drain action until it returns to the region. If it remains outside region automatically teleports back to its corpse after 24 hrs regardless of distance.

entries.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: Advantage: Dex (Stealth) to hide in swamp.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Soul Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 12 (2d8+3) psychic and target's Cha score is reduced by 1d4. Target dies if this reduces its Cha to 0. Otherwise reduction lasts until target finishes a short or long rest. If a Humanoid dies from this it can't be restored to life until shade is put to rest (see Rejuvenation).

entries.name: Haunting Murmurs
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +3 to hit, 60 ft., one creature,. 8 (1d8+3) psychic.

entries.name: Swampland Stealth
entries: Takes the Hide action. It must be in swampy terrain to use this bonus action.

entries.name: Blood Sense
entries: Can pinpoint by scent the location of warm-blooded creatures within 20' of it.

entries.name: Distracting Buzz
entries: A creature that is not deafened and starts its turn in a space occupied by a swarm of biting gnats must make DC 10 Wis save or become distracted by the droning of the gnats' wings. A distracted creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks that use Int Wis or Cha for 1 min. A creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. If a creature's save is successful the creature is immune to the swarm's Distracting Buzz for the next 10 min.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: Can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny beast. Can't regain hp or gain temp hp.

entries.name: Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit 0' 1 tgt in the swarm's space. 5 (2d4) piercing damage or 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half its hp or fewer. The target must make DC 11 Con save or become blinded for 1 min. The target can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. Alternatively target can use action to clear its eyes of the insects ending effect.

name: Swarm, Gryllus
languages: understands those of its creature but can't speak

entries.name: Book Bound
entries: Hp max is reduced by 1 every min it is more than 60' from its book. When hp max reaches 0 dies. If its book is destroyed or moved to another plane of existence separate from swarm must make DC 11 Con save or be reduced to 10 hp. Swarm can bind itself to new book by spending a short rest in contact with the new book.

entries.name: Construct Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

entries.name: In the Margins
entries: Can spend half its move to enter/exit its book. While inside its book it is indistinguishable from illustrations on a page.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: Can occupy another creature's space and vice versa; can move through opening large enough for Tiny construct. Can't regain hp or gain temp hp.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Go for the Knees or Go for the Eyes attacks. It can replace one attack with use of Timber.

entries.name: Go for the Knees
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit 0' 1 tgt in the swarm's space. 18 (4d8) slashing damage or 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage if swarm has half of its hp or fewer. Target must make DC 15 Con save or its speed is reduced by 10 ft. until end of its next turn.

entries.name: Go for the Eyes
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit 20/60' one target 18 (4d8) piercing damage or 8 (2d4+3) piercing damage if swarm has half of its hp or fewer. Target must make DC 15 Wis save or be blinded until end of its next turn.

entries.name: Timber
entries: Calls out in synchronous tiny voices before chopping away at the feet of one creature in the swarm's space. Target knocked prone (DC 15 Str negates). If target is knocked prone swarm can then make one Go for the Knees attack vs. it as a bonus action.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from cluster of icicles. This trait doesn't function if swarm has damaged a creature with blood within the past 2 hrs.

entries.name: Frigid Mass
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space takes 4 (1d8) cold.

entries.name: Heatsense
entries: The swarm can pinpoint the location of creatures emitting heat such as warm-blooded Beasts and Humanoids within 30' of it.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: Can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny elemental. Can't regain hp or gain temp hp.

entries.name: Impale
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 0 ft., one creature, in the swarm's space. 7 (2d6) piercing damage + 9 (2d8) cold or 3 (1d6) piercing damage + 4 (1d8) cold if the swarm has half its hp or fewer.

entries.name: Puddle Jump
entries: Once on its turn can use 10 ft. of its move to step magically through body of water within reach and emerge from 2nd body of water within 60' of 1st appearing in unoccupied space within 5 ft. of 2nd. If in Huge or larger body of water can teleport to another location within same body of water.

entries.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of swarm: poisoned until start of its next turn. (DC 12 Con negates and creature immune to swarm's Stench for 24 hrs).

entries.name: Swarm
entries: Can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny elemental. Can't regain hp or gain temp hp.

entries.name: Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 0 ft., one creature, in the swarm's space. 14 (4d6) piercing damage + 9 (2d8) poison or 7 (2d6) piercing damage + 4 (1d8) poison if the swarm has half its hp or fewer.

entries.name: Spit Swamp Sludge
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit 20/60' one target 18 (4d8) poison or 9 (2d8) poison if the swarm has half its hp or fewer.

entries.name: Soggy Relocation
entries: While at least one creature is in swarm's space swarm uses Puddle Jump attempting to pull one creature along for the ride. Target magically teleported with swarm to swarm's destination (DC 13 Str negates).

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: Has advantage on melee attack rolls vs. any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

entries.name: Blood Sense
entries: Can pinpoint by scent location of creatures that aren't constructs or undead within 30' of it. Swarm is otherwise blind.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from carpet of flower petals.

entries.name: Swarm
entries: Can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny plant. Swarm can't regain hp or gain temp hp.

entries.name: Petal Slashes
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 0 ft., one creature, in the swarm's space. 18 (4d8) slashing damage or 9 (2d8) slashing damage if the swarm has half its hp or fewer. Target must make a DC 13 Con save reducing its hp max by an amount equal to damage taken on a failed save or by half as much if made. This reduction lasts until creature finishes a long rest. Target dies if this reduces its hp max to 0.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from normal pile of rocks pebbles and scree.

entries.name: Landslide
entries: If it moves at least 15 ft. before entering creature's space creature: DC 13 Dex save or knocked prone. If target is prone talus flow can make one Slam vs. it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Scree Form
entries: Can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. Flow can move through a space as narrow as 3 inches wide with o squeezing. Flow's space is difficult terrain. When a creature starts its turn in flow's space it must make DC 13 Dex save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Med or smaller target the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Grind
entries: Grinds its form over one creature in its space or that is grappled by it. Target takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage (DC 13 Dex half). Flow regains hp equal to half the damage taken if creature is not a Construct or Undead.

entries.name: Poisonous Blood
entries: Its blood is as toxic as its bite. When it takes piercing or slashing each creature within 5 ft. of it: DC 14 Con save or take 5 (2d4) poison. A creature that consumes flesh of tatzelwurm: DC 14 Con save or poisoned 8 hrs.

entries.name: Pounce
entries: If it moves 20'+ straight to creature and then hits it with Claw on same turn target knocked prone (DC 14 Str negates). If target prone wurm can make one Bite vs. it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage + 5 (2d4) poison.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d4+3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Poisonous Breath
entries: Exhales a cloud of poisonous vapor in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in that area: 21 (6d6) poison and is poisoned for 1 min (DC 14 Con half damag not poisoned). A poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Move
entries: Up to half its speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Angry Hiss (2)
entries: Each creature within 30' of it: frightened until the end of its next turn (DC 13 Wis negates).

entries.name: Tail Slap (2)
entries: Swings its tail in a wide arc around it. Each creature within 10 ft. knocked prone (DC 14 Str negates).

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: Can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Amorphous (True Form Only)
entries: Can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide with o squeezing.

entries.name: Mimicry (Assumed Form Only)
entries: Can mimic the sounds and voice of its assumed form. A creature that hears these sounds can tell they are imitations with successful DC 14 Wis (Insight) check.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Regains 5 hp at the start of its turn. If it takes acid or fire this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slam attacks or two Manipulate Flesh attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Manipulate Flesh
entries: Can choose one of these attack options:Manifold Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 14 (4d4+4) piercing damage and the target can't regain hp until the start of the flesh's next turn.Tentacle Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends target is restrained. The flesh can have up to two tentacles each can grapple only one target.Acidic Mucus: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 14 (4d6) acid and 7 (2d6) acid at start of its next turn unless target immediately uses reaction to wipe.

attack.targets: The flesh can have up to two tentacles each can grapple only one target

entries.name: Assume Form
entries: Consumes corpse of Med or smaller Humanoid or Beast within 5 ft. and transforms into it. Stats other than size are the same in new form. Any items worn/carried meld into new form. Can't activate use wield or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment. It reverts to its true aberrant form if it dies makes a Manipulate Flesh attack or uses Assume Form while transformed.

entries.name: Feybane Weapons
entries: Its weapons are cold iron and are magical when used vs. fey. When it hits a fey with any weapon the weapon's damage is force instead of its normal damage type.

entries.name: Fey Sense
entries: Can pinpoint by scent the location of fey within 60' of it and can sense the general direction of fey within 1 mile of it.

entries.name: Soft Wings
entries: Can fly up to 40' on its turn but must start and end its move on solid surface (roof ground etc.). If it is flying at the end of its turn it falls to the ground and takes falling damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Extractor Spear or Disorienting Chitter attacks.

entries.name: Extractor Spear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage + 7 (2d6) necrotic. Target's hp max is reduced by amount equal to half necrotic taken and thripper regains hp equal to that amount. Reduction lasts until target finishes short/long rest. Target dies if this reduces its hp max to 0.

entries.name: Disorienting Chitter
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 16 (3d8+3) thunder and the target must make DC 14 Wis save or fall prone as it briefly becomes disoriented and falls.

entries.name: Glamour Counter
entries: When creature thripper can see within 30' of it casts spell can counter the spell. This works like counterspell spell with +6 spellcasting ability check except thripper can counter only enchantment or illusion spells and it must make the ability check regardless of spell's level.

entries.name: Final Fury
entries: When reduced to 0 hp its head and neck separate from body. Snake-like remnant immediately attacks nearest creature moving up to its speed if necessary even if it has already taken its turn this round. This remnant has same stats as original tigebra except it is Medium has 30 hp and can make only one Bite on its turn. Head remains active for 1d4 rounds or until killed.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Potent Poison
entries: A creature that normally has resistance to poison doesn't have resistance to the tigebra's poison. If a creature normally has immunity to poison it has resistance to the tigebra's poison instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 15 ft., one creature,. 27 (4d10+5) piercing damage + 10 (3d6) poison and the target must make DC 17 Con save or be poisoned for 1 min. While poisoned the creature suffers wracking pain that halves its speed. A poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns ending the effects on itself on a success.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 23 (4d8+5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Hypnotic Gaze
entries: Gazes on one creature it can see within 60' of it. If target can see it: paralyzed until end of its next turn (DC 17 Wis negates immune to tigebra's Hypnotic Gaze 24 hrs).

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary torch.

entries.name: Fiery Soul
entries: Can ignite or extinguish fire that crowns its head as a bonus action. While ignited it sheds bright light in a 20' radius and dim light for an extra 20 feet. When mimic is subjected to effect that would extinguish its flames vs. its will (ex: submerged in area of create or destroy water or gust of wind spells) mimic must make DC 11 Con save or fall unconscious until it takes damage or someone uses action to wake it. If effect is nonmagical mimic has advantage on the save.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Regains 2 hp at start of its turn. If mimic takes cold this doesn't function at start of its next turn. Dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Fire Blast
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit 20/60' one target 7 (2d4+2) fire.

entries.name: Bountiful Death
entries: When the tripwire patch reduces a creature to 0 hp nearby plants erupt with growth. Plants within 20' of the body become thick overgrown difficult terrain and all plants within a 2-mile radius centered on the point where the creature was killed become enriched for 7 days for each CR of the slain creature (minimum of 7 days) cumulatively increasing in duration each time the patch kills a creature. Enriched plants yield twice the normal amount of food when harvested.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from normal patch of foliage such as flowers or bushes.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Bite attacks or one Bite attack and two Tripwire Vine attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Tripwire Vine
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 20 ft., one creature,. 7 (1d6+4) bludgeoning damage and the target must make DC 14 Str save or be knocked prone and pulled up to 15 ft. toward the tripwire patch.

entries.name: No Escape
entries: If a prone creature within 5 ft. of patch stands up from prone patch can make one Bite vs. it.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: Can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Regains 10 hp at start of its turn. If it takes lightning or force this doesn't work at its next turn start. Dies only if it starts turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Slam or Water Blast attacks. If it hits one Large or smaller creature with two Slam attacks the target must make DC 15 Str save or be flung up to 15 ft. to an unoccupied space the troll can see and knocked prone.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 14 (3d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Water Blast
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 11 (2d8+2) bludgeoning damage + 3 (1d6) cold.

entries.name: Surge
entries: Pushes water surge in 30' line × 10 ft. wide. Each creature in line: 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and pushed up to 15 ft. from troll in direction following line (DC 15 Str half not pushed). Surge lasts until start of troll's next turn and any creature in line must spend 2 feet of move per 1 foot it moves when moving closer to troll. If troll uses this while underwater creatures in line have disadvantage on the save and any creature in line must spend 4 feet of move per 1 foot it moves when moving closer to troll.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: Can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

entries.name: Psychoactive Sweat
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the troll must make DC 13 Con save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace its Bite attack with Sticky Tongue attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 9 (2d4+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Sticky Tongue
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 20 ft., one target, 7 (1d6+4) bludgeoning damage and the target must make DC 14 Str save or be pulled up to 15 ft. toward the troll.

entries.name: Distracting Rattle
entries: Its shell plates rattle constantly creating a droning distracting noise. When a creature casts a spell with verbal component while within 30' of the troll that creature must make DC 15 Con save or lose the spell.

entries.name: Night Hunters
entries: While in dim light or darkness has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If it takes fire this trait doesn't function at start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Bite

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Venom Spray
entries: Sprays its venom in a 30' cone. Each creature in that area: 28 (8d6) poison and is poisoned for 1 min (DC 15 Con half damage and isn't poisoned). While poisoned in this way a creature can't regain hp. A poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Regains 10 hp at start of its turn. If troll takes acid or fire this doesn't function at start of troll's next turn. Dies only if it starts turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Uncontrolled Growth
entries: When it regains hp from its Regeneration gains random teratoma. Teratoma and effects last until removed or replaced by another. Troll can have only 3 at a time. If it would gain a 4th oldest fades and is replaced. Teratomas (d6):1 New Senses: A bevy of new ears and noses give troll advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.2 Many Feet: The troll can't be knocked prone.3 Adrenal Overdrive: Can't be frightened or suffer exhaustion.4 Clinging Limbs: When this teratoma is removed with Fling Limb action it attaches to target. While attached to target target takes 3 (1d6) poison at start of each of its turns. A creature including target can use its action to detach teratoma.5 Echo Chambers: Has blindsight out to a range of 60'.6 New Pain Nerves: Disadvantage on any non-attack roll.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Bite and two Claw. Can replace one Claw with Fling Limb. When it does tumor troll doesn't have disadvantage on this attack from being within 5 ft. of creature but can have disadvantage from other sources.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage + 3 (1d6) poison.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Fling Limb
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit 20/60' one target 9 (2d4+4) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) poison. Remove a teratoma from itself if it has one.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Gains 3 hp at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes acid or fire this ability doesn't function at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Thick Skin
entries: Its skin is thick and tough granting it a +1 bonus to Armor Class (already factored into its AC).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Uses Mark Foe. Then two Hurl Flame attacks or three Staff attacks.

entries.name: Staff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if used with 2 hands.

entries.name: Hurl Flame
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, 120 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) fire.

entries.name: Mark Foe
entries: One creature shaman can see within 60' must make DC 13 Wis save or be wreathed in magical fire for 1 min. While wreathed it can't take the Hide action or become invisible. The next time creature takes damage it takes an extra 7 (2d6) fire and the magical fire ends.

entries.name: Fiery Escape
entries: When shaman takes damage each creature within 5 ft. of it: DC 13 Dex save or take 7 (2d6) fire. Shaman is then wreathed in flames and teleports up to 30' to unoccupied space it can see.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Gains 3 hp at the start of its turn. If the trollkin takes acid or fire this ability doesn't function at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Thick Skin
entries: Its skin is thick and tough granting it a +1 bonus to Armor Class (already factored into its AC).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Greatsword attack and two Slam attacks or it makes three Throwing Axe attacks.

entries.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (1d8+4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Throwing Axe
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit 5 ft. or range 30/60' one target 7 (1d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Impregnable Counter
entries: When a creature within 5 ft. of the ironmonger misses a melee attack vs. it the attacker must make DC 15 Str save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Brutal Claws
entries: Its claw deals one extra die of its damage when trollkin isn't ragecasting (included in the attack).

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If it takes acid or fire this trait doesn't function at start of its next turn. Dies only if it starts turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Thick Hide
entries: Its skin is thick and tough granting it a +1 bonus to Armor Class (already factored into its AC).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Claws or two Elemental Blast attacks.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 16 (3d8+3) slashing damage when not ragecasting or 12 (2d8+3) slashing damage while ragecasting.

entries.name: Elemental Blast (Ragecasting Only)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, 120 ft., one target, 14 (3d6+4) cold fire lightning or thunder (trollkin's choice).

entries.name: Spellcasting (Ragecasting Only)
entries: Cha (DC 15) no material components: At will: thunderwave3/day ea: call lightning firebal1/day: fire shield

entries.name: Ragecasting
entries: Enters special rage that lets it channel elemental power for 1 min. While ragecasting: disadvantage on Wis saves and gains fly speed of 60'. It can end ragecasting as a bonus action. When ragecasting ends it descends 60'/round until it lands on a solid surface and can continue concentrating on spell it cast while ragecasting.

name: Truant Devourer
languages: Common + up to three other languages

entries.name: Heretic Sense
entries: Can pinpoint location of heretics of its faith within 60' of it and can sense their general direction within 1 mile of it.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Turn Resistance
entries: Advantage: saves vs. turn undead effects.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Devourer's Cleaver or Necrotic Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with Life Drain attack.

entries.name: Devourer's Cleaver
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) slashing damage + 9 (2d8) necrotic.

entries.name: Life Drain
entries: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 17 (3d8+4) necrotic. Target's hp max is reduced by amount equal to damage taken (DC 16 Con negates hp max). Reduction lasts until target finishes a long rest. Target dies if this reduces its hp max to 0.

entries.name: Necrotic Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, 120 ft., one target, 17 (3d8+4) necrotic.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries: Magically turns invisible (with items worn/carried) until it attacks uses Grasping Claws or concentration ends (as a spell).

entries.name: Grasping Claws
entries: Calls dozens of ghostly skeletal claws to erupt from a point on the ground it can see within 60' of it. All within 15 ft. of that point: 31 (7d8) necrotic and restrained 1 min (DC 16 Dex half damage not restrained). Restrained creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Dusty Step
entries: Teleports  with items worn/carried up to 60' to unoccupied space it can see. Dust cloud appears at origin and destination.

entries.name: Deep Roots
entries: Has advantage on Str and Dex saves made vs. effects that would move it vs. its will along the ground.

entries.name: Dozens of Eyes
entries: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on sight and on saves vs. being blinded. In addition if the tuberkith isn't blinded creatures attacking it can't benefit from traits and features that rely on a creature's allies distracting or surrounding the tuberkith such as the Pack Tactics trait or Sneak Attack feature.

entries.name: Peeler
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Masher
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 6 (1d8+2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature it must make DC 12 Str save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

entries.name: Tenebrous Agility
entries: Its speed is doubled in dim light or darkness and it doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it moves provided it moves only in dim light or darkness. In addition when a creature that relies on sight attacks the umbral shambler while the shambler is in dim light or darkness the attacker has disadvantage on the attack roll.

entries.name: Void Traveler
entries: Doesn't require air food drink sleep or ambient pressure.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Claws attacks.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 5 (1d4+3) slashing damage + 3 (1d6) necrotic.

entries.name: Twisted Step
entries: Can project itself beyond reality for a short time. Until start of its next turn it can move through objects as if they were difficult terrain provided an object is no more than 3' thick and at least one side of the object is in dim light or darkness. It takes 5 (1d10) force if it starts its turn inside an object.

entries.name: Passage Guardian
entries: Can make an opportunity attack when a hostile creature moves within its reach as well as when a hostile creature moves out of its reach. It gets one extra reaction that be used only for opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Turn Immunity
entries: Is immune to effects that turn undead.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Scythe or Death Knell attacks.

entries.name: Scythe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 17 (2d10+6) slashing damage + 10 (3d6) necrotic.

entries.name: Death Knell
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 16 (3d8+3) necrotic or 22 (3d12+3) necrotic if the target is missing any of its hp.

entries.name: Grim Reaping
entries: Spins with its scythe extended and makes one Scythe attack vs. each creature within its reach. A creature that takes necrotic from this attack can't regain hp until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Jungle Camouflage
entries: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in jungle terrain.

entries.name: Poisonous Leaves
entries: Its skin is embedded with vines and poisonous leaves that burn on contact. A non-Construct or Undead creature that touches the constrictor or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) poison.

entries.name: Urushi Blight
entries: A creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms within 1d4 hrs which includes gradual spread of painful itchy rash that develops into inflamed and blistered skin during 1st day. Until disease is cured infected creature: disadvantage on Con saves to maintain concentration on a spell and disadvantage on Dex and Cha saves and ability checks. At end of each long rest infected creature: DC 15 Con save. If it succeeds on two saves it recovers.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: 2 Bites or 1 Bite and 1 Poisonous Constriction.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 10 ft., one creature,. 14 (2d10+3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Poisonous Constriction
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 12 (2d8+3) bludgeoning damage and target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends target is restrained and takes 10 (3d6) poison at start of each of its turns and snake can't use Poisonous Constriction on another target. Each time target takes this poison it must make DC 15 Con save or contract urushi blight.

attack.targets: Until this grapple ends target is restrained and takes 10 (3d6) poison at start of each of its turns and snake can't use Poisonous Constriction on another target

name: Vampiric Vanguard
languages: the languages it knew in life

entries.name: Bloodthirsty
entries: When the vampiric vanguard is below half its hp max it has advantage on all melee attack rolls vs. creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Has the following flaws: Forbiddance: Can't enter a residence with o an invitation from one of the occupants.Harmed by Running Water: Takes 20 acid when it ends its turn in running water.Stake to the Heart: Destroyed if a wood piercing weapon is driven into its heart while it is incapacitated in its resting place.Sunlight Hypersensitivity: Takes 20 radiant when it starts its turn in sunlight. If in sunlight disadvantage on attacks/ability checks.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite and two Claws. If vanguard hits one target with both Claws target must make DC 15 Con save or take 7 (2d6) slashing damage and vampire regains hp equal to that amount.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage + 7 (2d6) necrotic. Target's hp max is reduced by an amount equal to necrotic taken and vampire regains hp equally. Reduction lasts until target finishes a long rest. Target dies if this reduces its hp max to 0.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.
