entries.name: Fortissimo Fibber
entries: Can't be magically silenced or forced to tell the truth by any means and it knows if it hears a lie.

entries.name: Ventriloquist
entries: Can make its voice sound as though it originates from any point it can see within 60' of it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Repartee attacks.

entries.name: Repartee
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit 5 ft. or range 60' one target 14 (3d6+4) psychic.

entries.name: Blather
entries: Asks a question of a creature it can see within 30' of it. Target must make a DC 14 Wis save. Fail: target must either answer the question truthfully and completely or have disadvantage on all attack rolls saves and ability checks for the next 1 hr cumulatively increasing in duration each time the target fails the save and chooses to take disadvantage. If the target chooses to answer the question it can't dissemble or omit information relevant to the question being answered. Success: veritigibbet takes 3 (1d6) psychic. Creatures that are immune to being charmed aren't affected by this.

entries.name: Veiled Escape
entries: Teleports along with any equipment worn or carried up to 120' to an unoccupied spot it sees. becoming invisible when it arrives at the destination.

entries.name: Liar Liar
entries: When a creature lies while within 30' of the veritigibbet that creature: 3 (1d6) fire and it ignites (DC 14 Dex negates). Until creature uses action to douse the fire target takes 3 (1d6) fire at start of each of its turns.

name: Void Constructor
languages: understands Void Speech but can't speak

entries.name: Mobile Grappler
entries: While grappling a creature the constructor can move at its full speed carrying the grappled creature along with it.

entries.name: Tainted Aura
entries: A Void constructor that has completed a Void henge gains necrotic energy while within 1 mile of the henge. At the start of each of the Void constructor's turns each creature within 10 ft. of it must make DC 13 Cha save or take 2 (1d4) necrotic. The Void constructor can choose for a creature it is grappling to be immune to the Tainted Auras of all Void constructors.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slam attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 13 (4d4+3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends the constructor can't use its tentacles on another target.

attack.targets: Until this grapple ends the constructor can't use its tentacles on another target

entries.name: Call of the Void
entries: If creature within 5 ft. of knight attempts to move away from it that creature: DC 13 Str save or be unable to move away from knight. If creature uses magic to move (ex: misty step or freedom of movement) it automatically succeeds.

entries.name: Construct Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Immoveable
entries: Can't be moved vs. its will except by magical means. In addition knight has disadvantage on Dex (Acrobatics) and Dex (Stealth) checks.

entries.name: Implosive End
entries: When Void knight dies it collapses in on itself releasing a wave of Void energy. Creature within 5 ft. of it: 18 (4d8) force (DC 16 Dex half).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Void Gauntlet attacks or three Void Bolts.

entries.name: Void Gauntlet
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 13 (2d6+6) slashing damage + 18 (4d8) force. If the target is a Med or smaller creature it must make DC 16 Str save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Void Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, 120 ft., one target, 21 (4d8+3) force.

entries.name: Pull of the Void
entries: Sends Void tendrils at up to three creatures it can see within 60' of it that are not behind total cover. Each target must make DC 16 strength Saving throw or be pulled up to 30' toward the knight. Then each creature within 5 ft. of knight takes 36 (8d8) force.

entries.name: Lava Bound
entries: Can exist outside of lava or magma for up to 4 hrs each day. If it starts its turn outside of lava and didn't take fire since end of its previous turn its shell begins to cool and harden. While its shell is hardened has walking speed of 20' AC 18 and vulnerability to bludgeoning. If it starts its turn in lava or if it took fire damage since end of its previous turn its shell becomes molten again. If vorthropod remains outside of lava for more than 4 hrs its shell becomes petrified transforming into basalt and vorthropod within goes into hibernation. Its body returns to normal if it is submerged in lava or magma for 1 round. It can stay petrified in hibernation for up to 1d100+10 years after which it dies.

entries.name: Lava Camouflage
entries: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in lava and volcanic terrain.

entries.name: Molten Shell
entries: If Its shell isn't hardened creature that touches it or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) fire.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Claw attacks.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) fire.

entries.name: Molten Tail Slap
entries: Unfurls its tail and slaps it down showering area with searing sparks and superheated rock. Each creature within 15 ft. of it: 28 (8d6) fire (DC 14 Dex half).

entries.name: Bloodthirsty Pounce
entries: If the wakwak moves at least 20' straight toward a creature and then hits it with Talon attack on the same turn that target must make DC 13 Str save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone the wakwak can make one Beak attack vs. it as a bonus action gaining temp hp equal to half the damage dealt.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Beak attack and one Talon attack.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 8 (1d10+3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Talon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Wing Slap
entries: Slams its sharp-edged wings together in front of itself in a 15 ft. cone. All in area make a DC 13 Dex save. On a failure a creature takes 10 (3d6) slashing damage and is pushed up to 10 ft. away from the wakwak and knocked prone. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone.

entries.name: Acidic Fog
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the wandering haze's space takes 7 (2d6) acid.

entries.name: Cloud Form
entries: Can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide with o squeezing and can enter a hostile creature's space and vice versa. The haze's space is heavily obscured.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary cloud or fog bank.

entries.name: Ooze Nature
entries: Doesn't require sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Pseudopod attacks.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 11 (2d4+6) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) acid.

entries.name: Sheath of Chaos
entries: Wraps its cloudy form tighter around those within it. Each creature in the wandering haze's space: 27 (6d8) psychic and is disoriented until end of its next turn as its mind fills with gibbering terrors of chaos that created haze's form (DC 17 Wis half damage and not disoriented). When a disoriented creature moves it moves in a random direction.

entries.name: Acidic Cloudburst
entries: Releases a deluge of acid. Each creature within 10 ft. of it: 35 (10d6) acid and speed halved 1 min (DC 17 Dex half damage and speed not reduced). A creature with halved speed can make a DC 17 Con save at the end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: Can hold its breath for 15 min.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Bite and two Claws. If it hits one Med or smaller creature with both Claws the waterkledde latches onto creature with its Beak and target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends target is restrained waterkledde can automatically hit target with its Beak and waterkledde can't make Beak attacks vs. other targets.

entries.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Frightening Call
entries: Screeches “Kludde! Kledde! Kleure!” in a 30' cone. Each creature in that area: 22 (5d8) psychic and frightened 1 min (DC 15 Wis half damage not frightened). Frightened creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries: Magically transforms into a Small or Med Beast or back into its true fiendish form. Without wings it loses its flying speed. Its statistics other than its size and speed are the same in each form. No matter the form its eyes are always an unnatural green. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Reverts on death.

entries.name: Supernatural Speed
entries: Takes Dash or Disengage.

entries.name: Blazing Maelstrom Form
entries: Can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide with o squeezing. A creature that touches the sirocco or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) fire. In addition sirocco can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn creature takes 3 (1d6) fire and must make DC 15 Str save or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Elemental Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 ft. it moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it it takes 1 cold.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Fiery Wallop attacks.

entries.name: Fiery Wallop
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) fire.

entries.name: Scorching Winds
entries: Whips up scorching winds around it. Each creature within 10 ft. of it: 21 (6d6) fire ignites and is thrown up to 20' in random direction and knocked prone (DC 15 Str negates). If thrown creature strikes solid surface creature takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. it was thrown. If thrown at another creature that creature must make DC 15 Dex save or take same damage and be knocked prone. Until creature uses action to douse fire ignited creature takes 3 (1d6) fire at start of each of its turns.

entries.name: Beast Passivism
entries: No beast with Int 3 or less can willingly attack the crone. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

entries.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: Can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Staff attacks.

entries.name: Wild Staff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage + 4 (1d8) force.

entries.name: Needle Breath
entries: Exhales pine needles in a 30' cone. Each creature in the area: 28 (8d6) piercing damage (DC 15 Dex half).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: Wis (DC 15). Prepared: At will: minor illusion tree stride3/day ea: goodberry hold person locate animals or plants1/day ea: commune with nature remove curse

entries.name: Transmigratory Strike
entries: When she kills a Humanoid can immediately restore it to life as a Beast with CR no higher the Humanoid's CR or level. Otherwise works as reincarnate spell.

spells.name: goodberry hold person locate animals or plants

warnings: compact spell list; spell separators absent in source

entries.name: Cursed Plant
entries: If damage reduces it to 0 hp becomes inanimate tumbleweed and travels via wind. Regains 5 hp every hr regaining consciousness after the first. This doesn't function if it took fire on same round it was reduced to 0 hp or if its body was destroyed.

entries.name: Flammable
entries: When it takes fire damage catches fire taking 3 (1d6) fire at start of each of its turns. Burns until it takes cold or is immersed in water. Creature that touches wind witch or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it while it is burning takes 3 (1d6) fire. While burning deals extra 3 (1d6) fire on each melee attack and deals 7 (2d6) fire to a captured creature at start of its turn.

entries.name: Tumbleweed Form
entries: Can enter hostile creature's space and stop there.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slam attacks or one Slam attack and uses Capture.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d8+ 3) bludgeoning damage and 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

entries.name: Capture
entries: Envelopes one up to Med creature in its space. Target: DC 13 Dex save or restrained inside wind witch. Restrained target can't be hit by wind witch's Slam but takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage if it takes action that requires movement (ex: attack or cast somatic spell). When it moves captured creature moves with it. Can have only one creature captured at a time. Creature within 5 ft. of wind witch can use action to pull restrained creature out via DC 13 Str check; creature trying: 5 (2d4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Bouncy Escape
entries: When it takes damage from a melee attack can move up to half its fly speed. This move doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. It releases a captured creature when it uses this.

entries.name: Deep Roots
entries: Has advantage on Str and Dex saves made vs. effects that would move it vs. its will along the ground.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from diseased or dying alder tree.

entries.name: Sunlight Regeneration
entries: While in sunlight the witchalder regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

entries.name: Speak with Plants
entries: Communicate with Plants as if they shared a language.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Slam attacks. Can replace one with Throttle.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 18 (4d6+4) bludgeoning damage. Target grappled (escape DC 15) if Med or smaller creature and it doesn't have two others grappled.

entries.name: Shape Wood
entries: Alters shape of any one Med or smaller wooden object (or portion) up to 5 ft. in any dimension that it can see within 30' forming it into any shape it wants. Ex: warp boat planks so it takes on water seal wooden door to its frame (or make new door in wood wall) or twist wood weapon out of shape (or restore warped one). Warped thrown or ranged weapons and ammo are useless while warped melee weapons give disadvantage on attacks. Can't create items that usually require high craftsmanship ex: pulley. If target is worn/carried creature with it: DC 15 Dex save avoid effect on success.

entries.name: Throttle
entries: One creature grappled by witchalder: 18 (4d6+4) bludgeoning damage and can't breathe speak or cast verbal spells until grapple ends (DC 15 Str half damage remains grappled but no other Throttle effects).

entries.name: Pollen Cloud
entries: Each creature within 15 ft. of witchalder: 22 (5d8) poison and incapacitated for 1 min (DC 15 Con half damage and isn't incapacitated). Incapacitated creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

name: Wrackwraith
languages: any languages it knew in life

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: Move through others/objects as difficult terrain. Takes 5 (1d10) force if it ends turn in object.

entries.name: Wrack Form
entries: While animating a pile of wrack has AC 18 and can use Slam and Deluge actions. Also loses its immunity to grappled and restrained conditions and can't fly. If it moves through a creature or object with Incorporeal Movement while animating wrack wrack falls off its ghostly body ending this. Otherwise can end this as bonus action. If it takes 15+ damage in single turn while animating wrack must make DC 13 Con save or be ejected from wrack ending this.

entries.name: Ghostly Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d8+3) necrotic.

entries.name: Slam (Wrack Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage + 4 (1d8) necrotic. If target is Large or smaller grappled (escape DC 13). Until grapple ends target restrained and wrackwraith can't use its Slam or attack another. Target can't breathe or speak until grapple ends.

entries.name: Animate Wrack
entries: Animates wrack within 5 ft. of it pulling the debris into a protective covering over its ghostly body.

entries.name: Deluge (Wrack Form Only)
entries: Fills lungs of one creature it is grappling with seawater algae and tiny ocean debris harming creatures that breathe air or water: 14 (4d6) necrotic and chokes as lungs fill with water and debris (DC 13 Con half damage not choking). Choking creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Wrack Jump
entries: Leaves current pile magically teleports to another within 60' of it and uses Animate Wrack.

name: Wraith, Oathrot
languages: the languages it knew in life

resistances.name: thunder; nonmagic B/P/S attacks not made w/silvered weapons

entries.name: Aura of Oathbreaking
entries: Any creature that begins its turn within 30' of wraith: DC 13 Cha save or become cursed losing its resolve in important oaths it has taken. While cursed creature has disadvantage on Con saves to maintain concentration and can't add its proficiency bonus to ability checks and saves in which it is proficient. On success creature is immune to wraith's Aura of Oathbreaking for 24 hrs.

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: Move through others/objects as difficult terrain. Takes 5 (1d10) force if it ends turn in object.

entries.name: Oathseeker
entries: Can pinpoint the location of any cleric paladin celestial or other divine connected creature within 60' of it.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

entries.name: Life Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one creature,. 20 (4d8+2) necrotic. The target must make DC 13 Con save or its hp max is reduced by amount equal to damage taken. Reduction lasts until target finishes long rest. Target dies if this reduces its hp max to 0.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: Can move through a space as narrow as 1' wide with o squeezing. Any equipment worn/carried is left behind when it goes through a space too small for the equipment.

entries.name: Assume the Dead
entries: Enters corpse of a Small Medium or Large creature that has been dead less than 24 hrs impersonating it for 2d4 days before body decays. If xecha takes 15 damage or more on a single turn while inhabiting body it must make DC 15 Con save or be ejected from the body which falls apart and is destroyed. Its stats except size are same in each body.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

entries.name: Transparent
entries: Even when in plain sight it takes a successful DC 16 Wis (Perception) check to spot a xecha that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the xecha's space while unaware of it is surprised by the xecha.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Pseudopod attacks or three Slams.

entries.name: Pseudopod (True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 13 (3d6+3) bludgeoning damage + 7 (2d6) acid.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 12 (2d8+3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Sensory Overload
entries: Psychic pulse. Each creature that isn't a Construct or Undead within 20' of the xecha: 24 (7d6) psychic and blinded and deafened until end of its next turn (DC 15 Int half damage not blinded/deafened).

entries.name: Construct Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary statue.

entries.name: Flinging Pounce
entries: If it moves 20'+straight toward a Large or smaller creature and then hits it with Tusk on same turn target thrown up to 15 ft. in a random direction and knocked prone (DC 12 Str negates throw and prone). If thrown target strikes a solid surface target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. it was thrown. If target is thrown at another creature creature takes same damage and knocked prone (DC 12 Dex negates both).

entries.name: Standing Leap
entries: Long jump is up to 40' and its high jump is up to 20' with or with o a running start.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: One Tusk attack and one Claw attack.

entries.name: Tusk
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (1d6+5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d4+5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Trumpeting Blast
entries: Unleashes a warbling sound in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in area: 10 (4d4) thunder and is deafened for 1 min (DC 12 Con half damage and not deafened). A deafened creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself.

entries.name: Eidetic Memory
entries: Remembers everything it hears or reads. It has advantage on Int (Arcana) and Int (History) checks.

entries.name: Two-Headed
entries: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks and on saves vs. being blinded charmed deafened frightened stunned and knocked unconscious.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 7 (2d4+2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Sonic Yelp
entries: Each creature within 60' of it and can hear it: 21 (6d6) thunder (DC 13 Con half).

entries.name: Enthralling Speech
entries: Each creature within 60' of it and can hear it: charmed for 1 min (DC 13 Wis negates). While charmed creature suffers either (zilaq's choice): Creature becomes hostile toward another creature of the zilaq's choice that is also charmed by the zilaq.Creature rolls d100 at start of each of its turns. If result is 51-100 it can take no action until start of its next turn.

entries.name: Phantasmal Oratory
entries: Describes a creature so vividly it takes on a semblance of reality. Zilaq creates an illusory creature that resembles a Beast Monstrosity or Plant with CR 1 or less for 1 hr. The illusory creature moves and acts according to zilaq's mental direction and takes its turn immediately after zilaq; uses statistics of creature it resembles except it can't use traits actions or spells that force target to save.

entries.name: Firesight
entries: Can see through areas obscured by fire smoke and fog with o penalty.

entries.name: Smoldering Death
entries: When it dies its body crumbles into smoldering coals releasing a great plume of smoke that fills 15 ft. radius sphere centered on zombie's corpse and spreads around corners. Area is heavily obscured and difficult terrain. When creature enters area for first time on a turn or starts its turn there: 7 (2d6) poison (DC 14 Con half). Smoke lasts for 1 min or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hr) disperses it.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hp it must make a Con save with DC of 5+the damage taken unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success the zombie drops to 1 hp instead.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage + 9 (2d8) fire.

entries.name: Smoke Breath
entries: The zombie breathes a cloud of smoke in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area: 9 (2d8) fire and 7 (2d6) poison (DC 15 Con half). Smoke remains until the start of the zombie's next turn and its area is heavily obscured.

entries.name: Erratic Movement
entries: Opportunity attacks vs. the voidclaw zombie are made with disadvantage.

entries.name: Turn Resistance
entries: Advantage: saves vs. turn undead effects.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hp it must make a Con save with DC of 5+the damage taken unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success the zombie drops to 1 hp instead.

entries.name: Undead Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Three Void Claw or Void Bolt attacks.

entries.name: Void Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 8 (1d8+4) slashing damage + 7 (2d6) necrotic. If target is creature other than Construct or Undead must make DC 15 Con save or take 3 (1d6) necrotic at start of each of its turns as wound burns with Void energy. Any creature can use action to purge energy from wound via DC 12 Int (Arcana) check. Energy also leaves the wound if target receives magical healing ending the effect.

entries.name: Void Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, 120 ft., one target, 16 (4d6+2) necrotic.

entries.name: Nimble Fighter
entries: Takes Dash or Disengage action.
